Query_Text_en: That is understandable : It is the characteristic of revolutions that the rate of change outpaces our comprehension .
Translation: 这是可以理解的：革命的特性在于变革的速度超出我们的认知能力。

Query_Text_en: If I started afresh I would probably not feel the need to dwell on the concept of reflexivity and its affinity to self-reference .
Translation: 如果我重新开始，可能没有必要深入探讨反身性及其与自我指涉的亲和力。

Query_Text_en: But I believe there is something to be gained from my approach : People today may be willing to take reflexivity for granted but they may not be fully aware of all its implications .
Translation: 但我相信我的方法或许能带来一些收获：当今人们或许愿意承认反身性，但可能并未完全意识到其所有影响。

Query_Text_en: And I may not be the only one who finds it difficult to adjust to the radical shift in attitudes .
Translation: 我可能并非唯一一个难以适应态度急剧转变的人。

Query_Text_en: In fact most people may not be aware that a radical transformation has occurred the young because they have little understanding of how people thought fifty years ago the old because they have failed to adjust their thinking and so feel perplexed by the current environment .
Translation: 事实上，大多数人可能并未意识到年轻人经历了一场根本性转变，因为他们对五十年前人们的思维方式缺乏了解；而老年人则由于未能调整自己的思维，因而对当前环境感到困惑。

Query_Text_en: We forget that logical positivism was very influential earlier in this century ; it effectively outlawed reflexivity by declaring that statements whose truth value can not be unequivocally determined are meaningless .
Translation: 我们忘记了本世纪初逻辑实证主义曾极具影响力；它通过宣称无法明确确定真值的陈述是没有意义的，实际上禁止了反射性。

Query_Text_en: It is worth remembering this because it reminds us how poorly the limitations of our understanding were understood .
Translation: 这一点值得我们铭记，因为它提醒我们，人们对自身认知局限性的认识何其匮乏。

Query_Text_en: We all know that we are fallible yet we do not really understand why .
Translation: 我们都知道人类并非完美无缺，然而却始终未能真正理解其中缘由。

Query_Text_en: It is the fact that we are participants that limits our powers as observers .
Translation: 正是我们作为参与者的身份，限制了我们作为观察者的能动性。

Query_Text_en: We can not avoid relying on beliefs that can affect their own validity and we can not attain the kind of certainty that is available in those areas where the truth can be established on the basis of the facts .
Translation: 我们无法避免依赖那些可能影响自身有效性的信念，也无法获得在可以通过事实确立真理的领域所具有的那种确定性。

Query_Text_en: Take death and dying : We can study it scientifically but when it comes to our own death science does not provide the answer ; we must make up our own .
Translation: 以死亡和临终为例：我们能够以科学方法进行研究，但当面对自身的死亡时，科学却无法给出答案；我们必须自己做出抉择。

Query_Text_en: There are many ways to reconcile being observer and participant at the same time but none is entirely satisfactory .
Translation: 尽管存在诸多方法可以在观察者与参与者之间寻求平衡，但没有一种是完全令人满意的。

Query_Text_en: Logical positivism has done this by outlawing self-referent statements and in so doing has simply sidestepped the quandary of being a thinking participant .
Translation: 逻辑实证主义正是通过禁止自指陈述这一做法，从而避开了作为思考主体所面临的困境。

Query_Text_en: Logical positivism has merely carried the Enlightenment idea of reason as something separate from reality to its logical conclusion .
Translation: 逻辑实证主义仅仅将启蒙思想中将理性视为独立于现实之外的观点推向了其逻辑终点。

Query_Text_en: `` I think therefore I am '' Descartes said .
Translation: “我思故我在。”笛卡尔说。

Query_Text_en: The Enlightenment idea that reason is capable of explaining and predicting reality remains deeply ingrained in our way of thinking .
Translation: 启蒙运动中理性能够解释和预测现实的观点，至今仍深深植根于我们的思维方式之中。

Query_Text_en: In economics for instance it is embedded in the theory of perfect competition and rational expectations that as we shall see provide the scientific justification for the prevailing creed of market fundamentalism . Expectations can not be rational when they relate to something that is contingent on itself .
Translation: 例如在经济学领域，完美竞争理论和理性预期理论中内嵌的观点，正如我们将要看到的，为市场原教旨主义的盛行信条提供了科学依据。当预期涉及自身条件相关的事物时，理性预期便无法成立。

Query_Text_en: The concept of equilibrium in economics is based on the old-fashioned perception of reality and reason as separate categories .
Translation: 经济学中的均衡概念建立在将现实与理性视为独立范畴的过时认识之上。

Query_Text_en: Currently the cutting edge of intellectual fashion has swung to the opposite extreme : The deconstruction of reality into the subjective views and prejudices of the participants has become all the rage in the humanities .
Translation: 目前，学术时尚的前沿已转向另一个极端：在人文科学领域，将现实解构为参与者的主观认知与偏见的做法正盛行一时。

Query_Text_en: The very basis upon which differing views can be judged namely the objective truth is being questioned .
Translation: 作为评判不同观点基础的客观真理正受到质疑。

Query_Text_en: I have little sympathy with those who seek to deconstruct reality .
Translation: 我对那些试图解构现实的人缺乏同情。

Query_Text_en: I consider this other extreme equally misguided and the concept of reflexivity should help me to make my point .
Translation: 我认为这种另一种极端同样存在谬误，而反射性概念有助于我阐明这一观点。

Query_Text_en: Reflexivity is based on the recognition that there is a reality and we are part of that reality : That is why our understanding is inherently imperfect .
Translation: 自反性基于这样一种认知：存在一个现实，而我们是这一现实的一部分。这就是为什么我们的认知本质上具有不完美性。

Query_Text_en: Reality is unique and uniquely important .
Translation: 现实具有独特性，其重要性独一无二。

Query_Text_en: It can not be reduced or broken down into the views and beliefs of the participants exactly because there is a lack of correspondence between what people think and what actually happens .
Translation: 这不能简单归结或分解为参与者的观点和信念，恰恰是因为人们的认知与实际发生的情况之间缺乏对应关系。

Query_Text_en: In other words there is more to reality than the participants ' views .
Translation: 换句话说，现实不仅仅限于参与者的观点。

Query_Text_en: The lack of correspondence also thwarts the prediction of events on the basis of universally valid generalizations .
Translation: 对应关系的缺失也阻碍了基于普遍有效概括的事件预测。

Query_Text_en: There is a reality even if it is unpredictable . This may be difficult to accept but it is futile even downright dangerous to deny it as any participant in the financial markets who has lost money can testify .
Translation: 存在一种现实，即使它不可预测。尽管这可能难以接受，但否认这一现实不仅徒劳无益，甚至会带来严重风险，任何在金融市场中蒙受损失的参与者都能证明这一点。

Query_Text_en: Markets rarely gratify one 's expectations yet their verdict is real enough to cause anguish and loss and there is no appeal .
Translation: 市场鲜少满足人们的期望，然而其裁决之真实足以引发痛苦与损失，且无可挽回。

Query_Text_en: It may strike readers as strange that I should present financial markets as an example of reality ; to most people they seem unreal .
Translation: 读者或许会感到奇怪，我竟将金融市场作为现实的例证；在大多数人看来，金融市场似乎显得不真实。

Query_Text_en: But that only goes to show that our understanding of reality is somehow warped .
Translation: 这恰恰表明，我们对现实的理解存在某种程度的扭曲。

Query_Text_en: We think of reality as something independent of human foibles whereas our imperfect understanding is very much part of reality .
Translation: 人们通常认为现实是独立于人类局限性的客观存在，然而，人类认知的不完美恰恰构成了现实的重要组成部分。

Query_Text_en: Financial markets reflect the biased views of the participants ; they also play an important role in shaping the course of events .
Translation: 金融市场反映了参与者的偏见；它们还在塑造事件进程中发挥着重要作用。

Query_Text_en: The course of events can not be understood simply by studying the participants ' views ; we must also study how the actual course of events differs from those views .
Translation: 仅通过研究当事方的观点无法理解事件进程；我们还必须研究实际事件进程与这些观点之间的差异。

Query_Text_en: Otherwise we would leave out of account the divergence between expectations and outcomes and that would be a significant distortion of reality .
Translation: 否则，我们就会忽视预期与结果之间的偏差，这将是对现实的重大扭曲。

Query_Text_en: I seek to reconcile the contradictions inherent in being participant and observer at the same time by taking our fallibility as my starting point .
Translation: 我试图以人类的局限性为出发点，调和同时作为参与者与观察者时所固有的矛盾。

Query_Text_en: To rephrase Descartes I ant pan of the world I seek to understand therefore my understanding is inherently imperfect .
Translation: 我作为我试图理解的世界的一部分，因此我的理解本质上是不完美的。

Query_Text_en: This applies with particular force to those aspects of reality that have thinking participants . It renders both our understanding and the course of events uncertain .
Translation: 这尤其适用于那些存在具有思维能力的参与者的真实领域。这使得我们的认知和事件的发展轨迹都充满了不确定性。

Query_Text_en: Since the uncertainty can not be removed we had better take it as our starting point .
Translation: 鉴于这种不确定性无法消除，我们最好将其作为出发点。

Query_Text_en: Doing so does not rule out speculating either on the nature of reality or on the nature of knowledge but it offers a firmer basis for understanding the world in which we live than either on its own .
Translation: 这样做并不排除对现实本质或知识本质进行探讨，但它为理解我们所生活的世界所提供的依据，比单独任何一方都更为坚实。

Query_Text_en: And it will lead to the concept of open society as a desirable form of social organization .
Translation: 这将使开放社会成为一种理想的社会组织形式。

Query_Text_en: While we have become familiar with reflexivity as a phenomenon we have not yet learned to appreciate its implications .
Translation: 虽然我们已经熟悉了反身性这一现象，但我们尚未充分认识到其影响。

Query_Text_en: We must recognize that reality is not something separate and independent of our thinking .
Translation: 我们必须认识到，现实并非与我们的思维相互分离、彼此独立的事物。

Query_Text_en: Perfect knowledge is unattainable but even with our imperfect understanding we are capable of having an impact on the world in which we live .
Translation: 完美知识虽无法完全掌握，但我们不完美的认知仍能对所处的世界产生影响。

Query_Text_en: We should remember however that our fallibility is liable to create a gap between intentions and outcomes .
Translation: 然而，我们应当时刻谨记，人类的局限性可能导致意图与结果之间产生偏差。

Query_Text_en: Instead of the futile pursuit of the perfect design whether in the form of communism or in the form of markets that tend toward equilibrium we should content ourselves with the next best thing : a society that holds itself open to change and improvement . That is the concept of open society .
Translation: 与其徒劳地追求完美的制度设计——无论是共产主义形式还是趋于均衡的市场形式——我们应当满足于次优选择：一个能够保持开放、不断改进与变革的社会。这就是开放社会的理念。

Query_Text_en: Logical positivism sought to outlaw self-referential statements as meaningless .
Translation: 逻辑实证主义试图将自指陈述视为无意义而予以排除。

Query_Text_en: The scheme is eminently suitable to a universe that is separate and independent of the statements that refer to it but it is quite inadequate for understanding the world of thinking agents .
Translation: 该方案极为适用于一个与指向它的陈述相分离且独立的领域，但它却难以理解具有思维能力的主体所处的世界。

Query_Text_en: It was always possible to attack the logical positivist position at the margin by conjuring up certain statements whose truth value was indeterminate for instance `` The present king of France is bald .
Translation: 人们总是可以通过提出某些真值无法确定的陈述，例如"法国当前的国王是秃头的"，从边缘处对逻辑实证主义立场发起攻击。

Query_Text_en: ? But such statements are either nonsensical or contrived ; either way we can live without them .
Translation: 但这类声明要么是毫无意义的，要么是牵强附会；无论如何我们都可以不用它们。

Query_Text_en: By contrast reflexive statements are indispensable to a proper understanding of human affairs .
Translation: 相比之下，反思性陈述对于正确理解人类事务不可或缺。

Query_Text_en: We can not do without reflexive statements because we can not avoid decisions that have a bearing on our fate ; and we can not reach those decisions without relying on theories and predictions that can affect the subject matter to which they refer .
Translation: 我们离不开反思性陈述，因为我们无法避免关乎命运的抉择；而要做出这些抉择，又必须依赖能够影响其涉及对象的理论和预测。

Query_Text_en: To ignore our use of reflexive statements when we all do use them or to force them into the categories of `` true '' and `` false '' misinterprets the role of thinking in human affairs .
Translation: 忽视我们实际上都在使用的反思性陈述，或强行将其归入"真实"与"虚假"的范畴，这曲解了思维在人类社会活动中所扮演的角色。

Query_Text_en: Instead of categorizing statements solely as true or false it may be useful to introduce a third category : reflexive statements whose truth value is contingent on their impact .
Translation: 与其单纯将陈述归类为真或假，或许可以引入第三类陈述：其真值取决于自身影响的自反性陈述。

Query_Text_en: All value statements are reflexive in character : `` Blessed are the poor for theirs is the kingdom of heaven .
Translation: 所有价值陈述都具有自反性："贫穷的人是有福的，因为天国是他们的。"

Query_Text_en: If this statement is believed then the poor may indeed be blessed with the ability to ignore their travails in this world but they will be less motivated to get themselves out of their misery .
Translation: 如果这一说法成立，那么穷人或许确实具备忽视现世苦难的能力，但他们摆脱困境的动力也会减弱。

Query_Text_en: By the same token if the poor are held to be guilty of their own misery then they are less likely to receive any relief and will have less reason to consider themselves blessed .
Translation: 同样地，如果穷人被认为要为自己的悲惨处境负责，那么他们就更难获得救济，也更少理由自视为蒙受恩惠。

Query_Text_en: Most generalizations about history and society are similarly reflexive in character : `` The proletarians of the world have nothing to lose but their chains '' or `` The common interest is best serve d by allowing people to pursue their own interests .
Translation: 关于历史与社会的大多数概括都具有类似的反身性特征："全世界的无产者除了锁链外一无所有"或"共同利益的最佳保障在于让每个人追求自身的利益"。

Query_Text_en: It may be appropriate to assert that such statements have no determinate truth value but it would be misleading [ and historically it has been very dangerous ] to treat them as meaningless .
Translation: 断言这些陈述没有确定的真值或许是适当的，但将其视为无意义则是具有误导性的——历史上还曾带来过巨大危险。

Query_Text_en: To the extent they are believed they affect the situation to which they refer .
Translation: 在人们相信它们的程度上，它们会影响所指涉的情况。

Query_Text_en: I am not claiming that a third category of truth is indispensable for dealing with reflexive phenomena .
Translation: 我并非主张第三种真理范畴是应对反身性现象不可或缺的。

Query_Text_en: The time-hallowed distinction between true and false may suffice provided we recognize that statements need not be true or false in order to be meaningful .
Translation: 关于真与假的这一历史悠久的区分或许足以适用，只要我们认识到，陈述无需是非真即假也能具有意义。

Query_Text_en: Predictions relating to singular events are true or false depending on whether or not they come to pass .
Translation: 关于单一事件的预测是否成立，取决于这些预测是否实现。

Query_Text_en: It is only when it comes to predictive theories that the uncertainty connected with reflexivity comes into play .
Translation: 只有在涉及预测性理论时，与反射性相关的不确定性才会起作用。

Query_Text_en: Perhaps it is best dealt with at the level of theories rather than at the level of statements .
Translation: 或许，从理论层面进行探讨更为适宜，而非停留于具体表述层面。

Query_Text_en: The crucial point is that in reflexive situations the facts do not necessarily provide an independent criterion by which the truth or validity of our theories can be judged .
Translation: 关键点在于，在反身性情境中，事实并不必然构成一个独立标准，用以评判我们理论的真理性或有效性。

Query_Text_en: We have come to treat correspondence as the hallmark of truth . But correspondence can be brought about in two ways : either by making statements that corresponds to the facts or by making facts correspond to the statements . Only in the first case is correspondence the guarantor of truth ; in the second case the correspondence may bear testimony to the impact of a belief rather than to its truth or validity .
Translation: 我们已将对应关系视为真理的标志。但对应关系可通过两种方式实现：要么通过使陈述与事实相符，要么通过让事实符合陈述。只有在第一种情况下，对应关系才是真理的保障；而在第二种情况下，对应关系可能证明的是一种信念的影响，而非其真实性和正确性。

Query_Text_en: This caveat applies to most political pronouncements and many social theories . Instead of being true or false they are contingent on being believed .
Translation: 这一警示同样适用于大多数政治声明和诸多社会理论。与其说是真实或虚假的，不如说它们的价值依存于是否被人们接受。

Query_Text_en: I hardly need emphasize the profound significance of this proposition : Nothing is more fundamental to our thinking than our concept of truth . We are accustomed to thinking about situations that have thinking participants in the same way as we do about natural phenomena but the relationship between facts and statements is different : Instead of a one-way street we find a two-way feedback mechanism reflexivity .
Translation: 我无需赘言这一命题的深远意义：没有什么比我们对真理的理解更为根本。我们习惯于以对待自然现象的方式思考涉及具有思维能力的参与者的情境，但事实与陈述之间的关系截然不同：这里不存在单向关系，而是存在着双向反馈机制——即反射性。

Query_Text_en: Therefore we must thoroughly revise the way we think about the world of human and social affairs .
Translation: 因此，我们必须彻底转变对人类社会事务领域的认识方式。

Query_Text_en: In the social realm we may draw a distinction between statements and facts between thoughts and reality but we must recognize that this distinction has been introduced by us in an attempt to make sense of the world in which we live ; it does not prevail in that world .
Translation: 在社会领域，我们或许可以区分陈述与事实、思想与现实，但我们必须认识到，这种区分是我们为了理解所生活的世界而人为引入的；它并非世界本身固有的。

Query_Text_en: Our thinking belongs in the same universe that we are thinking about .
Translation: 我们的思考与我们所探讨的对象存在于同一范畴之中。

Query_Text_en: This gives rise to innumerable difficulties that are absent when dealing with aspects of reality where thinking and reality can be separated into watertight compartments [ as in natural science ] .
Translation: 这就会产生数不胜数的困难，而在处理思维与现实能够严格区分的现实领域（如自然科学）时，这些困难并不存在。

Query_Text_en: Instead of separate categories we must treat thinking as part of reality .
Translation: 我们不应将其划分为独立的类别，而应将思维视为现实的组成部分。

Query_Text_en: Incidentally similar difficulties arise when we try to comprehend reality as a whole [ because we are paid of it ] but that is not the primary focus of the current discussion .
Translation: 当我们试图整体把握现实时，类似的困难也会出现（因为我们是它的一部分），但这一问题并非当前讨论的重点。

Query_Text_en: It is impossible to form a picture of the world in which we live without distortion .
Translation: 无法不带有失真地描绘我们所生活的世界的图景。

Query_Text_en: In a literal sense when the human eye forms a visual image we have a blind spot where the optic nerve is attached to the nerve stem .
Translation: 从字面意义来说，当人眼形成视觉图像时，在视神经连接到神经干的位置存在一个盲点。

Query_Text_en: The image made in our brain replicates the outside world remarkably well and we can even fill in the blind spot by extrapolating from the rest of the picnire though we can not actually see what is in the area covered by the blind spot .
Translation: 大脑中形成的图像能极为逼真地再现外部世界，我们甚至可以通过推断图像其余部分的信息来填补盲点区域，尽管实际上我们无法看到盲点覆盖区域内的景象。

Query_Text_en: This is a useful metaphor for the problem we confront .
Translation: 这为我们所面临的难题提供了一个有用的比喻。

Query_Text_en: The world in which we live is extremely complicated . To form a view of the world that can serve as a basis for decisions we must simplify .
Translation: 我们生活的世界极其复杂。为了形成能够作为决策基础的世界观，我们必须进行简化。

Query_Text_en: Using generalizations metaphors analogies comparisons dichotomies and other mental constructs serve s to introduce some order into an otherwise confusing universe .
Translation: 概括、隐喻、类比、比较、二分法以及其他心智建构旨在为否则将混乱不堪的宇宙引入某种秩序。

Query_Text_en: But every mental construct to some extent distorts what it represents and every distortion adds something to the world that we need to understand .
Translation: 但每个思维建构在某种程度上都会扭曲其所表征的对象，而每一次扭曲都会为这个世界增添我们需要理解的新内容。

Query_Text_en: Ideas have a way of taking on a life of their own .
Translation: 思想往往具有自行其是的力量。

Query_Text_en: I shall give a practical demonstration of this in connection with the concept of open society [ see Chapter 5 ] .
Translation: 我将结合开放社会的概念，对此进行实践演示（见第五章）。

Query_Text_en: The more we think the more we have to think about .
Translation: 思考得越多，需要思考的问题也就越多。

Query_Text_en: That is because reality is not a given . It is formed in the same process as the participants ' thinking : The more complex the thinking the more complicated reality becomes .
Translation: 这是因为现实并非既定不变。它是在与参与者思维共同作用的过程中形成的：思维越复杂，现实就越复杂。

Query_Text_en: Preface UNDERSTANDING the process of economic change would enable us to account for the diverse performance of economies , past and present . We would be able to account for the long history of sustained growth of the United States and western Europe , the spectacular rise and demise of the Soviet Union , for the contrasting performances of the rapid economic growth of Taiwan and South Korea and the dismal record of sub-Saharan Africa economies , and the contrasting evolution of Latin America and of North America . And beyond understanding the past , such knowledge is the key to improving the performance of economies in the present and future . A real understanding of how economies grow unlocks the door to greater human well-being and to a reduction in misery and abject poverty .
Translation:
前言  
理解经济变迁的过程，能够解释不同经济体过去与当前的差异化表现。我们得以阐释美国及西欧长期持续增长的历史、苏联的崛起与衰落、台湾和韩国经济高速增长与撒哈拉以南非洲经济体惨淡记录的鲜明对比，以及拉丁美洲与北美截然不同的发展轨迹。而超越对过往的解读，此类认知更是提升当下及未来经济表现的关键。真正理解经济增长的机制，将开启通向人类福祉改善的大门，助力减少困苦与极端贫困。

Query_Text_en: The economic paradigm -- neo-classical theory -- was not created to explain the process of economic change . We live in an uncertain and ever changing world that is continually evolving in new and novel ways . Standard theories are of little help in this context . Attempting to understand economic , political , and social change [ and one can not grasp change in only one without the others ] requires a fundamental recasting of the way we think . Can we develop a dynamic theory of change comparable in elegance to general equilibrium theory ? The answer is probably not . But if we can achieve an understanding of the underlying process of change then we can develop somewhat more limited hypotheses about change that can enormously improve the usefulness of social science theory in confronting human problems .
Translation: 经济学范式——新古典理论——并非为了阐释经济变化的过程而诞生。我们生活在一个充满不确定性且不断演变的世界，这个世界正以前所未有的方式持续重塑自身。标准理论在此情境下鲜少能提供帮助。试图理解经济、政治与社会的变化（因为孤立地把握某一领域而不考虑其余二者是不可能的），需要从根本上重构我们的思维方式。我们能否打造出一个在精妙程度上能与一般均衡理论媲美的变化动态理论？答案大概是否定的。但如果我们能洞悉变化背后的底层机制，便有可能发展出一些范围相对有限却更加精准的变化假设，从而极大提升社会科学理论应对人类问题的实际效用。

Query_Text_en: This study is an extension -- a very substantial extension -- of the new institutional economics . A brief review of my earlier work on institutional change will provide the proper setting for that extension . From my initial studies with Lance Davis [ Davis and North , 1971 ] and Robert Thomas [ North and Thomas , 1973 ] , I have placed institutions at the center of understanding economies because they are the incentive structure of economies . I also have focused on how economies that were composed of institutions that provided incentives for stagnation and decline could persist . The underlying source of this persistence had to be features of the human environment and of the ways humans interpreted that environment . What I did not consider in earlier studies was the character of societal change and the way humans understand and act upon that understanding of societal change .
Translation: 这项研究是对新制度经济学的延伸——一项极为重要的延伸。简要回顾我此前关于制度变迁的研究，将为这一延伸提供合适的背景。从最初与兰斯·戴维斯（Davis and North, 1971）以及罗伯特·托马斯（North and Thomas, 1973）的合作研究开始，我就将制度置于理解经济的核心地位，因其构成了经济的激励结构。我还特别关注过，由那些提供停滞与衰退激励的制度构成的经济体为何能够持续存在。这种持续性的根本动因必然源于人类生存环境的特征，以及人类解读该环境的方式。然而我在早期研究中未曾涉及的，是社会变迁的性质，以及人类如何理解和应对这种社会变迁的认知。

Query_Text_en: Economic change is a process , and in this book I shall describe the nature of that process . In contrast to Darwinian evolutionary theory , the key to human evolutionary change is the intentionality of the players . The selection mechanisms in Darwinian evolutionary theory are not informed by beliefs about the eventual consequences . In contrast , human evolution is guided by the perceptions of the players ; choices -- decisions -- are made in the light of those perceptions with the intent of producing outcomes downstream that will reduce uncertainty of the organizations -- political , economic , and social -- in pursuit of their goals . Economic change , therefore , is for the most part a deliberate process shaped by the perceptions of the actors about the consequences of their actions . The perceptions come from the beliefs of the players -- the theories they have about the consequences of their actions -- beliefs that are typically blended with their preferences .
Translation: 经济变革是一个过程，本书将描述这一过程的本质。与达尔文进化论不同，人类进化的核心在于行为主体的意图性。达尔文理论中的选择机制并不受行为主体对未来结果预期的影响。相比之下，人类进化则由行为主体的认知所引导；他们基于这些认知做出选择——即决策——旨在通过行动产生的下游结果，降低政治、经济及社会组织为实现目标而面临的不确定性。因此，经济变革在很大程度上是一个由行为主体对其行动后果的认知所塑造的有意识过程。这些认知源于行为主体的信念——即他们对自己行动后果的理论认知——而这些信念通常与其偏好相融合。

Query_Text_en: But just how do humans come to understand their environment ? The explanations that they develop are mental constructs derived from experiences , contemporary and historical . Human learning is more than the accumulation of the experiences of an individual over a lifetime . It is also the cumulative experiences of past generations . The cumulative learning of a society embodied in language , human memory , and symbol storage systems includes beliefs , myths , ways of doing things that make up the culture of a society . Culture not only determines societal performance at a moment of time but , through the way in which its scaffolding constrains the players , contributes to the process of change through time . The focus of our attention , therefore , must be on human learning -- on what is learned and how it is shared among the members of a society and on the incremental process by which the beliefs and preferences change , and on the way in which they shape the performance of economies through time .
Translation: 人类究竟是如何理解其所处环境的？他们发展出的解释是源自个人体验和历史传承的心智建构。人类的学习不仅是个体一生经验的积累，更是前人经验的累积。社会通过语言、人类记忆及符号储存系统所承载的累积学习成果，包括信仰、神话、行事方法等构成社会文化的基本要素。文化不仅决定某一时刻的社会表现，更通过其框架结构对参与者施加的约束方式，推动着历时性变革的进程。因此，我们的关注焦点必须转向人类学习——研究知识传承的内容与方式，探究认知与偏好随时间推移如何渐进演变，以及这种演变如何随时代发展塑造经济行为。

Query_Text_en: Part of the scaffolding humans erect is an evolutionary consequence of successful mutations and is therefore a part of the genetic architecture of humans , such as innate cooperation within small interacting groups ; part is a consequence of cultural evolution such as the development of institutions to favor larger group cooperation . Just what is the mix between the genetic architecture and the cultural heritage is in dispute . Evolutionary psychologists have stressed the genetic component in the scaffolding process at the expense of the role of the cultural heritage . Certain universals in human mental constructs such as supernatural explanations -- religions broadly construed -- suggest that these are congenial to the underlying inference structure of all humans . Equally , the immense variation in the performance characteristics of societies makes clear that the cultural component of the scaffolding that humans erect is also central to the performance of economies and polities over time .
Translation: 人类构建的社会架构部分源于进化过程中成功的基因突变，因此属于人类遗传架构的一部分，例如小型互动群体内的先天合作倾向；另一部分则源于文化进化，如为促进更大规模群体合作而发展出的社会制度。关于遗传架构与文化传承之间的具体比例，学术界存在争议。进化心理学家在强调脚手架构建过程中基因成分时，往往忽视了文化遗产的作用。人类思维构造中某些普世现象——如广义上的宗教等超自然解释——表明这些与人类底层推理机制具有天然亲和性。同样，不同社会在运行特征上的巨大差异也表明，人类构建的社会架构中文化要素同样对经济与政治体系的长期表现具有核心影响。

Query_Text_en: The wide gap throughout history between intentions and outcomes reflects the persistent tension between the scaffolds that humans erect to understand the human landscape and the ever changing `` reality '' of that landscape . That tension and its implications for the human condition both past and present , and indeed future , is the subject of this book . Part I explores the dimensions of the challenge involved in acquiring an in-depth study of the process of economic change . Part II takes us some distance along the trail toward a deeper understanding .
Translation: 历史上意图与结果之间的巨大鸿沟，反映了人类构建认知框架以理解社会图景与该图景不断变化的"现实"之间持续存在的张力。这种张力及其对人类境况——过去、现在乃至未来——的影响，正是本书探讨的核心。第一部分剖析了深入研究经济变革过程所面临的挑战维度；第二部分则沿着这条路径进一步引领我们深化认知。

Query_Text_en: We can not usefully model economic change until we understand the process . A good model entails a prior comprehension of the complex factors making up that process and then a deliberate simplifying to the crucial elements . Understanding is a necessary prerequisite missing in the economist 's rush to model economic growth and change . We are a long way from completely understanding the process . Until we do , we will have very little success in deliberately improving economic performance . What follows is an attempt to improve our understanding .
Translation: 我们无法在真正理解这一过程之前有效建模经济变革。优秀模型的构建需要先全面把握构成这一过程的复杂因素，再有意识地提炼出关键要素。理解这一过程是经济学家在急于对经济增长与变革进行建模时所缺失的关键前提。我们离完全理解这一过程还有很长的路要走。在真正理解这一过程之前，我们很难通过主动干预有效提升经济表现。以下尝试将有助于深化我们对这一问题的认识。

Query_Text_en: This study has been a long time in process -- more than ten years -- and could only have developed with the generous help of many organizations and individuals .
Translation: 这项研究历时十余年，是在众多机构和个人的大力支持下才得以完成的。

Query_Text_en: Both Washington University , my principal location , and the Hoover Institution at Stanford , my winter home , have provided hospitable settings for research . The Mercatus Center at George Mason University and the Stanford Institute for International Studies have hosted conferences focused on issues of this book , and I am deeply indebted to Paul Edwards and Brian Hooks of the former organization , and to Syed Shariq who played a major role in organizing the Stanford conferences .
Translation: 华盛顿大学是我主要的研究驻地，斯坦福大学胡佛研究所则是我的冬季驻所，两地都为我的研究提供了理想环境。乔治梅森大学的梅卡图斯中心与斯坦福国际研究所曾举办过聚焦本书议题的学术会议，我谨向梅卡图斯中心的保罗·爱德华兹和布莱恩·胡克斯致谢，同时深切感谢赛义德·沙里克在组织斯坦福会议中发挥的重要作用。

Query_Text_en: My colleagues at Washington University have patiently put up with my endless queries and arguments . I owe particular debts to Lee and Alexandra Benham , Pascal Boyer , Randall Calvert , John Drobak , Sukoo Kim , Jack Knight , Gary Miller , John Nye , Norman Schofield , and Itai Sened .
Translation: 华盛顿大学的同事们耐心听取并包容了我无休止的提问与讨论。我特别感谢李和亚历山德拉·本汉姆、帕斯卡尔·博耶、兰德尔·卡尔弗特、约翰·德罗巴克、苏库·金、杰克·奈特、加里·米勒、约翰·奈、诺曼·肖菲尔德以及伊泰·塞内德。

Query_Text_en: At Stanford Paul David , Steve Haber , Avner Greif , Walter Powell , Nate Rosenberg , and Barry Weingast have been particularly helpful in furthering my education .
Translation: 在斯坦福大学，保罗·戴维、史蒂夫·哈伯、阿夫纳·格雷夫、沃尔特·鲍威尔、内特·罗森伯格和巴里·韦因加斯特等教授给予我特别多的帮助，对我的学术成长起到了重要作用。

Query_Text_en: Participants at the conferences [ in addition to those listed above ] focused on issues of the book , among them Lee Alston , Robert Cooter , Leda Cosmides , Thrainn Eggertsson , Jean Ensminger , Gregory Grossman , Philip Hoffman , Timur Kuran , Chris Mantzavinos , Joel Mokyr , and Vernon Smith , were valuable to me .
Translation: 参加会议的代表（此外还有上述之外的）集中讨论了本书的相关议题，其中包括李·阿尔斯顿、罗伯特·科特、莱达·科斯米德斯、特雷恩·埃格特松、让·恩斯明格、格雷戈里·格罗斯曼、菲利普·霍夫曼、蒂穆尔·库兰、克里斯·曼塔扎维诺斯、乔尔·莫基尔和弗农·史密斯等学者，他们的观点对本人极具参考价值。

Query_Text_en: I am grateful to Kevin McCabe , who in collaboration with his colleagues in the experimental laboratory at George Mason University constructed experiments to test a number of the propositions central to this study . Lengthy discussions with Andy Clark and Merlin Donald improved my understanding of many crucial issues in cognitive science .
Translation: 我谨感谢凯文·麦卡比，他与乔治梅森大学实验实验室的同事合作，设计实验检验了本研究中的若干核心命题。与安迪·克拉克和梅林·唐纳德的多次深入讨论，显著提升了我对认知科学诸多关键问题的理解。

Query_Text_en: Joel Mokyr and John Wallis read the entire manuscript and provided detailed comments ; Philip Keefer did the same while working in Nepal . Peter Dougherty of the Princeton University Press also provided detailed comments on the entire manuscript . Their comments substantially improved the final draft .
Translation: 乔尔·莫基尔和约翰·沃利斯通读了整个手稿并提供了详细评论；菲利普·基弗在尼泊尔工作期间同样进行了通读并提出了详细意见。普林斯顿大学出版社的彼得·多尔蒂也对整份手稿给出了详细评论。他们的意见显著提升了最终草稿的质量。

Translation:
我在使用计算机方面的不足，多亏了多位能干的专家多次纠正指正，才得以弥补——圣路易斯的鲍勃·帕克斯和弗洛林·彼得雷斯库，以及胡佛研究所的丹·威尔黑米。我需向两位优秀的研究助理阿特·卡登和尤里·苏霍多尔斯基，以及能干的秘书范妮·巴特致谢。最深的谢意献给我的妻子伊丽莎白·凯斯，她不仅通篇校订了手稿，还承受了本书漫长而有时令人困扰的创作过程带来的主要压力。

Query_Text_en: UNDERSTANDING economic change including everything from the rise of the Western world to the demise of the Soviet Union requires that we cast a net much broader than purely economic change because it is a result of changes [ 1 ] in the quantity and quality of human beings ; [ 2 ] in the stock of human knowledge particularly as applied to the human command over nature ; and [ 3 ] in the institutional framework that defines the deliberate incentive structure of a society . A complete theory of economic change would therefore integrate theories of demographic , stock of knowledge , and institutional change . We are far from having good theories of any one of these three , much less of the three together , but we are making progress . The central focus of this study , and the key to improving economic performance , is the deliberate effort of human beings to control their environment . Therefore , priority is given here to institutional change , with the consequent incentive implications for demographic and stock of knowledge changes ; but there is no implication that such an approach deals adequately with the latter two .
Translation: 理解经济变迁——从西方世界的崛起到苏联的解体——必须将视野拓展到单纯的经济变化之外，因为经济变迁是三个层面变革的结果：[1]人类数量与质量的演变；[2]人类知识储备的积累（尤其是人类掌控自然能力的提升）；[3]界定社会激励结构的制度框架的变革。因此，完整的经济变迁理论应当整合人口理论、知识积累理论与制度变迁理论。目前我们对这三个领域的任何单一理论都尚未完全掌握，更遑论三者的综合，但我们正在取得进展。本研究的核心关切——也是提升经济绩效的关键——在于人类有意识地掌控环境的努力。因此本研究将制度变革置于优先地位，通过制度变革对人口演变和知识积累产生的激励效应展开分析；但这并不意味着这种研究路径能够充分解释后两者。

Query_Text_en: The structure we impose on our lives to reduce uncertainty is an accumulation of prescriptions and proscriptions together with the artifacts that have evolved as a part of this accumulation . The result is a complex mix of formal and informal constraints . These constraints are imbedded in language , physical artifacts , and beliefs that together define the patterns of human interaction . If our focus is narrowly on economics , then our concern is with scarcity and , hence , competition for resources . The structure of constraints we impose to order that competition shapes the way the game is played . Because various kinds of markets [ political as well as economic ] have different margins at which competition can be played out , the consequence of the structure we impose will be to determine whether the competitive structure induces increasing economic efficiency or stagnation . Thus well-developed property rights that encourage productivity will increase market efficiency . The evolving structure of political and economic markets is the key to explaining performance .
Translation: 我们为降低生活中的不确定性而构建的体系，是由一系列规定与禁止事项及相关产物共同积累形成的。这种积累的结果形成了正式与非正式约束交织的复杂网络。这些约束嵌入于语言、实物载体及信仰体系之中，共同塑造着人类互动的模式。若聚焦于经济学视角，我们的关切便指向稀缺性以及由此引发的资源竞争。我们为规范这种竞争而构建的约束体系，决定了博弈的规则。由于各类市场（政治与经济领域皆然）存在不同层面的竞争展开空间，我们所构建的结构将决定竞争体系究竟是推动经济效率持续提升还是导致停滞不前。因此，产权制度若能有效激励生产力发展，便能提升市场效率。政治与经济市场结构的演变，是解释经济表现的关键所在。

Query_Text_en: While the uncertainty that pervades our existence may be reduced by the structure we impose , it is not eliminated . The constraints that we impose have , themselves , uncertain outcomes reflecting both our imperfect understanding of our environment and the equally imperfect nature of both the formal rules and the informal mechanisms we use to enforce those constraints .
Translation: 虽然人为构建的框架可以降低渗透于我们存在的不确定性，但无法彻底消除。我们强加的约束机制其结果本身也充满不确定性，既反映了我们对环境认识的局限性，也体现了我们用来实施这些约束机制的正式规则和非正式手段的不完善性。

Query_Text_en: This book is a study about the ceaseless efforts of humans to gain greater control over their lives and in the course of that effort continually confronting new and novel problems to solve . It is a study of the perceptions that induce institutional innovation intended to reduce uncertainty or convert uncertainty into risk . It is also a study of a continually changing human landscape . This landscape poses new challenges , as a consequence of which policies emanating from `` non-rational '' explanations frequently play a part in the structures we create .
Translation: 本书探讨了人类为争取更大生活自主权所付出的不懈努力，以及在此过程中不断面对需要解决的新问题。它研究了促使制度创新的认知——这些认知旨在降低不确定性或将不确定性转化为可管控的风险。本书同时揭示了不断演变的人文景观：这种变迁催生了新的挑战，因此源自"非理性"解释的政策常成为我们构建的社会结构组成部分。

Query_Text_en: I A bare-bones description of the process of economic change is straightforward . The `` reality '' of a political-economic system is never known to anyone , but humans do construct elaborate beliefs about the nature of that `` reality '' -- beliefs that are both a positive model of the way the system works and a normative model of how it should work . The belief system may be broadly held within the society , reflecting a consensus of beliefs ; or widely disparate beliefs may be held , reflecting fundamental divisions in perception about the society . The dominant beliefs -- those of political and economic entrepreneurs in a position to make policies -- over time result in the accretion of an elaborate structure of institutions that determine economic and political performance . The resultant institutional matrix imposes severe constraints on the choice set of entrepreneurs when they seek to innovate or modify institutions in order to improve their economic or political positions . The path dependence that results typically makes change incremental although the occasional radical and abrupt institutional change suggests that something akin to the punctuated equilibrium change in evolutionary biology can occur in economic change as well . But change is continually occurring [ although the rate will depend on the degree of competition among organizations and their entrepreneurs ] as entrepreneurs enact policies to improve their competitive position . The result is alteration of the institutional matrix , therefore revisions of perceptions of reality , and therefore new efforts by entrepreneurs to improve their position in a never-ending process of change . The key to understanding the process of change is the intentionality of the players enacting institutional change and their comprehension of the issues . Throughout history and in the present world economic growth has been episodic because either the players ' intentions have not been societal well-being or the players ' comprehension of the issues has been so imperfect that the consequences have deviated radically from intention .
Translation: 经济变迁过程的简要描述是直截了当的。政治经济体系的"现实"从来无人知晓，但人类会构建关于这种"现实"本质的复杂信念体系——这些信念既是对系统运行方式的实证性模型，也是对其应然运行方式的规范性模型。这种信念体系可能在社会范围内得到广泛认同，反映共识；也可能存在根本分歧，折射出社会认知的深刻裂痕。随着时间推移，占据主导地位的信念——尤其是那些掌握政策制定权的政治经济领域决策者和企业家的信念——会逐步积累起一套复杂的制度结构，这些结构决定了经济与政治绩效。由此形成的制度矩阵，对企业家在寻求创新或改革制度以提升自身经济或政治地位时的选择范围构成严格约束。这种路径依赖通常导致渐进式变革，尽管偶尔出现的激进制度变革表明，类似生物学进化中的"间断平衡式变革"在经济变迁中同样可能发生。但变革始终持续发生（尽管变革速度取决于各类组织及其企业家之间的竞争程度），因为企业家会通过制定政策来提升自身竞争优势。这一过程不断改变制度矩阵，进而修订人们对"现实"的认知，促使企业家在永无止境的变革进程中不断尝试调整自身地位。理解变革过程的关键在于参与制度变革各方的意图性及其对问题的认知程度。历史上及当今世界经济增长呈现阶段性特征，要么因为各方意图并非追求社会整体福祉，要么由于各方认知存在严重缺陷，导致实际后果与初衷产生根本性偏离。

Query_Text_en: The nature of this overall process can be illustrated by a brief account of the rise and fall of the Soviet Union [ which will be the subject of a more comprehensive analysis later ] . Marx and Engels provided the belief system that was Lenin 's revolutionary inspiration , explaining both the way the world was and the way it should be . The circumstances of the war-torn Russia of 1917 provided the unusual opportunity for abrupt institutional change . While Marx provided no blueprint for the transformation to or construction of a socialist society , his fundamental ideological building blocks , particularly with respect to the concept of property , remained guiding principles [ and constraints ] of Soviet leaders . Dire necessity forced a retreat from the principles and led to the creation of the New Economic Policy [ NEP ] in 1921 ; the first five-year plan in 1928 returned to ideological orthodoxy . In the early years substantial discussion of alternative strategies and hence institutions helped shape socialism . The gradual accretion of the complex institutional matrix that resulted led to perceived successes -- such as in heavy industry -- and failures -- such as in agriculture -- and attempts to correct the failures within the belief system of Marxist orthodoxy . As the economy grew , underwent the devastating torment of the Nazi invasion , and then underwent the lengthy reconstruction process , the institutional matrix was continually being modified by external stimuli -- war -- or internal perceptions of needed institutional alterations guided by a belief system that evolved within the ideological limits of Marxism . The result throughout the 1950s , 1960s , and early 1970s was rapid growth of physical output , military technology , and scientific knowledge ; and the advent of superpower status .
Translation: 整个过程的性质可以通过对苏联兴衰的简要概述来说明（该主题将在后续进行更全面的分析）。马克思和恩格斯为列宁的革命提供了思想体系，既解释了当时世界运行的方式，也阐明了理想中的发展方向。1917年战乱频仍的俄国所处的特殊环境，为制度的剧烈变革提供了独特机遇。尽管马克思并未为向社会主义社会转变或构建社会主义社会提供具体蓝图，但他思想中关于财产概念等核心意识形态要素，始终是苏联领导人的指导原则（同时也构成约束）。在1921年，严峻的困境迫使莫斯科放弃既定原则，催生了“新经济政策”（NEP）；而1928年开始的第一个五年计划又回归了意识形态正统。在早期阶段，对替代性发展战略的广泛讨论确实帮助塑造了社会主义制度。随着时间推移，逐渐形成的复杂制度矩阵导致了可见的成就——例如重工业领域的成功——和失败——例如农业领域的问题——以及在马克思主义正统理论框架内对失败的修正尝试。在经济发展过程中，苏联经历了纳粹入侵带来的毁灭性创伤，随后又经历了漫长重建，其制度体系不断被外部刺激（战争）或内部对制度变革需求的感知所调整，而这些调整始终遵循着在马克思主义思想界限内演进的信念体系。其结果是，1950年代到1970年代初，苏联实现了物质产出、军事技术和科学知识的快速增长，并最终跻身超级大国行列。

Query_Text_en: Almost half the world became socialist or communist in this era and these ideologies were widely perceived to be the wave of the future . But then growth began to slow , the problems of agriculture became ever more acute , and efforts at institutional reform to rectify the problems were ineffectual . Following the advent of Gorbachev in 1985 , the policies of the next six years led to absolute decline and in 1991 to the demise of the Soviet Union -- perhaps the most striking case of internally induced rapid demise in all of human history .
Translation: 在此时期，几乎半个世界实行了社会主义或共产主义制度，这些意识形态曾被普遍视为历史潮流。然而经济增长开始放缓，农业问题日趋严峻，旨在纠正问题的机构改革努力收效甚微。1985年戈尔巴乔夫上台后，其后六年的政策导致全面衰退，并于1991年引发苏联解体——这或许是人类历史上因内部因素引发的迅速崩溃最典型案例。

Query_Text_en: This story of the Soviet Union is a story of perceived reality beliefs institutions policies altered perceived reality and on and on . The keys to the story are the way beliefs are altered by feedback from changed perceived reality as a consequence of the policies enacted , the adaptive efficiency of the institutional matrix -- how responsive it is to alteration when outcomes deviate from intentions -- and the limitations of changes in the formal rules as correctives to perceived failures .
Translation: 苏联的故事是一个关于感知现实、信念、制度与政策如何相互作用并不断改变感知现实的循环。这一故事的关键在于：政策实施后，因感知现实变化而产生的反馈如何改变信念的方式；制度矩阵的适应性效率——其偏离预期目标时调整响应的灵敏度；以及正式规则调整作为对感知到的失败的矫正措施时的局限性。

Query_Text_en: It is one thing to be able to provide a summary description of the process of economic change ; it is something else to provide sufficient content to this description to give us an understanding of this process . How well do we understand reality ? How do beliefs get formed ? Whose beliefs matter and how do individual beliefs aggregate into belief systems ? How do they change ? What is the relationship between beliefs and institutions ? How do institutions change ? How do institutions affect performance ? What accounts for the widely varied patterns of performance of economies and polities ? And perhaps most fundamental of all , what is the essential nature of the process itself ? These are just a few of the questions that are the subject of this book . The remainder of this chapter elaborates on the separate parts of the puzzle .
Translation: 描述经济变革过程是一个方面；要充实这种描述使其成为真正理解该过程的工具则是另一回事。我们对现实的理解程度如何？信念是如何形成的？哪些信念具有影响力？个人信念又是如何凝聚成为信念体系的？它们如何发生演变？信念与制度之间存在何种关联？制度如何演变？制度又如何影响绩效表现？为何不同经济体与政治体系的绩效模式会呈现如此广泛差异？或许最根本的问题是：这种演变过程的内在本质究竟是什么？这些问题仅仅是本书探讨的核心议题中的一部分。本章后续内容将逐一解析这些谜题的不同层面。

Query_Text_en: II What is the deep underlying force driving the human endeavor -- the source of the human intentionality that comes from consciousness ? It is the ubiquitous effort of humans to render their environment intelligible -- to reduce the uncertainties of that environment . But the very efforts of humans to render their environment intelligible result in continual alterations in that environment and therefore new challenges to understanding that environment . The study of the process of economic change must begin therefore by exploring the ubiquitous efforts of human beings to deal with and confront uncertainty in a non-ergodic world .
Translation: 人类所有努力背后的深层驱动力——源于意识的人类意向性之根源是什么？这正是人类普遍试图使其环境变得可理解的不懈努力——即减少环境中存在的不确定性。然而，人类将环境变得可理解的努力本身，反而导致环境的持续改变，因而不断产生新的理解挑战。对于经济变革过程的研究，必须首先从探索人类在非遍历世界中应对和直面不确定性的普遍努力开始。

Query_Text_en: Just what is it that we are trying to model in our theories , beliefs , ideologies ? The pragmatic concern is with the degree to which our beliefs accord with `` reality . To the extent that they do , there is some prospect that the policies that we enact will produce the intended result . But because throughout human history we have gotten it wrong [ misunderstood reality ] much more often than we have gotten it right [ understood reality ] it is important that we be very conscious about the nature of reality . Of even more importance is awareness of just how reality is changing . Beliefs and the way they evolve are at the heart of the theoretical issues of this book . For the most part , economists , with a few important exceptions such as Friedrich Hayek , have ignored the role of ideas in making choices . The rationality assumption has served economists [ and other social scientists ] well for a limited range of issues in micro theory but is a shortcoming in dealing with the issues central to this study .1 Indeed the uncritical acceptance of the rationality assumption is devastating for most of the major issues confronting social scientists and is a major stumbling block in the path of future progress . The rationality assumption is not wrong , but such an acceptance forecloses a deeper understanding of the decision-making process in confronting the uncertainties of the complex world we have created .
Translation: 在我们的理论、信仰和意识形态中，我们究竟在试图构建什么样的模型呢？从实用主义的角度来看，关键在于我们的信念与"现实"的契合程度。我们的信念越是符合现实，我们推行的政策就越有可能产生预期效果。但因为在人类历史长河中，我们误解现实的次数远多于理解现实的次数，因此我们必须极为清醒地认识到现实的本质。甚至更重要的是，要意识到现实本身是如何演变的。信念及其演变方式是本书理论探讨的核心。在很大程度上，经济学家们（少数例外如弗里德里希·哈耶克除外），忽视了观念在决策过程中的作用。理性假设虽在微观理论的一系列有限议题上为经济学家（及其他社会科学工作者）提供了便利工具，但在处理本研究的核心议题时却显现出局限性。事实上，对理性假设的不加批判的接受对社会科学面临的重大议题造成了致命打击，同时也是阻碍未来进步的主要障碍。理性假设本身并非错误，但这种教条式的接受方式阻碍了我们深入理解在应对我们所创造的这个复杂世界中的诸多不确定性时的决策过程。

Query_Text_en: The way we perceive the world and construct our explanations about that world requires that we delve into how the mind and brain work -- the subject matter of cognitive science . This field is still in its infancy but already enough progress has been made to suggest important implications for exploring social phenomena . Issues include how humans respond to uncertainty and particularly the uncertainty arising from the changing human landscape , the nature of human learning , the relationship between human learning and belief systems , and the implications of consciousness and human intentionality for the structure that humans impose on their environment .
Translation: 我们认识世界并构建对世界解释的方式，需要深入探讨心智与大脑的运作机制——这正是认知科学的研究领域。该学科尚处萌芽阶段，但已取得足够进展，为探索社会现象提供了重要启示。相关议题包括：人类如何应对不确定性（尤其是源于人类社会格局变化的不确定性）、人类学习的本质、学习与信仰体系的关系，以及意识和人类意图性对人类强加于环境的结构框架所具有的影响。

Query_Text_en: Humans attempt to use their perceptions about the world to structure their environment in order to reduce uncertainty in human interaction . But whose perceptions matter and how they get translated into transforming the human environment are consequences of the institutional structure , which is a combination of formal rules , informal constraints , and their enforcement characteristics . This structure of human interaction determines who are the entrepreneurs whose choices matter and how such choices get implemented by the decision rules of that structure . Institutional constraints cumulate through time , and the culture of a society is the cumulative structure of rules and norms [ and beliefs ] that we inherit from the past that shape our present and influence our future . Institutions change , usually incrementally , as political and economic entrepreneurs perceive new opportunities or react to new threats affecting their well-being . Institutional change can result from change in the formal rules , the informal norms , or the enforcement of either of these . The political-economic structure of the society and the way it evolves is the key to whose choices matter and how they conspire to shape policies .
Translation: 人类试图通过其对世界的认知来构建生存环境，以减少人际互动中的不确定性。但哪些认知具有影响力、这些认知又是如何转化为改造人类环境的现实力量，均取决于制度结构——这一由正式规则、非正式约束及其执行机制共同构成的体系。人类互动的制度框架决定了哪些企业家的选择具有影响力，以及这些选择如何通过制度结构的决策规则得以实施。制度约束随时间累积形成，而社会文化正是我们从历史继承的规则、规范（及信念）的累积结构，塑造着当下并影响着未来。制度变迁通常以渐进方式发生，当政治经济领域的行动者感知到新的机遇或应对影响其福祉的新威胁时，这种变迁便可能发生。制度变革可能源于正式规则的调整、非正式规范的演变，或是对上述任一要素执行方式的改变。社会的政治经济架构及其演变路径，是决定哪些选择具有影响力、以及这些选择如何共同作用以塑造政策的核心关键。

Query_Text_en: We can begin to put the pieces together to explore [ very incompletely ] the process of economic change . Is the process similar to models derived from evolutionary biology ? What difference does the intentionality of the players make and what is the nature of the human intentionality that is the immediate source of institutional change ? Does the uncertainty that humans face come from the inherent instability of the human landscape or from the perceptions and belief systems that we have about the human environment ? What are the underlying sources of path dependence and just how does path dependence affect performance ? And finally what makes for adaptive efficiency -- the ability of some societies to flexibly adjust in the face of shocks and evolve institutions that effectively deal with an altered `` reality '' ?
Translation: 我们可以开始整合线索，尝试[非常不完整地]探索经济变迁的过程。这一过程是否类似由进化生物学衍生出的模型？参与者的主观意图会对制度变革产生何种影响，而作为制度变革直接来源的人类主观意图的本质又是什么？人类所面临的不确定性源自人类环境本身固有的不稳定性，还是我们对人类环境的认知与信念体系？路径依赖的根本来源有哪些，而路径依赖又是如何影响绩效的？最后，是什么造就了适应性效率——即某些社会在应对冲击时能灵活调整，并成功演化出有效处理改变后"现实"的制度的能力？

Query_Text_en: In part II of this book I apply the analytical framework developed in part I to attempt to provide a deeper understanding of the process of change , both historical and contemporary . I broadly outline the changes in the human landscape over the millennia since humans evolved from other primates , and particularly focus on the past two millennia . The emphasis here is on the sharp divide between institutions constructed to deal with the uncertainties that are a consequence of the physical environment and those constructed to deal with the human environment . The difficulties involved in altering the institutional framework from one geared to confronting the physical environment to one capable of dealing with the modern human environment is at the heart of many of the fundamental issues of economic development .
Translation: 在本书第二部分中，我将第一部分构建的分析框架应用于尝试更深入地理解历史与当代变革过程。我大致勾勒了人类从灵长类进化至今数千年间人类社会面貌的演变轨迹，尤其聚焦于过去两千年间的变迁。此处的核心在于揭示两类制度体系的鲜明分野：一类旨在应对物理环境带来的不确定性，另一类则针对人类环境构建。将制度框架从应对物理环境的模式转向能够处理现代人类环境的机制所面临的困难，正是经济发展诸多根本性问题的核心所在。

Query_Text_en: In the Western world , and in particular in the United States , we tend to take order for granted . We should not . Disorder -- revolution , lack of personal security , chaos -- has characterized a great deal of the human condition , as witness the turbulent history of Latin America . Order implies a reduction of the uncertainties that inevitably characterize the human condition as a result of institutions that provide greater predictability in human interaction . Disorder increases uncertainty as rights and privileges of individuals and organizations are `` up for grabs '' as a consequence of unstable relationships in both political and economic markets . Understanding the underlying conditions of order and disorder is essential for coming to grips with the process of economic change .
Translation: 在西方世界，尤其是美国，人们往往将秩序视为理所当然。然而，这种态度并不妥当。无序——包括革命、个人安全缺失、混乱等——一直是人类境况的重要特征，拉丁美洲动荡的历史便是明证。秩序意味着通过制度减少人类互动中的不确定性，这些制度为人类交往提供了更大的可预测性。无序则会加剧不确定性，因为个人和组织的权利与特权在政治和经济市场不稳定的关联下，往往处于争夺状态。理解秩序与无序的深层条件，对于把握经济变革的过程至关重要。

Query_Text_en: How successful are we at controlling our destiny ? In the tradition of Herbert Simon , who directed our attention to these issues , what difference does it make that humans fall far short of substantively rational behavior , which would entail full knowledge of all possible contingencies , exhaustive exploration of the decision tree , and a correct mapping between actions , events , and outcomes ? The short answer is that it makes a lot of difference . Economic history is a depressing tale of miscalculation leading to famine , starvation , defeat in warfare , death , economic stagnation and decline , and indeed the disappearance of entire civilizations . And even the most casual inspection of today 's news suggests that this tale is not purely a historical phenomenon . Yet we do get it right sometimes , as the spectacular economic growth of the past few centuries attests . But ongoing success is hardly a foregone conclusion .
Translation: 我们掌控自身命运的成效如何？沿着赫伯特·西蒙的传统——他曾将我们的注意力引向这些问题的方向——人类远未达到实质理性行为这一点究竟有何影响？要完全预知所有可能的意外情况，系统梳理决策脉络，并建立行动、事件与结果间的精准关联，这些才是实质理性的核心要素。简短的回答是：这种差距影响重大。经济史是一部由误判引发饥荒、贫困、战争溃败、死亡、经济停滞、衰退乃至整个文明消亡的令人沮丧的历程。即便只是粗略浏览当今新闻，也能发现这种境遇并非纯粹属于历史现象。然而人类偶尔确实做得不错，正如近几个世纪以来经济的迅猛增长所证明的。但持续的成功绝非板上钉钉。

Query_Text_en: The beliefs and consequent institutions that produced the rise of the Western world illustrate the blend of shrewd judgments and good fortune that have gone into getting it [ more or less ] right . A more important objective is to tell a dynamic story -- exploring the process of successful change through time . The rise and fall of the Soviet Union is a sobering exploration of the human endeavor to deliberately craft society and I explore the subject in more depth in order to elaborate two aspects of economic change : the inherent difficulties involved in deliberately attempting to alter the societal framework with the very imperfect knowledge of the players , and [ 2 ] the process of disintegration of a society wrestling to overcome the rigidities and erroneous beliefs that confront societies attempting to make fundamental changes . The accretion of experience derived from efforts to improve performance of third world and transition economies as well as what we have learned from the success stories has provided us with a crude laboratory and sobering understanding of how little we know about the process . But we are learning ; and I shall describe what we have learned and what we have yet to learn in order to improve our understanding of the process .
Translation: 西方世界崛起背后的理念与制度安排，展现了取得成功（或多或少）过程中精明判断与幸运的结合。更重要的目标在于讲述一个动态发展的故事——通过时间维度探索成功变革的过程。苏联的兴衰是对人类试图人为设计社会结构这一努力的深刻警示，我将深入探讨这一主题以阐明经济变革的两个方面：其一是在知识极度匮乏的情况下刻意尝试改变社会框架所面临的固有困难；其二是一个社会在努力克服根本性变革中遭遇的僵化结构与错误观念时，其解体过程的内在规律。从改善第三世界国家和转型经济体绩效的努力中积累的经验，以及从成功案例中汲取的教训，为我们提供了一个粗糙的试验场和清醒的认知——我们对变革过程的了解依然匮乏。但我们正在学习；我将阐述我们已知的内容以及仍需探索的部分，以深化对这一过程的理解。

Query_Text_en: A clear implication of understanding the nature of the process of change is the limitation the process imposes on human foresight . In this book I shall explore just how much we can know about the future and how much must remain the province of astrologers , soothsayers , and statesmen . The argument of this study suggests a sobering appraisal of the future of humans in the face of the ubiquitous uncertainty of a non-ergodic world .
Translation: 对变革过程本质的理解有一个明确的启示，即这一过程对人类预见能力的制约。本书将探讨我们能够多大程度上预知未来，以及哪些领域仍需交由占星家、预言家和政治家来诠释。本书的论点表明，在非遍历世界普遍存在的不确定性面前，人类未来的前景需要进行令人清醒的评估。

Query_Text_en: Introduction WHAT KIND of a theoretical framework must we develop to understand the process of economic change ? The theory we possess is static ; and while a truly dynamic theory may be beyond our reach we can incorporate the dimension of time as an integral part of the analysis . We must develop a body of generalizations about the operation of economies over time . Our objective must be to focus on those elements in the society that undergird and account for that process . Economics is a theory of choice -- so far so good . But the discipline neglects to explore the context within which choice occurs . We choose among alternatives that are themselves constructions of the human mind . Therefore how the mind works and understands the environment is the foundation of this study . But what is the environment ? The human environment is a human construct of rules , norms , conventions , and ways of doing things that define the framework of human interaction . This human environment is divided by social scientists into discrete disciplines -- economics , political science , sociology -- but the constructions of the human mind that we require to make sense out of the human environment do not coincide with these artificial categories . Our analytical frameworks must integrate insights derived from these artificially separate disciplines if we are to understand the process of change . Moreover we must understand what is the underlying force driving the constructs that the mind makes . Why do rules , norms , conventions , and ways of doing things exist ? What induces the mind to structure human interaction in this way ? The new institutional economics [ NIE ] takes us partway . It focuses on the beliefs that humans develop to explain their environment and the institutions [ political , economic , and social ] that they create to shape that environment . Part I of this book explores what drives humans to undertake these artificial constructs and then develops and expands on the tools of the NIE to provide a framework for explicitly exploring the nature of economic change .
Translation: 我们需要建立什么样的理论框架才能理解经济变迁的过程？我们现有的理论是静态的；尽管真正动态的理论或许超出了我们的能力范围，但我们仍可以把时间维度作为分析的有机组成部分。我们必须构建关于经济随时间运行动态的普遍性结论。我们的目标应聚焦于社会中那些支撑并解释这一过程的要素。经济学是关于选择的理论——这一点没错。但该学科忽略了对选择所处环境的探讨。我们是在人类思维构建的选项中做出选择的。因此，关于心智如何运作并理解环境的研究，构成了本研究的基础。那么什么是环境？人类的环境是由人类创造的规则、规范、惯例和做事方式的集合，这些构成了人类互动的框架。社会科学将这一人类环境人为地划分为经济学、政治学、社会学等不同学科，但人类为了理解环境所构建的认知体系，并不与这些人为划分的学科领域完全契合。若想理解变迁过程，我们的分析框架必须整合这些被割裂学科中的洞见。此外，我们还必须理解塑造这些心智建构背后的底层驱动力。为何规则、规范、惯例与行为方式能够存在？是什么促使人类以这种方式架构人际关系？新制度经济学（NIE）部分回答了这些问题。它关注人类为解释环境而形成的基本信念，以及他们创造的政治、经济、社会制度如何塑造环境。本书第一部分将探讨人类构建这些人为体系的内在动因，继而拓展NIE的研究工具，建立一个明确探究经济变迁本质的分析框架。

Query_Text_en: THE INTELLECTUAL JOURNEY on which we are embarking requires us to rethink some of the foundations of traditional economic theory , specifically those foundations dealing with the two issues that are the subject of this chapter -- uncertainty and ergodicity . Economists , typically , do not ask themselves about the structure that humans impose on themselves to order their environment , and therefore reduce uncertainty ; nor are they typically concerned with the dynamic nature of the world in which we live , which continues to produce novel problems to be solved . The last point raises a fundamental issue . If we are continually creating a new and novel world , how good is the theory we have developed from past experience to deal with this novel world ? These questions are central to this study . We must delve into the remote sources of the forces that induce humans to devise the kind of structures that they do . It is not sufficient to describe societal change ; rather we must attempt to find the underlying forces shaping the process of change .
Translation: 我们即将开启的这场思想之旅需要重新思考传统经济理论的一些基础性假设，具体而言是与本章讨论的两大核心议题相关的基础假设——不确定性和遍历性。经济学家通常不会思考人类为了规范自身环境而构建的结构（这种结构正是降低不确定性的关键），也不太关注我们所处世界的动态本质——这个世界持续不断产生有待解决的新问题。这一点引出了一个根本性问题：如果人类始终在创造崭新且未知的世界，那么我们基于过往经验建构的理论在应对这个新世界时究竟有多大的适用性？这些问题是本研究的核心所在。我们需要深入探究那些驱动人类创造特定社会结构的深层力量。仅仅描述社会变迁是不够的，我们必须努力揭示塑造变革过程的潜在动因。

Query_Text_en: I Uncertainty has a long history in economic literature . It is usually traced back to Frank Knight 's distinction between risk and uncertainty in a classic study published in 1921 . For Knight , risk was a condition in which it was possible to derive a probability distribution of outcomes so that one could insure against such a condition . Uncertainty according to Knight was a condition in which no such probability distribution existed . Theorizing under the condition of uncertainty therefore was not possible , according to eminent theorists such as Kenneth Arrow [ 1951 ] and Robert Lucas [ 1981 ] . More recently the terms have undergone some semantic alteration with uncertainty coming to mean what Knight meant by risk and the term ambiguity coming to refer to what Knight meant by uncertainty . I shall continue to use the terms as Knight defined them , although with some modification as discussed in the following paragraphs .
Translation: 不确定性在经济学文献中具有悠久的历史，通常可追溯至弗兰克·奈特在1921年经典研究中对风险与不确定性的区分。在奈特看来，风险是指能够推导出结果概率分布、从而可针对该情形进行投保的条件；而不确定性则指不存在此类概率分布的状态。肯尼斯·阿罗（1951）和罗伯特·卢卡斯（1981）等权威理论家认为，在不确定性条件下进行理论构建是不可能的。近年来相关术语经历了一些语义演变，当前"不确定性"一词逐渐被用于指代奈特所定义的"风险"，而"模糊性"则对应奈特所指的"不确定性"。尽管下文将对部分概念进行调整，我仍将沿用奈特最初的术语定义。

Query_Text_en: Economists have themselves displayed a good deal of ambiguity on the subject , largely proceeding as though uncertainty was an unusual condition and therefore the usual condition , certainty , could warrant the elegant mathematical modeling that characterizes formal economics . But uncertainty is not an unusual condition ; it has been the underlying condition responsible for the evolving structure of human organization thioughout history and pre-history . In order to deal properly with the issue we must define the term somewhat differently than Knight did . Knight limited his definition to a probabilistic criterion ; a more general view is that humans have a ubiquitous drive to make their environment more predictable . The drive can encompass anything from rendering outcomes to be statistically probable to attempting to reduce uncertainty so fundamental in character that we do not have a clue to the possible outcomes -- such as the consequences of nuclear energy for the future of humans . Ronald Heiner , in an article of fundamental importance to economic analysis , caught the essence of the issue in his assertion that uncertainty was `` The Origin of Predictable Behavior '' [ Heiner 1983 ] . Heiner 's article points to the source of institutional innovation in what he calls the C-D gap , a gap between the agent 's competence and the difficulty of the decision problem . The human agent in the face of such a gap will construct rules to restrict the flexibility of choices in such situations . We know these rules as institutions . By channeling choices into a smaller set of actions , institutions can improve the ability of the agent to control the environment [ although there is no implication that the agent 's perceptions are correct ] . Heiner directs us toward the analytical framework developed in the rest of this study . The construction of an institutional framework has been an essential building block of civilization .
Translation: 经济学家们自身在这一问题上表现出相当模糊的态度，他们大多行事仿佛不确定性是一种罕见状态，因此认为通常状态下的确定性能够支撑起正式经济学中那种优雅的数学建模。但不确定性并非罕见状态；它始终是人类社会组织形态演变背后的根本性条件，贯穿整个历史与史前时代。要恰当处理这一问题，我们必须以不同于奈特的方式重新定义该术语。奈特将定义局限于概率标准；而更普遍的观点是，人类普遍存在一种将环境变得更可预测的驱动力。这种驱动力涵盖从让结果呈现统计学上的可能性，到试图降低那些根本性的不确定性——例如核能对未来人类的影响——以至于我们对其可能结果毫无头绪。罗纳德·海纳在一篇对经济分析具有根本意义的文章中，通过“不确定性是可预测行为之源”这一论断，抓住了问题的本质[海纳1983]。海纳的文章指出，制度创新的根源在于他所谓的“能力-难度差距”——即行动者的能力与决策问题的难度之间的鸿沟。面对这种差距，人类行动者会构建规则以限制特定情境下的选择灵活性。我们称这些规则为制度。通过将选择限制在较少的行动范围内，制度能够提升行动者控制环境的能力[尽管这并不意味着行动者的认知是正确的]。海纳的研究指引我们走向本研究后续部分所发展的分析框架。制度框架的构建始终是文明发展的基石。

Query_Text_en: The beliefs and institutions that humans have devised only make sense as an ongoing response to the various levels of uncertainty that humans have confronted and continue to confront in the evolving physical and human landscape . While the deep underlying source of institutions has been and continues to be the effort by humans to structure the environment to make it more predictable , this effort can and frequently does make for increased uncertainty for some of the players . The development of well-specified property rights , for example , will make the overall environment more predictable but will increase uncertainty for those who traditionally have used the land in question without having formal title . Hence an essential question we must ask is , who makes the rules and for whom and what are their objectives . There is no necessary identification between institutions and efficiency as economists use [ and misuse ] the term . Indeed one of the major puzzles to be explained is how , and under what conditions , humans create the conditions that make for markets with low costs of transacting and increasing material well-being .
Translation: 人类所设计的信仰与制度体系，本质上是对不断演变的物质和人文环境中各类不确定性所作出的持续性回应。制度的深层根源始终在于人类试图通过构建环境来增强其可预测性的努力，但这种努力往往也会给某些参与者带来更大的不确定性。以产权的明确界定为例，虽然这会使整体环境更具可预测性，却可能增加那些传统上无正式产权却使用相关土地群体的不确定性。因此我们必须追问的核心问题是：谁在制定规则？为谁制定？其目标何在？制度与效率之间并不存在必然关联——正如经济学家所使用（乃至误用）该术语所揭示的那样。事实上，亟待解释的重大谜题在于：人类在何种条件下、通过何种方式创造出交易成本较低且物质福祉持续提升的市场环境。

Query_Text_en: We can make a beginning at answering the question concerning rules by exploring the way humans have attempted to make the environment more predictable . Everyone begins life facing ubiquitous uncertainty . That initial uncertainty gets reduced by learning experiences of two kinds -- those from the physical environment and those from the socio-cultural linguistic environment . Experiences differ across cultures both at a moment of time and over time ; humans will have different interpretations of the environment and therefore uncertainty . Therefore , knowing how learning takes place in the mind is essential for understanding how humans deal with uncertainty .
Translation: 我们可以通过探索人类如何试图使环境更具可预测性来开始解答规则相关的问题。每个人的一生都始于面对无处不在的不确定性。这种初始的不确定性会通过两种类型的实践经验得到缓解——来自物理环境的经验以及来自社会文化语言环境的经验。不同文化背景下的经验既在某一时刻存在差异，又随时间推移而变化；因此人类对环境及其不确定性也会形成不同的认知。因此，了解人类心智中的学习机制是理解人类如何应对不确定性的重要前提。

Query_Text_en: Throughout human history there has always been a large residual that defied rational explanation -- a residual to be explained partly by non-rational explanations embodied in witchcraft , magic , religions ; but partly by more prosaic non-rational behavior characterized by dogmas , prejudices , `` half-baked '' theories . Indeed despite the above cited assertion by eminent theorists that it is not possible to theorize in the face of uncertainty , humans do it all the time ; their efforts range from ad-hoc assertions and loosely structured beliefs such as those encompassed in the labels `` conservative '' and `` liberal '' to elegant systematic ideologies such as Marxism or organized religions .
Translation: 纵观人类历史，始终存在着一大片无法用理性解释的残留领域——其中部分残留可通过巫术、魔法、宗教等蕴含的非理性解释来阐释；另一部分则源于更具世俗色彩的非理性行为，表现为教条、偏见以及"半吊子"理论。事实上，尽管诸多杰出理论家断言面对不确定性无法进行理论建构，人类却始终在实践这一过程；其努力范畴从"保守"与"自由"等标签所涵盖的即兴断言和松散信仰，延伸至马克思主义或有组织宗教这类优雅系统的意识形态构建。

Query_Text_en: A general characteristic of human history has been the systematic reduction in the perceived uncertainty associated with the physical environment and therefore a reduction in those sources of uncertainty to be explained by beliefs embodied in witchcraft , magic , and religions . But if uncertainty associated with the physical environment has declined , a consequence has been a vastly more complex human environment . And while we have made some progress in understanding this human environment , our understanding is very limited and characterized by an immense amount of non-rational explanation . Part of the reason for our limited understanding is that there do not appear to be any fundamental `` power laws '' in the social sciences comparable to those in the physical sciences . A more fundamental reason is the non-ergodic nature of the world we are continually altering . An ergodic economy is one in which the fundamental underlying structure of the economy is constant and therefore timeless . But the world we live in is non-ergodic -- a world of continuous novel change ; and comprehending the world that is evolving entails new theory , or at least modification of that which we possess . In consequence , there is no implication that we `` have it right '' despite the awesome advances in science which have enormously reduced uncertainty about the physical environment . With this caveat in mind , let us see how humans through time have altered the environment to make it more predictable . We go back to the definition of uncertainty and divide the term into different degrees :
Translation: 人类历史的一个普遍特征在于系统性降低了人们对物理环境感知到的不确定性，从而减少了需要用巫术、魔法和宗教等信仰形式解释的不确定性来源。然而，随着物理环境相关的不确定性下降，人类社会环境却变得复杂得多。尽管我们在理解社会环境方面取得了一些进展，但认知仍极为有限且充斥着大量非理性解释。认知受限的部分原因在于，社会科学领域似乎不存在类似自然科学中的基本"幂律"法则。更根本的原因在于，我们持续改变的世界具有非遍历性特征。遍历性经济是指其基础结构恒定且超越时间的本质不变的经济体系。但现实世界是非遍历的——一个持续涌现新变化的世界；理解不断演变的世界需要新的理论，或至少对现有理论进行修正。因此，尽管科学的惊人进步极大降低了物理环境的不确定性，但我们并不能因此断言"已完全掌握真理"。谨记这一前提，让我们考察人类如何通过历史进程改造环境以增强其可预测性。我们回到对不确定性的定义，并将这一概念划分为不同层次：

Query_Text_en: 5 . Residual uncertainty that provides the foundation for `` non-rational '' beliefs .
Translation: 5. 剩余不确定性构成"非理性"信念的基础。

Query_Text_en: A major challenge to economic historians would be to write economic history exploring each of these historical processes . Here is a brief elaboration of each of these categories :
Translation: 对于经济史学家而言，一个重大挑战在于系统梳理这些历史进程并撰写经济史。以下是对每一类别的简要阐述：

Query_Text_en: 1 . The development of more information about the characteristics of a human activity has led to predictability . For example , in the fifteenth century the development of marine insurance which entailed collecting and collating information on ships , cargoes , destinations , time en route , wrecks , damage , converted uncertainty into risk . It was a major factor in increasing trade in early modern Europe .
Translation: 人类活动特征的信息发展日益丰富使得预测成为可能。例如，15世纪海上保险的兴起需要收集和整理船舶、货物、目的地、航行时间、沉船事故及损失等信息，将不确定性转化为可计算的风险。这一创新成为早期现代欧洲贸易增长的重要推动力。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Increase in the stock of knowledge has been the fundamental source of increased human well-being . Some of this increase has occurred without a change in the institutional structure being the source of the altered incentives . Increasing the stock of knowledge within the existing institutional framework has occurred throughout history as a consequence of the ubiquitous drive of humans to invent and innovate even in the absence of institutional incentives , as an impressive account of human creativity throughout the ages attests . Other major sources of increases in the stock of knowledge have been changing relative prices or alterations in beliefs , both leading to resource reallocations . Fundamental changes in the relative prices of factors of production have , throughout history , altered incentives to acquire knowledge about those productive factors . For example , the Neolithic revolution and the onset of the plague in fourteenth-century Europe led to both fundamental societal reorganization and redirection of resources and the acquisition of knowledge [ see North 1981 , chapters 7 and 10 ] . As for changes in beliefs , it is finally ideas and their creation which for good and sometimes for evil are the fundamental driving force of the human condition and are the major focus of this study .
Translation: 知识存量的增加始终是人类福祉提升的根本源泉。其中部分增长并未源于制度结构的变革，激励机制的改变也非制度变迁所致。历史上，人们即便在缺乏制度激励的情况下，仍因普遍存在的发明创新冲动而持续积累知识存量，这印证了人类创造力的辉煌历程。知识存量增长的其他主要来源还包括相对价格变动或观念转变，二者均导致资源配置方向调整。历史上生产要素相对价格的根本性变化，始终会改变获取相关生产要素知识的激励机制。例如，新石器革命和14世纪欧洲黑死病的爆发，既引发了社会结构的根本性重组及资源配置转向，又推动了知识的积累[参见诺斯1981年著作第七章和第十章]。至于观念变革，最终正是思想及其创造——有时带来善果，有时导致恶果——构成了人类境况的根本驱动力，也是本研究的核心关注点。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Altering the institutional framework entails changing the incentive structure and has been an essential condition for the reduction in the uncertainties of the environment over time . It has been the major tool by which humans have attempted deliberately to alter their environment . It encompasses many of the efforts in the contemporary world to improve the performance of third world economies . Historically , institutional change has altered the pay-off to cooperative activity [ the legal enforcement of contracts , for example ] , increased the incentive to invent and innovate [ patent laws ] , altered the pay-off to investing in human capital [ the development of institutions to integrate the distributed knowledge of complex economies ] , and lowered transaction costs in markets [ the creation of a judicial system that lowers the costs of contract enforcement ] .
Translation: 改变制度框架意味着调整激励结构，这是长期降低环境不确定性的重要条件。制度变迁一直是人类有意改变其生存环境的主要手段，当代世界诸多旨在提升第三世界国家经济绩效的努力均涵盖其中。历史上，制度变革重塑了合作活动的收益（例如法律合同执行机制）、强化了创新激励（如专利法）、调整了人力资本投资回报（如发展整合复杂经济分散知识的制度体系），并降低了市场交易成本（如建立降低合同执行成本的司法系统）。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The response of humans to novel situations depends on how novel they are and on the cultural heritage of the actors . Their cultural heritage will , in many instances , determine the success or lack of success of the actors . To the extent that that cultural heritage has equipped them to deal with such problems they may , in fact , make responses that make that environment more predictable . If they have not been so equipped they may make inappropriate responses or relegate the issue to witchcraft and\/or similar anti-rational responses . The differential response of economies to the move from personal to impersonal exchange is illustrative . Economies that had evolved a cultural heritage that led them to innovate institutions of impersonal exchange dealt successfully with this fundamental novelty . Those with no such heritage failed , as Avner Greif has documented [ forthcoming a ] .
Translation: 人类对新情况的反应取决于其新颖程度以及行动者所拥有的文化传统。在许多情况下，他们的文化传统将决定行动者能否取得成功。在一定程度上，如果文化传统已为其应对此类问题做好准备，他们实际上可能会做出使环境更具可预测性的反应。如果没有这种准备，他们可能会做出不恰当的反应，或将问题归因于巫术等非理性反应。经济体系对从个人交易向非个人化交易转变的差异化反应就说明了这一点。那些发展出非个人化交易制度文化传统的经济体成功应对了这种根本性变革，而没有这种传统的经济体则失败了，正如Avner Greif所记录的那样。

Query_Text_en: 5 . Despite the fact that uncertainty associated with the physical environment has been radically reduced [ although resulting in increased uncertainty about the human environment ] the residual that leads to non-rational beliefs plays a major role in the world today as it has all through history . The history of and the widespread belief in religions is illustration . Religious belief systems such as Islamic fundamentalism have played and continue to play a major role in shaping societal change ; but equally significant is the critical role of secular ideologies and belief systems in decision making , as the rise and decline of the Soviet Union so vividly illustrates .
Translation: 尽管与物理环境相关的不确定性已大幅降低（尽管由此导致人文环境的不确定性增加），但导致非理性信念的残留因素在当今世界仍扮演着重要角色，这与历史长河中的情形别无二致。宗教的历史及其广泛信仰便是明证。以伊斯兰原教旨主义为代表的宗教信仰体系，既在过去也持续在当今塑造社会变革中发挥重要作用；同样具有深远意义的是，世俗意识形态和信仰体系在决策中的关键作用——苏联的崛起与衰落便生动地印证了这一点。

Query_Text_en: II Ergodic is defined in Webster 's dictionary as `` involving or relating to the probability that any state will recur , especially having zero probability that any state will never recur . Therefore , `` an ergodic stochastic process simply means that averages calculated from past observations can not be persistently different from the time average of future outcomes '' [ Davidson 1991 , 132 ] . For Samuelson the ergodic hypothesis was essential for a scientific economics [ Samuelson 1969 , 184 ] . And indeed the ergodic hypothesis is implicit in much of current economic theory . Robert Solow , in discussing the fundamental assumptions of economic theory , characterized such a view as follows : `` My impression is that the best and the brightest in the profession proceed as if economics is the physics of society . There is a single universally valid model of the world . It only needs to be applied '' [ Solow 1985 , 330 ] .
Translation: 遍历性在韦氏词典中被定义为"涉及或关联到状态重现的概率，尤其指任何状态永不重现的概率为零"。因此，"遍历随机过程"的含义是"根据过去观测值计算的平均值不会与未来结果的时间平均值持续存在差异"[Davidson 1991,132]。对于萨缪尔森而言，遍历假设是科学经济学的基石[Samuelson 1969,184]。事实上，遍历假设隐含在当代多数经济理论之中。罗伯特·索洛在探讨经济理论的基本假设时曾如此概括这种观点："我认为学界最优秀的人才仿佛将经济学视为社会的物理学。存在一套普适有效的世界模型，只需加以运用即可"[Solow 1985,330]。

Query_Text_en: To an economic historian surveying the ten millennia of human history from the onset of the Neolithic revolution , however , the ergodic hypothesis is a-historical . Further , the extraordinary changes in every facet of present-day society are evident all around us ; and it is evident that we have been and are creating societies that are unique in comparison to anything in the past .
Translation: 对于一位审视新石器革命伊始至今人类万年历史的经济史学家而言，遍历假设显然是反历史的。此外，现代社会的方方面面都发生了非凡的变化，这一点处处可见；我们已然且正在创造的社会形态，与历史上任何时期相比都独具特色。

Query_Text_en: The physical sciences resort to reduction to arrive at the fundamental underlying principles that makes their science [ maybe ] ergodic . The social sciences have no such underlying principles except perhaps a behavioral assumption and even that turns out to be far from satisfactory , as research in cognitive science demonstrates . But the reverse position is equally untenable -- that the theory derived from past experience has no relevance for understanding the present and the future . Microeconomic theory has repeatedly demonstrated its power to explain [ and predict ] aspects of economic performance . What we must sort out are the kinds of theory and their appropriateness in particular contexts in a non-ergodic world . But first let us be sure that we understand the essential characteristics of a non-ergodic world .
Translation: 自然科学通过还原论揭示其科学可能具备遍历性的基本原理。社会科学则缺乏此类基础原理，即便存在某种行为假设，认知科学的研究也表明这一假设远非令人满意。但反之，认为从过去经验中得出的理论对理解当下和未来毫无意义的观点同样站不住脚。微观经济理论反复证明了其解释并预测经济表现某些方面的强大能力。我们需要厘清的是，在非遍历性世界中各类理论及其在特定语境下的适用性。但首先必须明确非遍历性世界的本质特征。

Query_Text_en: IN the last decades of the nineteenth century the United States underwent a rapid industrial expansion that moved the nation into the front ranks of the world economy . At the same time , robust democratic institutions formally allocated political power .1 The primary purpose of this book is to explain how and why economic development and democratic institutions coexisted in the United States . This explanation stresses the intensity of popular claims on wealth , the openness of electoral politics , and the very high saliency of developmental policies underpinning industrial expansion .
Translation: 19世纪末的几十年间，美国经历了快速工业扩张，使该国跻身世界经济前列。与此同时，健全的民主制度确立了政治权力分配机制。本书的核心目的在于阐释美国经济与民主制度共存的原因及方式。这一阐释强调民众对财富的强烈诉求、选举政治的开放性以及支撑工业扩张的发展政策所具有的高度重要性。

Query_Text_en: The central problem is to explain why , in a democracy , popular claims for a class redistribution of wealth did not divert the stream of investment propelling industrial expansion . Such claims might have been anticipated , particularly from those classes and sectors most injured by industrialization . In fact , however , private capital accumulation in industrial plant and economic infrastructure was almost entirely unrestrained throughout the late nineteenth century . In explaining this result , four features of the national political economy play important roles : the regional nature of industrialization , the varying ways in which claims on wealth were pressed in the different regions , the dynamics and structure of national party competition , and the susceptibility of the different branches of the federal government to popular political influence .
Translation: 核心问题是解释为何在民主制度下，民众要求财富的阶级性再分配诉求并未转移推动工业扩张的投资流向。这类诉求本可预期出现，尤其是来自工业化过程中受损最深的阶层与群体。然而事实上，整个19世纪后期，工业设施与经济基础设施领域的私人资本积累几乎完全未受限制。在解释这一现象时，国家政治经济的四个特征具有关键作用：工业化的地域性特征、不同地区提出财富诉求的差异化方式、全国政党竞争的动态结构，以及联邦政府各分支对民众政治影响力的敏感程度差异。

Query_Text_en: From the broadest perspective , robust democratic institutions and rampant industrialization were compatible because : [ i ] the agricultural sector that most heavily subsidized industrialization was the export - oriented southern plantation economy , and the South , as a region , was seriously disabled as a viable coalition partner in national politics during this period ; [ 2 ] the structure of the national political economy led workers in the manufacturing belt to focus on interregional redistribution of wealth [ from South to North ] and intersectoral transfers of capital [ from export - oriented agriculture to tariff-protected industry ] , rather than shop-floor contestation with capitalists over shares of industrial profits ; and [ 3 ] the Republican party , as agent for northern industrialization , was able to both win elections and successfully administer a national developmental program . Summed up in a single sentence , democracy and development were compatible because the major groups most likely to pursue political claims on industrial profits , southern cotton producers and northern industrial workers , were unable to coalesce because they occupied antithetical positions within a national political economy restructured and influenced by the primacy of the Republican party .
Translation: 从最宏观的角度看，强大的民主制度与蓬勃发展的工业化能够相容，原因在于：[一]最直接支撑工业化的农业部门是出口导向型南方种植园经济，而作为地理区域的南方在此期间因难以成为有效的政治联盟伙伴而受到严重削弱；[二]国家政治经济结构促使制造业带的工人将关注重点放在地区间财富再分配（从南方到北方）和产业间资本转移（从出口导向型农业向关税保护型工业）上，而非在车间层面与资本家争夺工业利润份额；[三]作为北方工业化推动者的共和党既能在选举中获胜，又能成功实施国家发展计划。简而言之，民主与发展的相容性源于这样一点：最可能提出政治诉求争夺工业利润的两大主要群体——南方棉花生产者和北方产业工人——因在由共和党主导地位重塑和影响的国家政治经济体系中占据对立地位，而无法形成有效联盟。

Query_Text_en: Economic development within democratic institutions has been rare because transitions from agrarian to industrial societies almost always generate intense conflict over the distribution of wealth .3 Rapid transformation of a society from labor-intensive agrarian and artisanal production into energy - and machine-intensive industry necessarily requires vast amounts of capital .
