Translation: 然而，在这两种情况下，电子邮件和日历工具均可互换使用。

Query_Text_en: This camera has a really cool feature called TimeShift. With this function, you can adjust the facial expressions of each person in a group photo, such as making someone smile instead of frowning
Translation: 这款相机拥有一项名为“TimeShift”的实用功能。通过这一功能，您可以在群组照片中调整每个人的面部表情，例如将某人的皱眉表情替换为微笑。

Query_Text_en: I did n't do a formal battery test , but in my moderate to heavy use of the phone , I found it did n't last as long on a charge as the iPhone 5 , and began to get pretty low by late afternoon.
Translation: 我没有进行正式的电池测试，但在中度到重度使用手机的情况下，发现其续航时间不如iPhone 5，到下午较晚时电量已明显不足。

Query_Text_en: The frequency of my mobile phone usage is above average .
Translation: 我的手机使用频率高于平均水平。

Query_Text_en: It would last some people an entire day , but not everyone .
Translation: 这件事对某些人来说可能需要一整天，但并非所有人都这样。

Query_Text_en: I found the browser adequate , but noticeably slower than the standard Apple and Android browser , even on a fast Wi-Fi network
Translation: 我发现该浏览器勉强可用，但比标准苹果和安卓浏览器明显更慢，即使在较快的Wi-Fi网络下也是如此。

Query_Text_en: However, unlike many mobile phones nowadays, its browser supports AdobeFlash on some pages, but it needs to be installed manually. .
Translation: 然而，与如今许多智能手机不同，其浏览器支持部分网页的Adobe Flash功能，但需要手动安装。

Query_Text_en: The Z10 is capable of using LTE networks , the most consistently speedy available .
Translation: Z10支持使用LTE网络，这是目前可用的最稳定快速的网络。

Query_Text_en: RIM did not explain this abnormal situation .
Translation: RIM未对这一异常情况作出解释。

Query_Text_en: In BB10 , RIM has added a video-chat feature similar to Apple 's FaceTime
Translation: 在BB10系统中，RIM新增了类似于苹果FaceTime的视频通话功能。

Query_Text_en: My test results show that this function is very useful.
Translation: 测试结果显示，该功能具有很高的实用性。

Query_Text_en: Unlike Android or Apple devices , BB10 has no built-in cloud system for syncing or storing photos or other data
Translation: 与Android或苹果设备不同，BB10系统本身没有内置的云系统用于同步或存储照片及其他数据。

Query_Text_en: RIM said that the third-party cloud application Box has an automatic synchronization function. The main users of this program are enterprise users .
Translation: RIM表示，第三方云应用Box具备自动同步功能，其主要用户群体为企业用户。

Query_Text_en: There is no native ability to print from the Z10
Translation: Z10设备本身不具备直接打印的原生功能。

Query_Text_en: And in some cases , I found that common controls required too many steps.
Translation: 在某些情况下，我发现常规管控措施所需步骤过多。

Query_Text_en: For instance, if you want to quickly locate to the top or bottom of a long information list in the Hub, you need to make a selection in the menu, but this was very easy to do on older BlackBerry models.
Translation: 例如，如果你想在中心的长信息列表中快速定位到顶部或底部，需要通过菜单进行选择，但这一操作在旧款黑莓手机上却非常简便。

Query_Text_en: The Z10 and BB10 represent a radical reinvention of the BlackBerry
Translation: Z10和BB10标志着黑莓品牌的彻底革新

Query_Text_en: The hardware is decent and the user interface is logical and generally easy to use.
Translation: 硬件性能不错，用户界面逻辑清晰且总体易于使用。

Query_Text_en: I believe that if the company can attract more applications, this mobile phone has a chance to bring RIM back to the competitive stage .
Translation: 我相信，如果该公司能够吸引更多应用程序，这款手机就有机会帮助RIM重返竞争舞台。

Query_Text_en: The yen 's recent dramatic drop is giving hard-hit corporate Japan its biggest break in years , raising hopes of a long-awaited earnings recovery
Translation: 日元近期的急剧下跌为饱受打击的日本企业界带来了多年来最大的转机，提振了市场对其长期期待的收益复苏的希望。

Query_Text_en: In a first glimpse of the brightening outlook , camera manufacturer Canon Inc. on Wednesday forecast that net profit would rise 14 % in 2013 , after dropping 9.7 % last year .
Translation: 在首次透露出前景改善的迹象时，佳能公司周三预测2013年净利润将增长14%，较去年9.7%的降幅实现回升。

Query_Text_en: In anticipation of the weaker yen 's benefits , investors have bid Canon shares up nearly 40 % since mid-November , when the yen slide started .
Translation: 自11月中旬日元开始贬值以来，投资者鉴于日元贬值带来的利好，已将佳能股价推高近40%。

Query_Text_en: The yen 's depreciation prompted videogame maker Nintendo Co. on Wednesday to double its profit outlook for its full fiscal year even as the company slashed its sales projection .
Translation: 日元贬值促使任天堂公司周三将全财年盈利预期翻倍，尽管该公司同时大幅下调了销售预测。

Query_Text_en: The weaker yen offers a boost to Japanese exporters in several ways .
Translation: 日元贬值通过多种方式为日本出口商带来提振作用。

Query_Text_en: It helps increase earnings made abroad when they are repatriated into yen.
Translation: 有助于提高境外收益在汇回为日元时的所得。

Query_Text_en: A weaker yen also helps lower the price abroad of goods manufactured in Japan and exported  .
Translation: 日元贬值也有助于降低日本制造并出口的商品在国外的价格。

Query_Text_en: The yen 's tumble has been especially beneficial for country 's electronics and automobile sectors , which for years have grumbled about a strong yen sapping profit .
Translation: 日元贬值对日本的电子和汽车行业尤其有利，这两个行业多年来一直抱怨日元走强侵蚀利润。

Query_Text_en: The depreciation of Japan, coupled with the economic stimulus plan implemented by Japanese Prime Minister ShinzoAbe, who took office in December last year, has sparked optimism. The expectation that the performance of Japanese enterprises will be boosted is obvious in the Japanese stock market..
Translation: 日本货币贬值叠加去年12月上任的日本首相安倍晋三推行的经济刺激计划，引发了市场乐观情绪。日本股市已明显反映出企业业绩将得到提振的预期。

Query_Text_en: Electronics makers and auto manufacturers are outperforming the benchmark index  .
Translation: 电子设备制造商和汽车制造商的表现优于基准指数。

Query_Text_en: Shares of Sony Corp. and Panasonic Corp. are up more than 50 % since mid-November .
Translation: 自11月中旬以来，索尼公司和松下公司的股价已上涨超过50%。

Query_Text_en: Panasonic reports earnings Friday , and Sony , next week .
Translation: 松下将于周五公布财报，索尼则会在下周公布。

Query_Text_en: Shares of Toyota Motor Co. , Nissan Motor Co. , and Honda Motor Co. have gained more than 35 % over the same period.
Translation: 丰田、日产和本田三家汽车公司的股票同期涨幅均超过35%。

Query_Text_en: Honda will release its earnings report this Thursday, while Toyota and Nissan will do so next week .
Translation: 本田将于本周四发布财报，而丰田和日产将于下周发布。

Query_Text_en: China's door may have been closed to the social networking company Facebook, but for DSTGlobal, which invested in the company before its listing, it is wide open
Translation: 尽管中国的大门对社交网络公司Facebook可能已经关闭，但对早在该公司上市前就对其进行投资的DST Global而言，大门始终敞开。

Query_Text_en: Unlike some other foreign investors, Digital Sky Global Group is willing to hold minority stakes in the companies it invests in. As a financially strong late-stage investor, it also encounters less competition among China-focused investors when facing new deals. .
Translation: 与其他一些外国投资者不同，数字天空全球集团愿意持有被投企业的少数股权。作为财力雄厚的后期投资者，其在面对新交易时，相较于专注于中国市场的投资者，面临的竞争更少。

Query_Text_en: DST , alongside other private equity firms like Silver Lake agreed to buy shares in Alibaba at a tender offer of $ 1.6 billion in 2011
Translation: 2011年，DST与银湖投资集团等其他私募股权公司达成协议，以16亿美元的要约价格购入阿里巴巴股份。

Query_Text_en: That same year , DST Global also participated in a $ 1.5 billion third round of funding in Jingdong , with media reports stating that DST bought a 5 % share in the online retailer for $ 500 million .
Translation: 同年，DST全球集团还参与了京东第三轮融资，该轮融资规模达15亿美元。媒体报道称，DST集团斥资5亿美元购入该在线零售商5%的股份。

Query_Text_en: Lindfors said that although DSTGlobal invested approximately 1.5 billion US dollars in both of the above transactions, he pointed out that the relatively small overall market size in China often leads to smaller transaction volumes in China. Therefore, the company is also willing to participate in much smaller investments, even 50 million US dollars.
Translation: 林德福表示，尽管DSTGlobal在这两项交易中投资了约15亿美元，但他指出中国整体市场规模相对较小，通常导致交易规模也较为有限。因此，该公司也愿意参与更小规模的投资，甚至金额低至5000万美元。

Query_Text_en: In fact , KPCB China Investment Partner Wei Zhou last year told Venture Capital Dispatch that it had even started investing in pre-Series A deals .
Translation: 事实上，KPCB中国投资合伙人周炜去年在接受《风险投资通讯》采访时曾表示，他们甚至开始投资Pre-A轮融资。

Query_Text_en: Indeed , industry insiders , including Kai Fu Lee , founder of Chinese investment firm Innovation Works , predict China will have 500 million smartphone users by the end of this year , jumping up from the current 330 million .
Translation: 事实上，业内人士，包括创新工场创始人李开复在内，预测到今年年底，中国智能手机用户数量将达到5亿，从目前的3.3亿激增至这一数字。

Query_Text_en: On the other side of the Pacific Ocean , DST Global has invested in the likes of Twitter and now-Nasdaq-listed Facebook which faces restricted use in China and manages three funds .
Translation: 在太平洋的另一边，DST Global投资了包括Twitter在内的企业，现于纳斯达克上市的Facebook（在中国面临使用限制），并管理着三只基金。

Query_Text_en: Last year , Bloomberg reported that DST Global was raising $ 1 billion for a new technology fund , and separately reported that DST Global I achieved an annual 151 % gross internal rate of return .
Translation: 去年，彭博社报道DST Global正在筹集10亿美元用于一只新的科技基金，并另报道DST Global I的年化毛内部收益率达到151%。

Query_Text_en: The Asian headquarters of Digital Sky Global Group is located in Hong Kong. The company was founded by entrepreneur Milner. Its most notable move was investing 200 million US dollars in Facebook in 2009, followed by a joint investment of 500 million US dollars with Goldman Sachs in 2011. .
Translation: 数字天空全球集团的亚洲总部设于香港。该公司由企业家米尔纳创立。其最引人注目的举措是2009年向Facebook投资2亿美元，随后于2011年与高盛集团联合投资5亿美元。

Query_Text_en: About three years ago, LandO'LakesInc., a butter producer in Minnesota Approximately 2,500 employees use BlackBerry mobile phones distributed by the company.
Translation: 大约三年前，明尼苏达州的黄油生产商兰德奥莱克斯公司为大约2500名员工配发了黑莓手机。

Query_Text_en: Today , the number at the Minnesota butter maker is down to 12  .
Translation: 今天，明尼苏达州这家黄油生产商的员工人数已降至12人。

Query_Text_en: Despite this week 's launch of a new BlackBerry , Barry Libenson , the company 's chief information officer , said he is no longer planning on supporting BlackBerrys .
Translation: 尽管本周推出了新款黑莓手机，但该公司首席信息官巴里·利博森表示，他已不再计划继续支持黑莓手机。

Query_Text_en: The ` vast majority ' of his employees prefer a different smartphone , he said , and BlackBerry maker Research In Motion Ltd. 's precarious financial position is a ` concern for us .
Translation: 他表示，他的绝大多数员工更倾向于选择其他品牌的智能手机，而黑莓手机制造商Research In Motion Ltd.（RIM）岌岌可危的财务状况也让我们感到担忧。

Query_Text_en: This reflects the huge challenges that RIM is facing. The company will release details of the latest generation of operating system 'blackberry 10' and two mobile phones equipped with this system on Wednesday. '
Translation: 这反映出RIM公司正面临巨大挑战。该公司将于周三发布最新一代操作系统"黑莓10"的详细信息及两款搭载该系统的手机。

Query_Text_en: In the past, most of RIM's business relied on lucrative deals with enterprises and government agencies. In early 2007, before AppleInc. released its iPhone, the company's customers accounted for 71% of RIM's user base..
Translation: 过去，RIM公司的业务主要依赖与企业及政府机构开展的高利润交易。2007年初苹果公司发布iPhone之前，这些客户的用户数量占RIM用户总量的71%。

Query_Text_en: The BYOD trend accelerated as more employees switched to the iPhonees . .
Translation: 随着越来越多的员工转向iPhone，BYOD趋势加速。

Query_Text_en: A survey early last year from Forrester Research showed that 54 % of more than 1,600 IT decision makers at North American and European companies said they are implementing a BYOD program  .
Translation: Forrester Research去年年初的一项调查显示，北美和欧洲超过1600家公司的IT决策者中，有54%表示他们正在实施BYOD计划。

Query_Text_en: For CIOs , the program is a money saver , allowing the company to forgo the cost of the phone itself.
Translation: 对于首席信息官而言，该计划是一项节省开支的举措，使企业能够省去手机本身的费用。

Query_Text_en: A bevy of companies now offer easy-to-use , secure software that allows CIOs to manage a number of different smartphones at once.
Translation: 目前，众多企业推出了操作简便且安全的软件，帮助首席信息官（CIO）同时管理多种不同智能手机。

Query_Text_en: For RIM , the trend is forcing the Canadian company to compete more squarely with market leaders Apple and Samsung Electronics Co. for the consumer , a daunting task considering RIM 's global market share is just 4.6 % , according to IDC.
Translation: 对于RIM而言，这一趋势迫使这家加拿大公司不得不与苹果和三星电子等市场领头羊在消费者市场展开更直接的竞争。而根据IDC的数据，RIM的全球市场份额仅有4.6%，这无疑是一项艰巨的任务。

Query_Text_en: The enterprise exodus is also pinching RIM 's profits as corporate customers are far more lucrative than consumers ..
Translation: 企业客户的大量流失也挤压了RIM的利润，因为企业客户比普通消费者更具利润贡献。

Query_Text_en: Analysts estimate that service fees from businesses net RIM $ 7 to $ 10 a month per user , compared with $ 1 to $ 4 for consumers
Translation: 分析师估计，来自企业的服务费每月每用户为RIM带来7至10美元收入，相比之下，消费者用户仅为1至4美元。

Query_Text_en: While RIM is still sitting on plenty of cash , its ailing financial health is also worrying some CIOs.
Translation: 虽然RIM仍拥有大量现金储备，但其财务状况不佳也让部分CIO感到担忧。

Query_Text_en: In the latest fiscal third quarter , RIM 's profit fell to $ 9 million from $ 265 million , and the number of global BlackBerry subscribers fell for the first time , by 1 million , to 79 million.
Translation: 在最近的第三财季，RIM公司利润从2.65亿美元骤降至900万美元，黑莓全球用户数量也首次出现下降，减少了100万至7900万。

Query_Text_en: Last year , RIM engaged bankers to study strategic alternatives .
Translation: 去年，RIM委托投行顾问研究战略选项。

Query_Text_en: The financial uncertainty has some CIOs weighing whether or not to stick with BlackBerry for the long haul , or start making contingency plans .
Translation: 金融不确定性迫使部分CIO开始权衡是否继续长期使用黑莓，或是启动应急计划。

Query_Text_en: Many RIM investors still believe that the two upcoming blackberry phones (the first new products launched in about a year and a half) will help reverse RIM's unsatisfactory situation in the past two years. During this period, the company was hit by delays in product launches, network disconnections, a decline in sales, and a shrinking market share..
Translation: 许多RIM投资者仍相信即将推出的两款黑莓手机（这是该公司约一年半以来首次推出的新产品）将有助于扭转RIM过去两年间的不利局面。在此期间，公司遭遇了产品发布延迟、网络服务中断、销量下滑及市场份额萎缩等问题。

Query_Text_en: Several once-bearish analysts have jumped on the back of the share-price rally , raising their ratings and price targets  .
Translation: 此前持看跌观点的分析师纷纷借着股价上涨的东风，上调了评级和目标价。

Query_Text_en: But the turnaround is dependent on winning back corporate clients , particularly in security-minded professions like law , banking and government , which RIM counts as its most loyal.
Translation: 但这一复苏取决于能否重新赢回企业客户，尤其是法律、银行和政府部门等注重安全的职业领域客户，这些领域一直是RIM最忠实的客户群体。

Query_Text_en: A parade of big corporations and government agencies has already dumped RIM , including Yahoo Inc. , Halliburton Co. and the U.S. Bureau of Alcohol , Tobacco , Firearms and Explosives  .
Translation: 包括雅虎公司、哈利伯顿公司以及美国酒精、烟草、火器及爆炸物管理局在内的一系列大型企业和政府部门已弃用RIM。

Query_Text_en: RIM has responded by offering incentives aimed at getting CIOs to give BlackBerry 10 a try , including free software upgrades for the new operating system , a free phone for customers ' IT departments and training to IT departments to help ensure a smooth transition .
Translation: RIM为此推出了旨在鼓励首席信息官尝试BlackBerry 10的激励措施，包括为新操作系统提供免费软件升级、向客户信息技术部门赠送免费手机，并为信息技术部门提供培训以确保顺利过渡。

Query_Text_en: RIM also rolled out its upgraded phone-management software earlier this month , which now allows companies to manage BlackBerrys and other smartphones
Translation: 本月早些时候，RIM公司还推出了其升级版手机管理软件，该软件现允许企业管理和黑莓以及其他品牌的智能手机。

Query_Text_en: ` We want to bring some sanity to this BYOD phenomenon that many -LSB- companies -RSB- are struggling with , ' said Paul Devenyi , a senior vice president at RIM .
Translation: 我们希望为许多企业正在努力应对的BYOD现象注入一些理性，"RIM公司高级副总裁保罗·德文伊表示。

Query_Text_en: ` We have no doubt that -LSB- CIOs -RSB- are evaluating a number of other options , but they 're thrilled to see that RIM is in this multiplatform solutions game with both feet . ' .
Translation: 我们毫不怀疑，首席信息官们正在评估其他多种选择，但他们欣喜地看到黑莓公司已全面投入多平台解决方案领域。

Query_Text_en: RIM has also acknowledged it may change its service-fee structure
Translation: RIM也确认可能调整其服务费结构。

Query_Text_en: During a conference call with analysts in December , RIM CEO Thorsten Heins said the company 's service fees would come under pressure as RIM introduced a new , tiered ` menu ' offering .
Translation: 在12月与分析师举行的电话会议上，RIM首席执行官托斯腾·海因斯表示，随着公司推出新的分层菜单式服务套餐，其服务费将面临压力。

Query_Text_en: `Service revenues are not going away , but our business model and service offerings are going to evolve.
Translation: 服务收入不会消失，但我们的商业模式和服务产品将不断演进。

Query_Text_en: To be sure , RIM 's proprietary network is still seen as more secure and more robust than many carriers ' networks despite high-profile outages in late 2011 .  , ' Mr. Heins said .
Translation: 当然，尽管2011年底发生了备受关注的中断事件，RIM的专有网络仍被认为比许多运营商网络更加安全可靠。黑莓公司高管海因斯表示。

Query_Text_en: Many companies also hope to avoid - or postpone - the possible troubles that might arise from a full-scale switch to another type of smartphone
Translation: 许多企业也希望能避免（或推迟）全面转向另一种智能手机可能引发的潜在问题。

Query_Text_en: In recent weeks , the new OS has garnered positive reviews , including from many partners and developers who have worked with a prototype of the device
Translation: 近几周来，这款新操作系统获得了积极评价，包括众多与该设备原型进行过合作的合作伙伴和开发者的认可。

Query_Text_en: Several big carriers including Verizon Wireless and Sprint Nextel Corp. have said they would support the launch.
Translation: 包括威瑞森无线公司（Verizon Wireless）和斯普林特-纽纪惮公司（Sprint Nextel Corp.）在内的多家大型运营商已表示将支持该计划的推出。

Query_Text_en: After initially saying it would dump its BlackBerrys for Apple iPhones , the U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement said it would partner with RIM on a trial run of the BlackBerry 10 .
Translation: 美国移民和海关执法局最初表示将弃用黑莓手机改用苹果iPhone，但随后表示将与RIM合作开展BlackBerry 10的试运行项目。

Query_Text_en: RIM has said it has more than 1 million government customers in North America  .
Translation: RIM表示，其在北美地区拥有超过100万政府客户。

Query_Text_en: Still , the competition among smartphone makers for corporate customers has ratcheted up , sharpening the BYOD threat.
Translation: 不过，智能手机制造商之间争夺企业客户的竞争日趋激烈，进一步加剧了BYOD办公模式的威胁。

Query_Text_en: Apple and Nokia Corp. , after fears of concentrating on consumer tastes , have targeted business clients in recent years . .
Translation: 苹果公司和诺基亚公司鉴于对过于专注于消费者偏好的担忧，近年来将目标转向了企业客户。

Query_Text_en: Samsung aired a 45-second ad during two National Football League playoff games earlier this month , promoting its phones as corporation-friendly and poking fun directly at the BlackBerry
Translation: 本月早些时候，三星在两场国家橄榄球联盟（NFL）季后赛期间投放了一则45秒的广告，宣传其手机面向企业用户，并直接调侃黑莓手机。

Query_Text_en: Meanwhile, MobileIronInc., AirWatchLLC and GoodTechnologyInc. These new types of 'mobile management experts' have also launched their own services, and there have always been customers signing up..
Translation: 与此同时，MobileIron公司、AirWatch公司和GoodTechnology公司等新型"移动管理专家"也推出了各自的专属服务，一直有客户持续签约。

Query_Text_en: On the face of it , Laos is a no man 's land for foreign investors
Translation: 表面上看，老挝对外资而言是一片无人问津之地。

Query_Text_en: This landlocked , Southeast Asian nation of 6.5 million people offers a tiny market .
Translation: 这个拥有650万人口的东南亚内陆国家仅有狭小的市场。

Query_Text_en: Experts say corruption is widespread  .
Translation: 专家指出，腐败现象普遍存在。

Query_Text_en: And some foreigners say they have been burned when deals in the country unraveled.
Translation: 一些外籍人士表示，当该国的交易破裂时他们蒙受了损失。

Query_Text_en: Yet investment is pouring in .
Translation: 然而，投资仍在持续涌入。

Query_Text_en: Foreign direct investment rose more than 40 % in each of the past two years , largely as neighboring countries jostled for work in the resource and hydropower sectors .
Translation: 过去两年，外国直接投资均增长超过40%，主要由于周边国家竞相争取在资源和水电领域的项目机会。

Query_Text_en: Chinese companies increasingly are breaking ground on real-estate projects , and Western companies including Coca-Cola Co. and French lens maker Essilor International SA also are stepping in.
Translation: 越来越多的中国企业正在启动房地产项目，包括可口可乐公司和法国依视路国际在内的西方企业也纷纷加入。

Query_Text_en: The World Bank predicted that Laos would post a record trade deficit of $ 1.3 billion for last year .
Translation: 世界银行预测老挝去年的贸易赤字将创下13亿美元的历史新高。

Query_Text_en: The gap would largely stem from imports related to foreign investments , such as fuel , vehicles and construction materials.
Translation: 这一缺口主要源于与外商投资相关的进口商品，例如燃料、车辆和建筑材料。

Query_Text_en: The Laotian economy remains small compared with those of neighboring Thailand , Vietnam and Myanmar .
Translation: 老挝经济与邻国泰国、越南和缅甸相比仍然较小。

Query_Text_en: And foreign direct investment first topped the billion-dollar mark only last year  .
Translation: 外商直接投资直到去年才首次突破十亿美元大关。

Query_Text_en: But Laos hopes to attract $ 8 billion in investment from 2011 to 2015 , the vast majority of it from foreign investors , to keep its economy expanding around 8 % a year.
Translation: 但老挝希望在2011年至2015年间吸引80亿美元投资，其中绝大部分来自外国投资者，以保持经济年均增长约8%。

Query_Text_en: For Laos, a country with an annual economic output of only 9 billion US dollars, the injection of foreign capital will be an important link to achieve the government's plan to further develop the nascent domestic industry and lift Laos out of its status as one of the 48 least developed countries in the world by 2020 .
Translation: 对于年经济总量仅有90亿美元的老挝而言，外资注入将成为实现政府计划的重要环节——该计划旨在进一步发展国内新兴产业，并在2020年前使老挝摆脱世界上最不发达国家之一的地位。

Query_Text_en: Laos might not be as interesting as a Vietnam or Thailand , but it 's growing , and it provides steady revenue , ' says Chris Manley , the Laos manager for RMA Lao , the largest U.S. company operating in Laos .
Translation: “老挝可能不如越南或泰国那样具有投资吸引力，但它正在快速发展，并能带来稳定的收入，”RMA老挝公司老挝业务经理克里斯·曼利表示。RMA老挝公司是美国在老挝运营的最大企业。

Query_Text_en: `The company , which distributes Fords , Land Rovers , John Deere tractors and heavy trucks and equipment , is building showrooms and expanding others to meet a car boom in the capital of Vientiane and in smaller cities   .
Translation: 该公司负责分销福特、路虎、约翰迪尔拖拉机及重型卡车和设备，目前正在新建展厅并扩建其他展厅，以应对首都万象及周边中小城市汽车销售热潮。

Query_Text_en: Part of the appeal for foreign companies lies in establishing a footprint in the region as Southeast Asian nations prepare to form the Asean Economic Community in 2015.
Translation: 外资企业之所以被吸引，部分原因在于它们希望在东南亚各国准备于2015年组建东盟经济共同体之际，抢先在该地区布局。

Query_Text_en: The bloc will bring together nearly 10 % of the world 's population into a shared economy of more than $ 2 trillion.
Translation: 该经济区块将涵盖近十分之一的世界人口，形成超过2万亿美元的共同经济总量。

Query_Text_en: Coca-Cola in late November announced plans to build the U.S. company 's first bottling plant in Laos .
Translation: 美国可口可乐公司于十一月下旬宣布计划在老挝建设该公司首个灌装厂。

Query_Text_en: Citing the country 's entry into the World Trade Organization next month ` and the beginning of the integration of the country into the global economy , we see opportunities for growth in this market , ' the U.S.-based company says.
Translation: 鉴于该国将于下月正式加入世界贸易组织并启动融入全球经济进程，我们在此市场看到了增长机遇，"这家美国企业表示。

Query_Text_en: Malayan Banking Bhd. in November opened its first Laotian branch , in Vientiane .
Translation: 马来亚银行Bhd.于11月在万象开设了其首家老挝分行。

Query_Text_en: And Essilor , which makes eyeglass lenses , will build a plant this year in the southwestern province of Savannakhet , the company 's first in the region beyond Thailand  .
Translation: 生产眼镜镜片的依视路公司今年将在老挝西南部的沙湾拿吉省建设工厂，这是该公司在泰国以外该地区的首个工厂。

Query_Text_en: China CAMC Engineering Co. is working on Vientiane 's new convention center , which is expected to be completed by November , and is a year into a $ 600 million plan to reshape Vientiane 's waterfront over the next six years or so .
Translation: 中国 CAMC 工程公司正在推进万象新会展中心项目，预计将于11月完工，并已实施为期约六年、总额6亿美元的万象滨水区改造计划一年。

Query_Text_en: The state-owned company long has played a construction role in Laos , a country with only a handful of buildings higher than five stories.
Translation: 这家国有企业长期在仅有少数建筑超过五层的老挝发挥着建设作用。

Query_Text_en: Mall developer Shanghai Wanfeng Group last month broke ground in the capital on what the company said would be a $ 1.6 billion commercial and residential development-Shanghai Wanfeng 's first major foray outside China.
Translation: 上海万丰集团上月在首都启动了一个名为"上海万丰"的16亿美元商业住宅综合开发项目，这是该公司首次重大海外拓展。

Query_Text_en: And Malaysia 's Giant Consolidated Ltd. recently signed a contract to fund a $ 5 billion railway line connecting Vietnam to southern Laos , a country that is essentially barren of track today .
Translation: 马来西亚的Giant Consolidated有限公司近日签署了一项价值50亿美元的合同，资助建设连接越南与老挝南部的铁路项目。老挝目前几乎没有任何铁路网络。

Query_Text_en: But whether these investors have moved too quickly remains a question  .
Translation: 但这些投资者是否行动过于迅速，仍是一个问题。

Query_Text_en: The U.S. State Department has warned that commercial law remains untested here .
Translation: 美国国务院警告称，此处的商业法律尚未经过实践检验。

Query_Text_en: In a report this month, risk assessment firm Maplecroft said that weak rule of law and frequent government interference will continue to put foreign enterprises at risk of arbitrary legal action.
Translation: 本月，风险评估机构Maplecroft发布的一份报告显示，薄弱的法治环境和频繁的政府干预将继续使外国企业面临任意法律诉讼的风险。

Query_Text_en: People love conspiracy theories .
Translation: 人们热衷于阴谋论。

Query_Text_en: One in particular has been doing the rounds in FX land for months , with no sign of fizzling out .
Translation: 其中有一个话题在外汇市场持续流传数月，且没有消退迹象。

Query_Text_en: Right now , it 's having a mini revival .
Translation: 目前，它正经历一轮小幅复苏。

Query_Text_en: China is buying euros in a deliberate effort to stop the yuan from rising too far .
Translation: 中国正通过购入欧元来有意抑制人民币过快升值。

Query_Text_en: Sure , it 's keeping Washington sweet by letting the yuan climb against the dollar .
Translation: 当然，此举通过允许人民币对美元升值来安抚华盛顿。

Query_Text_en: But it 's bashing the buck hard by buying euros , keeping the yuan relatively weak on a trade-weighted basis .
Translation: 但通过大量购入欧元来大幅打压美元，使得人民币在贸易加权基础上保持相对弱势。

Query_Text_en: The analysts at BNP Paribas are keen on this idea right now .
Translation: 目前，法国巴黎银行的分析师对这一提议表现出浓厚兴趣。

Query_Text_en: ` China fixes -LSB- the dollar -RSB- lower -LSB- against the yuan -RSB- trying to hold increasing commodity import price pressure at the border , ' the bank 's currencies analysts said Monday in a note to clients .
Translation: 中国将美元兑人民币汇率调低，试图缓解进口环节不断上升的商品价格压力，该行货币分析师周一在一份致客户报告中表示。

Query_Text_en: Translation : commodities prices are rising , so China is letting the yuan climb , to make those imports cheaper .
Translation: 大宗商品价格上涨，因此中国正允许人民币升值以降低进口成本。

Query_Text_en: But , the bank continues : ` China seems to be not yet ready accepting general yuan strength , suggesting that the People 's Bank of China reserve managers will remain on the euro bid . '
Translation: 但该银行进一步指出："中国似乎尚未准备好接受人民币全面走强，表明中国人民银行储备管理部门将继续买入欧元。"

Query_Text_en: Again , a translation for those uninitiated in the dark art of reading currencies research : China still wants to keep the yuan generally weak , so it will keep on buying euros .
Translation: 再次为那些不熟悉货币研究深奥晦涩的人士做一解读：中国仍希望保持人民币汇率总体弱势，因此将继续购入欧元。

Query_Text_en: Now that the grand G-7 coordinated intervention on the yen has taken place , China ca n't very easily buy Japanese yen to help keep the yuan under pressure , so this euro buying is likely to accelerate , the French bank added .
Translation: 由于七国集团（G7）已实施大规模协调干预日元的行动，中国难以通过购买日元来缓解人民币升值压力，因此法国银行预计欧元购买行为可能加速。

Query_Text_en: This may or may not be true .
Translation: 此说法可能属实，也可能并非如此。

Query_Text_en: It 's close to impossible to tell for sure , although it chimes with persistent trading-floor chatter .
Translation: 要确定这一点几乎不可能，尽管这与交易大厅长期存在的议论不谋而合。

Query_Text_en: Whenever the euro runs higher against the buck , with no obvious trigger , traders blame China .
Translation: 每当欧元对美元升值且缺乏明显诱因时，交易员们都会将责任归咎于中国。

Query_Text_en: Many market watchers are nonplussed by this idea , pointing out that there 's a good number of other reasons for the euro to be strong against the dollar right now , despite the long-running European debt crisis .
Translation: 许多市场观察者对这一观点感到困惑，指出尽管欧洲债务危机长期持续，当前欧元兑美元走强仍有大量其他原因。

Query_Text_en: After all , European Central Bank interest rates are set to rise within three weeks .
Translation: 毕竟，欧洲央行的利率预计将在三周内上调。

Query_Text_en: We 'll be lucky if the Fed does the same this year .
Translation: 若美联储今年也采取同样举措，那将是非常幸运的。

Query_Text_en: To be fair , BNP Paribas does n't think this is the only reason for euro strength , either .
Translation: 客观而言，法国巴黎银行也不认为这是欧元走强的唯一原因。

Query_Text_en: But if it is true , it goes some way towards solving one of the biggest riddles in the market : the curious case of the weak dollar .
Translation: 但若这一情况属实，它在一定程度上将有助于解决市场上的一个最大谜团——美元疲软的典型案例。

Query_Text_en: With investors ' worry lists running into at least two pages , it 's weird that the dollar -- usually a safe retreat in times of stress -- is not significantly stronger .
Translation: 投资者担忧清单已拉至至少两页长，但美元——通常在市场动荡时期充当避险之选——眼下并未显著走强，这一现象显得颇为反常。

Query_Text_en: Pinning this on China may be misguided .
Translation: 将此归咎于中国可能有失偏颇。

Query_Text_en: But the euro 's resilience is somewhat odd .
Translation: 但欧元展现出的韧性略显异常。

Query_Text_en: And two plus two makes at least five in the currencies markets .
Translation: 在货币市场中，二加二至少会被算作五。

Query_Text_en: Nanjing is no Bretton Woods .
Translation: 南京并非布雷顿森林体系。

Query_Text_en: A meeting in China 's former capital , called at the behest of France , was meant to bring together G-20 leaders to put the international monetary system to rights .
Translation: 应法国要求召开的、在中国前首都举行的会议，旨在召集二十国集团领导人共同整顿国际货币体系。

Query_Text_en: The French perhaps thought they had common cause with China against the dominant role of the dollar in the international financial system .
Translation: 法国方面或许认为，他们与中国在反对美元在国际金融体系中的主导地位方面存在共同利益。

Query_Text_en: But if so , they thought wrong .
Translation: 但若如此，他们的判断便是错误的。

Query_Text_en: Given that China holds $ 1.6 trillion in dollar debt , calling an end to the dollar 's reign would hardly shore up the value of its investment .
Translation: 鉴于中国持有1.6万亿美元的美元债务，宣告结束美元的主导地位几乎不会提振其投资的价值。

Query_Text_en: So Thursday 's gathering was relegated from a leaders ' summit in Beijing to a ministerial meeting in Nanjing . With a sprinkling of academics thrown in and discussion limited to a single day , the chances of any breakthrough results look small .
Translation: 周四的会议从原定的北京领导人峰会降级为南京部长级会议，并掺杂少量学者参与，且讨论仅限一天时间，因此取得突破性成果的可能性看来很小。

Query_Text_en: In the absence of clear political will , contenders for the heavyweight reserve-currency crown will have to slug it out on their own merits .
Translation: 在缺乏明确的政治意愿情况下，角逐主要储备货币地位的竞争者将不得不依靠自身实力展开较量。

Query_Text_en: The reigning champion , weighing in at 61 % of global reserves , is the dollar .
Translation: 美元是全球储备中的主导货币，占比达61%。

Query_Text_en: With the world 's largest economy , deep and liquid capital markets , and the benefit of incumbency , the dollar packs a powerful punch .
Translation: 得益于全球最大经济体的地位、深度和流动性强的资本市场以及既有地位带来的优势，美元具有强大的影响力。

Query_Text_en: But after a long time at the top , it is also looking a little flabby .
Translation: 但长期位居榜首后，它也显得有些松懈。

Query_Text_en: The greenback 's dominance means other countries have little choice but to hold their reserves in dollars .
Translation: 美元的主导地位使得其他国家不得不以美元形式持有储备。

Query_Text_en: That let the U.S. live beyond its means in the buildup to the crisis , and finance a response with foreign capital .
Translation: 这使得美国在危机前得以寅吃卯粮，并借助外资来筹措应对危机的资金。

Query_Text_en: With a falling dollar now eroding the value of its debt , abuse of that privilege has won the U.S. few friends among its creditors .
Translation: 由于美元贬值正在侵蚀其债务价值，滥用这一特权使得美国在债权人中几乎没有赢得支持。

Query_Text_en: But contenders for the dollar 's crown are n't yet at their fighting weight .
Translation: 但觊觎美元王冠的竞争者们目前实力尚不足以全面抗衡。

Query_Text_en: The euro , with 26 % of global reserves , is the leading challenger .
Translation: 欧元以占全球储备26%的份额成为主要挑战者。

Query_Text_en: But with its own debt problems , no proven mechanism for ensuring fiscal restraint among its members and no integrated financial market , the euro zone could be an even more irresponsible steward of the global financial system than the U.S.
Translation: 由于自身存在债务问题、缺乏在成员国之间确保财政约束的有效机制，加之金融市场尚未实现一体化，欧元区可能成为比美国更加不负责任的全球金融体系管理者。

Query_Text_en: That leaves China .
Translation: 这便落在了中国身上。

Query_Text_en: Progress toward an international role for the yuan has been rapid .
Translation: 人民币在国际角色方面取得的进展迅速。

Query_Text_en: In 2010 , $ 76 billion in trade transactions were settled in yuan , up from less than $ 1 billion in 2009 .
Translation: 2010年，以人民币结算的贸易交易额达760亿美元，较2009年的不足10亿美元显著增长。

Query_Text_en: But there is a big difference between a trade-settlement currency and a reserve currency .
Translation: 但贸易结算货币与储备货币之间存在显著区别。

Query_Text_en: As the world 's biggest exporter , there is no reason why China ca n't demand payment in yuan for its goods .
Translation: 作为全球最大的货物出口国，中国没有理由不能要求以人民币结算其商品贸易。

Query_Text_en: But with a closed capital account and continued control over the exchange rate , there is little prospect that it will be able to establish the yuan as a reserve currency .
Translation: 但由于资本账户未开放且继续实施汇率管制，人民币要成为储备货币的前景渺茫。

Query_Text_en: The dollar might not be in fighting shape , but with the other contenders still in the featherweight division , it will be a while before the U.S. has to surrender the reserve-currency crown .
Translation: 美元可能已不在巅峰状态，但由于其他竞争者尚属轻量级，美国仍可保有储备货币之冠一段时间。

Query_Text_en: As fears grow about a potential nationalization of Tokyo Electric Power Co. , concern is mounting over some of Japan 's leading institutions that have a high level of exposure to the troubled utility .
Translation: 随着东京电力公司可能被国有化的担忧加剧，日本一些主要机构因对这家陷入困境的电力公司存在大量曝险，其风险也引发越来越多的关注。

Query_Text_en: Toshihiro Uomoto , chief credit strategist at Nomura Securities , said bondholders could book mark-to-market losses if talks over nationalizing Tepco do indeed transpire and drag on .
Translation: 野村证券首席信贷策略师上本敏广表示，如果东京电力公司的国有化谈判确实展开并久拖不决，债券持有者可能面临市值重估带来的账面亏损。

Query_Text_en: Equity investors are the ones who would take the biggest hit if Tepco is effectively nationalized .
Translation: 如果东京电力公司事实上被国有化的话，股权投资者将是遭受最大损失的一方。

Query_Text_en: Dai-Ichi Life Insurance Co. , Nippon Life Insurance Co. , the Tokyo Metropolitan Government , Sumitomo Mitsui Financial Group Inc. and Mizuho Financial Group Inc. are among its top shareholders
Translation: 其主要股东包括第一生命保险公司、日本生命保险公司、东京都政府、三井住友金融集团和瑞穗金融集团。

Query_Text_en: ` It 's very unlikely we 'll reduce our exposure to Tepco as we do n't think the government nationalizing Tepco is a main scenario , ' one banker said , adding that the lender holds Tepco equity and debt .
Translation: “我们不太可能减少对东京电力公司的风险敞口，因为我们认为政府国有化东京电力公司并非主要情景，”一位银行人士表示，并补充称该机构持有东京电力公司的股权和债务。

Query_Text_en: ` It 's obviously different from the case of Japan Airlines , ' the person said .
Translation: “这显然与日航案例不同，”该人士表示。

Query_Text_en: The worst-case scenario for shareholders and lenders is that Tepco files for bankruptcy protection , as Japan Airlines did last year , though analysts think there is a very low probability of that .
Translation: 最糟糕的情况是东京电力公司申请破产保护，如同日本航空公司去年所做的那样，不过分析师认为这种情况发生的概率极低。

Query_Text_en: JAL shareholders , bondholders and lenders booked hefty losses .
Translation: 日航的股东、债券持有者和贷款方蒙受了巨额损失。

Query_Text_en: Hiroki Shibata , analyst at Standard & Poors , said , ` We 're cautiously watching the recent move -LSB- of Tepco -RSB- in the markets , but we also try to see more fundamental parts of the company in terms of credibility and importance of the company , ' He added that Tepco does n't really have a competitor , which makes a difference from the JAL case .
Translation: 标准普尔分析师柴田浩树表示："我们正谨慎关注东京电力公司在市场上的近期动向，但我们也在努力从公司的可信度和重要性等根本层面审视其业务。"他补充称，东京电力公司实际上并无真正竞争对手，这与日航的情况有所不同。

Query_Text_en: Some see this as a possible buying opportunity for Tepco shares .
Translation: 一些人认为，这可能为东京电力的股票提供了买入机会。

Query_Text_en: ` Tepco seems to be the epitome of the cultural issue of investing in Japan , ' said Lorne Steinberg , president of Canadian asset manager Steinberg Wealth , noting the speed with which the troubled utility 's lenders offered a loan package valued at some $ 25 billion last week . ` At current price levels we are looking at Tepco shares .
Translation: 加拿大资产管理公司Steinberg Wealth总裁洛恩·斯坦伯格表示："东京电力公司似乎已成为日本投资环境文化特性的典型代表。"他指出，该公司债权人上周迅速为其提供了约250亿美元的贷款包。当前股价水平下，我们正在关注东京电力公司的股票。

Query_Text_en: It 's an important company in the framework of Japan Inc. , and virtually everybody has a strong stake in its success . '
Translation: 该公司是日本企业界的重要一员，其成功几乎关系到所有人的重大利益。

Query_Text_en: The U.S. military intervention in Libya has cost the government about $ 550 million so far , with much of the price tag coming from munitions such as Tomahawk missiles , the Pentagon said Tuesday .
Translation: 美国国防部周二表示，美国在利比亚的军事干预迄今已耗资政府约5.5亿美元，其中大部分开支来自战斧导弹等弹药。

Query_Text_en: Costs will continue to build up , though at a smaller rate as the U.S. takes on a more supporting role .
Translation: 尽管美国转为承担更多支持性角色，但成本将持续增加，增速将有所放缓。

Query_Text_en: ` Future costs are highly uncertain , ' said Cmdr. Kathleen Kesler , a Pentagon spokeswoman .
Translation: “未来成本存在高度不确定性，”五角大楼女发言人、指挥官凯瑟琳·凯斯勒表示。

Query_Text_en: She said over the next several weeks , as the U.S. takes a back seat and the North Atlantic Treaty Organization leads operations against Col. Moammar Gadhafi , the price tag will likely be an additional $ 40 million .
Translation: 未来几周内，随着美国退居次要地位、北大西洋公约组织领导对卡扎菲上校的军事行动，相关费用预计将额外增加4000万美元。

Query_Text_en: The figures represent the first assessment by the government of the costs of action in Libya , and may help settle concerns from Congress about whether the conflict will thwart efforts to trim the federal budget .
Translation: 这些数据是政府对在利比亚采取军事行动成本的首次评估，有助于消除国会关于这场冲突是否会阻碍削减联邦预算努力的担忧。

Query_Text_en: Nongovernmental groups have estimated U.S. involvement would top $ 1 billion in costs .
Translation: 非政府组织估算，美国的参与成本将超过10亿美元。

Query_Text_en: The government 's assessment does n't include the cost of the F-15E Strike Eagle fighter that crashed in Libya last week .
Translation: 政府的评估未包含上周在利比亚坠毁的F-15E"攻击鹰"战斗机的相关费用。

Query_Text_en: The Obama administration has insisted U.S. intervention in Libya would be limited and would n't require additional funds from Congress .
Translation: 奥巴马政府一再强调，美国对利比亚的军事干预将是有限的，且不会需要国会追加资金。

Query_Text_en: Instead , the administration has said , the government has built-in contingency funds for just these type of unexpected operations .
Translation: 政府方面表示，已预留了专门用于此类意外行动的应急资金。

Query_Text_en: It 's unclear how much contingency funding the government has left .
Translation: 政府剩余的应急资金数额尚不明确。

Query_Text_en: A Pentagon spokesman was n't immediately available to comment .
Translation: 五角大楼发言人未立即发表评论。

Query_Text_en: President Barack Obama , in a speech on Monday justifying the use of force in Libya , largely left the cost component unanswered .
Translation: 美国总统巴拉克·奥巴马在周一发表的演讲中为在利比亚使用武力进行辩护，但对成本问题大多未予回应。

Query_Text_en: Lawmakers have questioned how long the U.S. would remain involved in the conflict amid fears a protracted U.S. presence would cost a significant amount at a time when Congress is trying to trim the budget .
Translation: 在国会试图削减预算之际，议员们对美国将在这场冲突中保持多久的参与提出了质疑，担忧美国长期驻军可能耗费巨额资金。

Query_Text_en: While Mr. Obama has said Col. Gadhafi should step aside , the U.S. operation in Libya is n't aimed at ousting him .
Translation: 虽然奥巴马先生表示卡扎菲上校应该下台，但美国在利比亚的军事行动并非旨在推翻他。

Query_Text_en: Mr. Obama suggested cost played a factor in not seeking his ouster through U.S. military force .
Translation: 奥巴马暗示，成本是未通过美国军事力量实现其罢免的一个因素。

Query_Text_en: ` To be blunt , we went down that road in Iraq , ' he said , referring to the Iraq war . ` Regime change there took eight years , thousands of American and Iraqi lives , and nearly a trillion dollars . That is not something we can afford to repeat in Libya . '
Translation: 直说吧，我们在伊拉克走上了那条道路，他指的是伊拉克战争。政权更迭在那里耗费了八年时间、成千上万的美伊两国生命以及近万亿美元。这种代价是我们承担不起在利比亚重蹈覆辙的。

Query_Text_en: While American billionaires Warren Buffett and Bill Gates are in India trying to persuade the country 's rich to give their money away , another group of businessmen is here to get them to spend it on themselves .
Translation: 当美国亿万富翁巴菲特和比尔·盖茨正在印度试图说服该国富豪捐赠财富时，另一群商人却来到此处游说他们将钱投资给自己。

Query_Text_en: A team of Italian entrepreneurs who work in the luxury sector are in Mumbai for a two-day conference to talk luxury and business
Translation: 意大利奢侈品行业的一支企业家团队正在孟买参加为期两天的会议，就奢侈品与商业发展展开交流。

Query_Text_en: It 's no big surprise that the luxury industry is eyeing markets like India : It 's estimated that in less than five years emerging markets will make up 50 % of luxury sales globally .
Translation: 奢侈品行业瞄准印度等市场并不令人意外：据估算，不到五年时间，新兴市场将占全球奢侈品销售额的50%。

Query_Text_en: The industry realized just how important these markets are during the global economic downturna ` prompting commentators to say it was ` saved by the BRICs , ' referring to the top emerging markets of Brazil , Russia , India and China .
Translation: 该行业在全球经济衰退期间深刻认识到这些市场的重要性，促使评论人士称其"得救于金砖四国"，即巴西、俄罗斯、印度和中国这四个主要新兴市场。

Query_Text_en: Or rather , the BRICs minus the ` I. '
Translation: 或者说，不包括印度的金砖国家（BRIC）。

Query_Text_en: For a country that boasts the world 's second-fastest growing major economy , India 's international luxury goods market is still surprisingly small .
Translation: 作为拥有全球增长第二快的主要经济体的国家，印度的国际奢侈品市场却依然相对较小。

Query_Text_en: Here , it has failed to take off in the same way it has in countries like Chinaa ` where it has done spectacularly .
Translation: 在这里，它未能像在中国等国家那样取得显著发展，这些国家在该领域表现尤为突出。

Query_Text_en: In a speech prepared for the conference on Friday , Santo Versace , co-chief executive of fashion house Gianni Versace SpA and chairman of Italian luxury trade lobby Fondazione Altagamma , likened the Indian luxury market to a ` sprinter at the starting line , but with feet bound by heavy chains . '
Translation: 在周五准备的会议上发表的一篇演讲中，Gianni Versace集团联合首席执行官兼意大利奢侈品协会Fondazione Altagamma主席桑托·韦尔萨切将印度奢侈品市场比作"起跑线上的短跑运动员，但双脚却被沉重的锁链束缚"。

Query_Text_en: While China makes up an estimated 10 % of the global luxury market , India accounts for less than 1 % , or a market worth around $ 1.3 billion , according to data provided by Altagamma , which brought the delegation of businessmen to Mumbai .
Translation: 根据阿尔塔伽玛（Altagamma）提供的数据，中国约占全球奢侈品市场的10%，而印度占比不足1%，约合13亿美元的市场规模。该机构曾组织商界代表团前往孟买。

Query_Text_en: On the supply side , the gap between the two Asian giants is also vast : of the world 's leading 500 global luxury brands , only around 30 % have an Indian presence , compared to China 's 70 % , according to Altagamma .
Translation: 在供给侧，两大亚洲经济体之间的差距同样显著：根据Altagamma的数据，全球前500大奢侈品牌中，仅有约30%在印度设有业务，而中国的这一比例达到70%。

Query_Text_en: The comparison between China and India is startlinga ` and one which Italy 's luxury team wants Indian policymakers to take note of .
Translation: 中国与印度之间的比较发人深省，而这正是意大利奢侈品行业团队希望印度政策制定者能够注意到的。

Query_Text_en: The issue is not the lack of potential demand , said Altagamma Executive Director Armando Branchini . -LRB- Other participants include top representatives from leather goods maker Salvatore Ferragamo SpA , jewelry-maker Pomellato SpA , and interior design firm Alessi Spa .
Translation: 阿尔塔伽玛执行董事阿尔曼多·布兰奇尼表示，问题并非潜在需求的缺乏。其他与会代表包括意大利皮具制造商萨尔瓦托雷·菲拉格慕股份公司、珠宝商宝梅拉托股份公司以及室内设计公司阿莱西股份公司的高层代表。

Query_Text_en: French couturier Emanuel Ungaro is also making a star appearance . -RRB-
Translation: 法国高级定制服装设计师埃曼努埃尔·昂嘎罗也闪亮登场。

Query_Text_en: Although they are well aware there are people wealthy enough in India to splurge on international high-end products , Altagamma estimates that that the potential luxury goods demand in India could be between 120 % to 150 % greater than it actually is in practice .
Translation: 尽管印度确实存在能够消费国际高端产品的人群，Altagamma估算该国潜在奢侈品需求可能比实际需求高出120%至150%。

Query_Text_en: A lot of it has to do with the kind of stuff foreign retail firms eyeing Indian consumers regularly complain about : high taxes and caps on foreign direct investment .
Translation: 很多问题都与瞄准印度消费者的外国零售企业经常抱怨的内容有关，即高税收和对外资的限制。

Query_Text_en: Luxury retailers too are pressing the Indian government for full ownership of their Indian units -LRB- rather than just a 51 % stake with a mandatory Indian partner -RRB- and lower tariff barriers -LRB- import taxes on luxury goods at the federal level hover around 30 % to 40 % -RRB- .
Translation: 奢侈品零售商也在向印度政府施压，要求完全拥有其在印度的分支机构（而非仅持有51%的股份并必须与印度合作伙伴合资），并降低关税壁垒（联邦层面的奢侈品进口税税率徘徊在30%至40%之间）。

Query_Text_en: These regulatory hurdlesa ` and the option many jet-setting wealthy Indians have of shopping abroada ` means luxury brands often struggle to make a profit in India .
Translation: 这些监管障碍以及许多经常出国旅行的富裕印度人选择在国外购物的习惯，意味着奢侈品牌在印度常常难以盈利。

Query_Text_en: For many firms , having an Indian presence is largely a branding exercise , explained Mr. Branchini .
Translation: Branchini先生解释说，对于许多企业而言，在印度的存在很大程度上是一种品牌推广活动。

Query_Text_en: The lack of upmarket spaces where brands can set up high-end boutiques is another concern .
Translation: 缺乏可供品牌开设高端精品店的高端场所是另一个需要关注的问题。

Query_Text_en: Neither New Delhi , Mumbai nor Bangalore have an equivalent to New York 's Fifth Avenue , London 's Bond Street or Paris ' Rue Saint-Honor ?? .
Translation: 新德里、孟买和班加罗尔都没有纽约第五大道、伦敦邦德街或巴黎圣奥诺雷路这样的相当于街道。

Query_Text_en: Instead , big brands are housed in five-star hotels , international airports or in rare high-end malls .
Translation: 相反，知名品牌通常入驻五星级酒店、国际机场或数量极少的高端商场。

Query_Text_en: -LRB- It would be entirely fair to add that while a Fifth Avenue in New Delhi remains a distant prospect , well-paved roads free of rubble and criss-crossed cables would be a good and welcome starta ` and not just for the sake of swanky shops . -RRB-
Translation: 公平地说，虽然新德里拥有一条像纽约第五大道那样的繁华商业区仍是一个遥远的愿景，但建设平整宽阔、没有碎石和交错电缆的道路将是一个良好的开端——而不仅仅是为了一些豪华商店的存在。

Query_Text_en: But there is also the possibility Indian consumers may not be that keen on Western-style luxurya ` at least not yet .
Translation: 但印度消费者可能对西方风格的奢侈品兴趣不大，至少目前尚未形成明显偏好。

Query_Text_en: India , after all , has its own , long history of custom-made high-end goods -LRB- Think gem-studded head pieces , embroidered silks and opulent bridal wear -RRB- .
Translation: 毕竟，印度拥有自己悠久的高端定制商品历史，例如宝石镶嵌的头饰、刺绣丝绸以及奢华的婚纱礼服。

Query_Text_en: ` India , in the luxury goods industry in particular , is not easy to conquer : High-end Indian consumers have centuries of aesthetic tradition at their backs that have shaped their tastes , ' Mr. Versace said in his speech .
Translation: 印度，尤其是在奢侈品行业，绝非易攻之地：印度高端消费者身后有着数个世纪的审美传统积淀，这塑造了他们的品味，范思哲先生在演讲中表示。

Query_Text_en: But with the right kind of marketing , tastes too could change .
Translation: 但通过恰当的营销策略，人们的偏好也可能会改变。

Query_Text_en: As Altagamma suggested in a note , expanding the reach of glossy fashion magazines may do the trick .
Translation: 正如Altagamma在一份说明中所建议的，扩大高档时尚杂志的覆盖面可能奏效。

Query_Text_en: Bollywood appears to be trying to do its bit as well .
Translation: 宝莱坞似乎也在努力尽自己的一份责任。

Query_Text_en: In the 2010 movie ` Aisha , ' the main character wears designer togs and spends a lot of screen time shopping in luxury boutiques , which left more of an impression on some viewers than the plot .
Translation: 在2010年电影《艾莎》中，主角身着设计师服装，并花大量戏份在奢侈品店购物，这一场景给部分观众留下的印象比剧情本身更深刻。

Query_Text_en: As financial markets struggle to digest the catastrophic effects of Japan 's earthquake , growing violence in the Middle East and resulting jolts to global economies , traders like John Brynjolfsson and Samer Nsouli are engaged in a furious fight to try to stay ahead of events .
Translation: 在应对日本地震带来的灾难性影响、中东地区不断升级的暴力冲突以及这些事件对全球经济造成的冲击之际，像约翰·布林若尔松和萨默·恩苏里这样的交易员正展开激烈角逐，试图领先于事态发展。

Query_Text_en: Wednesday afternoon , Mr. Brynjolfsson was in the lobby of a Denver office building , waiting to meet a potential investor for his hedge fund , Armored Wolf LLC .
Translation: 周三下午，布林约尔弗松先生在丹佛某办公大楼的大堂内，等待会晤其对冲基金——铠狼有限责任公司——的潜在投资者。

Query_Text_en: Rather than review notes for the meeting , however , Mr. Brynjolfsson could n't take his eyes off a television screen flashing market prices .
Translation: 然而，布林约尔松先生没有查阅会议笔记，而是目不转睛地盯着屏幕上不断跳动的市场价格。

Query_Text_en: Soon he was calling contacts at Wall Street banks , searching for information about what he describes as ' a freefall panic ' in currency markets that sent the yen soaring to its highest level in years , and the dollar tumbling , all between 5:10 pm to 5:20 Eastern time on Wednesday .
Translation: 很快，他便联系了华尔街银行的联络人，寻找他所描述的周三东部时间下午5点10分至5点20分之间外汇市场"自由落体式恐慌"的相关信息——在此期间日元升至多年来的最高水平，美元则大幅跳水。

Query_Text_en: Mr. Brynjolfsson dialed his trader , Tim Alford , who was back in the office in Aliso Viejo , California .
Translation: 布莱尼诺夫森先生拨通了他交易员蒂姆·阿尔福德的电话，当时后者正在加州阿利索维耶霍的办公室里。

Query_Text_en: Their $ 500 million fund already was short the yen , costing it money .
Translation: 该5亿美元基金已做空日元，导致其蒙受损失。

Query_Text_en: Now Mr. Brynjolfsson wanted to add more bearish positions .
Translation: 目前布林约尔松先生希望增加更多空头头寸。

Query_Text_en: ` It 's not worth it , ' Mr. Alford told his boss , urging caution .
Translation: “这样做不值得。”阿尔福先生对老板说道，并建议谨慎行事。

Query_Text_en: Around the same time , Mr. Nsouli was at his trading desk in New York , watching the plunge of the dollar against the yen .
Translation: 与此同时，恩苏利先生正在纽约的交易台前，关注着美元兑日元汇率的暴跌。

Query_Text_en: ' I ca n't believe this , ' Mr. Nsouli said to a colleague in the office of his $ 80 million hedge fund , Lyford Group International Ltd. . Rather than make a currency move , Mr. Nsouli quickly sold U.S. stocks , expecting the dollar 's drop to weigh on shares .
Translation: "我不敢相信，"Nsouli先生对其所在的利福德国际有限公司办公室同事说道。这家对冲基金资产管理规模达8000万美元。他并未采取货币操作，而是迅速抛售了美国股票，预计美元贬值将拖累股价。

Query_Text_en: In a matter of minutes he would learn if he was right .
Translation: 几分钟后，他将得知自己是否正确。

Query_Text_en: Mr. Brynjolfsson and Mr. Nsouli are called ` macro ' traders because they bet on global macroeconomic events .
Translation: 伯尼奥尔夫森先生和恩苏利先生被称为"宏观"交易员，因为他们押注全球宏观经济事件。

Query_Text_en: Unlike most mutual funds and other vehicles , these investors can trade stocks , bonds , currencies and commodities around the globe , a freedom that helps explain why they 've seen a rush of money from investors , as global political and economic events have more impact on markets than ever before .
Translation: 与大多数共同基金和其他投资工具不同，这些投资者能够在全球范围内交易股票、债券、货币及大宗商品。这种自由度有助于解释为何其吸引了大量资金流入——在全球政治经济事件对市场的影响日益深远的背景下，这种投资灵活性显得尤为重要。

Query_Text_en: But with the freedom comes added pressure .
Translation: 但伴随着自由而来的还有额外压力。

Query_Text_en: Mr. Brynjolfsson and Mr. Nsouli hold hundreds of millions of dollars of positions in global markets , forcing them to react instantaneously to different events around the globe .
Translation: 布林约尔松先生和恩苏利先生在全球市场持有数亿美元的头寸，迫使他们必须对全球各地的事件迅速作出反应。

Query_Text_en: One example is oil .
Translation: 例如石油便是其中一例。

Query_Text_en: The nuclear accident in Japan suggested to some traders that the prices of oil , natural gas and coal would rise , as Japan and other nations move away from nuclear power , putting new pressure on already stretched energy markets . Some investors have bid up these investments .
Translation: 日本核事故促使一些交易者认为，随着日本及其他国家减少对核能的依赖，油价、天然气和煤炭价格将上涨，这给本已紧张的全球能源市场增添了新的供应压力。部分投资者已推高了这些投资品的价格。

Query_Text_en: Other traders countered that the falloff in demand in Japan is quite small , or that the events there would cause a slowdown in overall economic activity , something that should hurt oil prices .
Translation: 其他交易员反驳称，日本需求下降的幅度相当有限，或是认为日本的这些情况可能导致整体经济活动放缓，而这将抑制油价。

Query_Text_en: ' A nuclear leak can cause oil to rally or sell off , usually in the same time , ' said Mr. Brynjolfsson , citing moves in Thursday 's oil market .
Translation: 布林诺夫松表示："核泄漏可能导致油价上涨或下跌，通常在同一时段内。"他引用了周四石油市场的波动情况。

Query_Text_en: ` And instead of typical 25-cent or 50-cent moves it 's $ 1 or $ 3 . '
Translation: 取代了通常的25美分或50美分的变动幅度，现在是1美元或3美元。

Query_Text_en: As they desperately search for an edge , the investors are turning to new sources of information .
Translation: 随着投资者急于寻找竞争优势，他们开始转向新的信息来源。

Query_Text_en: Mr. Nsouli , a native of Lebanon , has begun to rely on Al Jazeera 's coverage of the events . And he 's using insights from emails sent by his cousin , who lives in Bahrain , about the violent protests in that country .
Translation: 恩苏利先生开始依赖半岛电视台对相关事件的报道，并利用其居住在巴林的表亲通过邮件提供的关于该国暴力抗议活动的见解。

Query_Text_en: One email yesterday afternoon read : ` hey buddy . situation has gone from bad to worse , and in the past 48hrs it has really spiraled out of control . '
Translation: 一封邮件写道："老兄，形势已从糟糕变得愈发严峻，过去48小时内事态已彻底失控。"

Query_Text_en: Mr. Brynjolfsson has taken to peppering questions at his 84-old father , Ari , who spent 40 years as a nuclear scientist , asking about the potential impact of Japan 's nuclear crisis .
Translation: 布林约尔松先生开始不断向他84岁的父亲Ari提问，Ari曾在核科学领域工作了40年，询问日本核危机可能带来的影响。

Query_Text_en: ` The amount of confusion is extreme , ' Mr. Brynjolfsson says .
Translation: "混乱的程度极高，"布莱尼诺夫森先生表示。

Query_Text_en: Mr. Brynjolfsson and Mr. Alford spent much of Wednesday debating what to do .
Translation: 布林约尔松先生和阿尔福德先生周三大部分时间都在讨论下一步该如何行动。

Query_Text_en: Early in the day , while he was on the way to his meeting , Mr. Brynjolfsson listened as a European energy minister called the situation in Japan a disaster . Global stocks soon tumbled .
Translation: 当天早些时候，在前往会议途中，布林约尔松听到某位欧洲能源部长将日本的情况称为一场灾难。全球股市随后急剧下跌。

Query_Text_en: Seconds later , Mr. Brynjolfsson shot off an email to his portfolio manager : ` Fade the rantings of the EU commissioner , ' using trading lingo for ignoring the minister 's sentiments .
Translation: 几秒钟后，布莱尼奥夫森先生迅速向其投资组合经理发送了一封邮件：‘无视欧盟委员的言论’，用交易术语表达即指忽略该官员的立场。

Query_Text_en: Do n't shift the firm 's positions , he told Mr. Alford .
Translation: 他对阿尔福先生说：“不要改变公司的立场。”

Query_Text_en: ` The guy did n't know what he was talking about , ' Mr. Brynjolfsson explains .
Translation: "那位先生对所谈内容一无所知，"布莱尼约夫森先生解释道。

Query_Text_en: He had been consulting with nuclear and medical experts , asking about the impact escaping radiation could have on citizens of the country and what could be done to help them prevent injury .
Translation: 他一直在与核领域及医学专家进行咨询并详细了解辐射泄漏可能对本国公民造成的影响，以及如何帮助民众采取防护措施避免受到伤害。

Query_Text_en: He also consulted his father , who was n't panicked .
Translation: 他还咨询了他的父亲，后者并未感到恐慌。

Query_Text_en: ` We 're overdoing it , ' Mr. Brynjolfsson concluded to a colleague , saying his fund should consider buying uranium .
Translation: "我们可能操之过急了，"布林约尔松先生对同事总结道，并表示他的基金应考虑购入铀矿。

Query_Text_en: Mr. Brynjolfsson also was tempted to buy Japanese shares .
Translation: 布林约尔松先生也曾考虑过购买日本股票。

Query_Text_en: But he worried that even if he did n't think the nuclear threat was great , others might .
Translation: 但他担心，即使他自己并不认为核威胁严重，其他人可能会这样认为。

Query_Text_en: ` If 90 % of experts say do n't buy Toyota it does n't matter if they never find radiation on car seats , ' he says .
Translation: “如果90%的专家都说不要购买丰田，那么即使他们从未在座椅上发现辐射，也无关紧要，”他表示。

Query_Text_en: As the yen soared late in the day , Mr. Brynjolfsson became more convinced he had to act .
Translation: 随着日元在当天尾盘急剧上涨，布莱尼奥尔夫松先生更加确信必须采取行动。

Query_Text_en: He long argued that Japan 's heavy debt , slow economic growth and demographic challenges eventually will cripple the nation 's currency and Japanese government debt .
Translation: 他长期主张，日本沉重的债务、经济增长迟缓以及人口结构挑战最终将严重削弱该国货币和日本政府债务。

Query_Text_en: Mr. Alford , his trader , was less convinced .
Translation: 阿尔福先生的交易员对此不太信服。

Query_Text_en: He was on the phone with traders in Wellington , New Zealand , trying to figure out why the yen was plunging , concluded that it likely was because it came at a time of little trading in currency markets .
Translation: 他当时正在与新西兰惠灵顿的交易员通电话，试图弄清日元为何暴跌，并得出结论认为，这可能是因为当时正值外汇市场交易清淡所致。

Query_Text_en: ` Someone could be messing around ' with the market , he said .
Translation: 他表示，可能有人在操纵市场。

Query_Text_en: He argued that the market was in such turmoil it would be hard to short yen at the prices quoted at that moment .
Translation: 他认为，由于市场当时动荡不安，以当时的报价价格做空日元将面临较大困难。

Query_Text_en: Mr. Alford also told Mr. Brynjolfsson that even if he was right in the long run , other traders could be piling into the yen , some of them scrambling to exit bearish positions on the currency , making a short bet on the yen a likely losing proposition , at least in the near term
Translation: 阿尔福德先生还告诉布雷尼奥夫松，即便从长期来看他的判断是正确的，其他交易者可能仍在大量买入日元，其中部分交易者正急于平仓离场，退出看跌日元的头寸，这意味着短期内做空日元很可能成为亏本交易。

Query_Text_en: Shorting Japanese government debt ` is where hedge fund managers go to lose money , ' Mr. Alford says , citing years of losses by those making this trade .
Translation: 阿尔福德表示：“做空日本政府债券是让对冲基金经理亏钱的领域”，并指出进行这一交易的人多年来一直亏损。

Query_Text_en: Mr. Brynjolfsson says . ` But Tim 's trying to protect me . '
Translation: 布林约尔松先生说："但蒂姆正在试图保护我。"

Query_Text_en: He stepped up a recent effort to slice the firm 's positions in almost every market , from stocks to emerging market debt , preparing for even bumpier times for the market .
Translation: 他近期加大了公司在几乎所有市场削减仓位的力度，从股票到新兴市场债务，并为更加动荡的市场时期做好准备。

Query_Text_en: But because he clung to his relatively upbeat outlook for the Japanese crisis , Mr. Brynjolfsson warned his team to exit bearish positions before bullish ones .
Translation: 但由于布莱尼奥夫森对日本危机仍持相对乐观的展望，他警告团队需先平掉看跌头寸，再平掉看涨头寸。

Query_Text_en: Mr. Brynjolfsson flew back to California on Wednesday night , arriving at his fund 's office before 6 a.m. . He and his team continued to trim the firm 's positions , while holding onto some bullish bets .
Translation: 布林约尔松于周三晚间飞回加利福尼亚，于凌晨6点前抵达其基金公司的办公室。他与团队继续削减公司仓位，同时保留部分看涨押注。

Query_Text_en: That helped yesterday , as stock markets rallied .
Translation: 这为市场昨日的上涨提供了助力。

Query_Text_en: Trying to relax from the action , Mr. Brynjolfsson walked to a Zen garden in his office complex , sitting by a koi pond , waiting to hear if the Denver investors would become a new client .
Translation: 为了从紧张的工作中放松下来，布莱尼奥夫森先生走向办公园区内的禅意花园，坐在锦鲤池旁，等待得知丹佛的投资者是否会成为新客户。

Query_Text_en: Back in New York , Mr. Nsouli also was startled by the huge move in the yen late on Wednesday . Instead of trading that currency , he decided to add short positions on the Standard & Poor 's 500 .
Translation: 回到纽约后，恩苏利先生也对周三晚间日元的大幅波动感到震惊。他并未继续交易该货币，而是决定增持标准普尔500指数的空头头寸。

Query_Text_en: Within minutes of the yen move , he had sold $ 45 million of futures contracts on the S&P 500 .
Translation: 日元波动发生后几分钟内，他就卖出了价值4500万美元的标普500指数期货合约。

Query_Text_en: Just a half an hour later , the position had gained 1 % , and Mr. Nsouli quickly sold it , pocketing a quick $ 450,000 .
Translation: 半小时后，这笔持仓已增值1%，Nsouli先生迅速抛售，轻松赚得45万美元。

Query_Text_en: By Thursday , his focus was again focused on the Middle East , an area he thinks will have even more impact on global markets in the weeks ahead .
Translation: 到周四时，他的关注点再次转向中东地区，他认为这一地区在未来几周将对全球市场产生更大的影响。

Query_Text_en: ` The most underestimated and overlooked issue is what 's happening today in Bahrain , ' he said yesterday afternoon .
Translation: "最容易被低估且最容易被忽视的问题就是巴林当前局势，"他昨天下午表示。

Query_Text_en: Mr. Nsouli argues that there 's a 20 % chance that Iran enters the situation , something that could bring the U.S. into military conflict with the nation .
Translation: 恩苏利认为，伊朗有20%的可能性卷入这一局势，这可能使美国与该国陷入军事冲突。

Query_Text_en: Such a scenario would send oil prices surging , he says . So Mr. Nsouli has been buying up oil contracts , using any dip as a reason to buy more .
Translation: 他说，这种情况下油价将急剧上涨。因此恩苏利先生一直在大量购入石油合约，逢低吸纳以加码买入。

Query_Text_en: That move paid off Thursday , as crude prices soared 3.5 % .
Translation: 这一举措周四取得成效，因原油价格飙升3.5%。

Query_Text_en: An international currency seminar to be held in the southern Chinese city of Nanjing this week has evolved into an ungainly hybrid between official summit and academic discussion thanks to conflicting visions for the event held by its two principal organizers , France and China .
Translation: 本周在中国南部城市南京举行的国际货币研讨会，由于其两大主办方法国和中国对此次会议的不同构想，已演变为官方峰会与学术讨论难以协调的混合形式。

Query_Text_en: The ` seminar , ' to be held this Thursday , is the brainchild of French President Nicolas Sarkozy , who wants to get Group of 20 industrialized and emerging nations talking about exchange rate policy and the future of the international monetary system , currently anchored by the U.S. dollar as the primary world reserve currency .
Translation: 定于本周四举行的研讨会是法国总统尼古拉·萨科齐的倡议，旨在推动二十国集团工业强国与新兴经济体就汇率政策及以美元为主导的世界储备货币体系的未来展开讨论。

Query_Text_en: The hope is that China can be coaxed into discussing the highly sensitive yuan exchange rate within this broader context .
Translation: 希望在于，中国能在这一更广泛的背景下被引导讨论人民币汇率这一高度敏感问题。

Query_Text_en: The Chinese , for their part , have resisted any suggestion that the yuan will be discussed in Nanjing with Ministry of Foreign affairs spokeswoman Jiang Yu saying earlier this month that the yuan exchange rate was not on the agenda .
Translation: 中方对将人民币问题纳入南京议程的提议表示反对。外交部发言人江玉本月早些时候表示，人民币汇率不在议程之列。

Query_Text_en: Meanwhile , China has gone to great lengths to minimize the importance of the event , characterizing it as ` informal and academic , ' placing it far from the capital Beijing , and limiting the time allotted to just one day .
Translation: 与此同时，中国不遗余力淡化这一事件的重要性，将其定性为"非正式且学术性"，将活动地点安排在远离首都北京的区域，并将活动时间严格限定为仅一天。

Query_Text_en: Thanks to the meeting 's dual identity , the list of speakers has swelled to accommodate both academic commentators and the finance ministers and central bankers of prominent G-20 nations .
Translation: 得益于此次会议的双重性质，发言名单得以扩充以满足同时容纳学术评论家和主要二十国集团国家财政部长及中央银行家的需求。

Query_Text_en: The agenda is so packed that most speakers will only have a few minutes to propound on their vision for the future of the international monetary system .
Translation: 议程安排过于紧凑，大多数发言者阐述其对国际货币体系未来愿景的时间将仅剩几分钟。

Query_Text_en: While the summit will not suffer for diversity of views , the depth of discussion , especially given the complexity of the topic , seems destined to be wanting .
Translation: 虽然峰会不会因观点多样性而受到影响，但由于议题的复杂性，讨论的深度似乎注定会显得不足。

Query_Text_en: An hour-and-fifteen minute panel in the morning , for instance , will feature U.S. Treasury Secretary Timothy Geithner , People 's Bank of China Governor Zhou Xiaochuan , European Central Bank President Jean-Claude Trichet , as well as Singaporean Finance Minister Tharman Shanmugaratnam .
Translation: 例如，一场上午举行的1小时15分钟的小组讨论将包括美国财政部长蒂莫西·盖特纳、中国人民银行行长周小川、欧洲央行行长让-克洛德·特里谢以及新加坡财政部长蒂哈曼·尚穆根。

Query_Text_en: Singapore is not a member of the G-20 , but Shanmugaratnam is there in his capacity as Chair of the International Monetary Fund 's steering committee .
Translation: 新加坡并非G20成员，但尚穆根是以国际货币基金组织指导委员会主席的身份出席的。

Query_Text_en: On the academic side , the panel will include Nobel Prize winning economist Robert Mundell , sometimes called ` father of the euro ' for his influential work on optimal exchange rate areas .
Translation: 在学术领域，该小组将包括诺贝尔经济学奖得主、有时被称为"欧元之父"的罗伯特·蒙代尔，他因在最优货币区领域的权威研究而闻名。

Query_Text_en: Mundell is favored by the Chinese for his frequent defense of their exchange rate policies .
Translation: 蒙代尔因其频繁为中国汇率政策辩护而受到中国人的青睐。

Query_Text_en: In deference to Chinese sensitivity on the exchange rate issue , participants have been instructed , according to a person with knowledge of the matter , to direct their comments towards the international monetary system in general , and not to specific currencies .
Translation: 鉴于中方在汇率问题上的敏感性，据知情人士透露，与会者被告知应将讨论重点放在国际货币体系整体上，而非具体货币。

Query_Text_en: This will be an awkward task since the main issue at hand is what , if anything , will replace the U.S. dollar as the principal anchor of the international monetary system .
Translation: 这将是一项棘手的任务，因为当前的核心问题在于，究竟什么能够取代美元成为国际货币体系的主要锚定货币。

Query_Text_en: Thus the U.S. dollar will be the largest elephant in the conference room , joined by a more junior and less self-assured pachyderm , the Chinese yuan .
Translation: 因此，美元将成为会议室里最大的大象，而人民币这只体型较小、底气不足的大象也将跻身其中。

Query_Text_en: Mining companies , which posted record profits of more than $ 50 billion in 2010 , are funneling cash into expanding their supplies of key raw materials .
Translation: 在2010年创下超过500亿美元利润的矿业公司正将资金投入扩大其关键原材料的供应。

Query_Text_en: The expansion , though , is unlikely to be enough to meet robust demand and tame rising commodity prices .
Translation: 不过，这一扩张措施不太可能足以满足强劲需求并抑制不断上涨的大宗商品价格。

Query_Text_en: Companies such as BHP Billiton , Rio Tinto PLC and Vale SA are boosting capital investment but running into various head winds , which are slowing their ability to greatly boost output of iron ore , coal and copper .
Translation: 必和必拓、力拓集团和淡水河谷等公司正在增加资本投资，但面临诸多阻力，这削弱了其大幅提高铁矿石、煤炭和铜产量的能力。

Query_Text_en: As a result , prices of those commodities are expected to remain high , with some forecast to climb even higher over the next two years .
Translation: 因此，这些大宗商品的价格预计将持续保持高位，其中部分商品价格甚至可能在未来两年进一步上涨。

Query_Text_en: The price of coal has risen 32 % since late last year .
Translation: 自去年年底以来，煤炭价格上涨了32%。

Query_Text_en: One issue shaping -- and limiting -- investment options is the rising wave of nationalism by countries , which have signaled an intent to impose high taxes or government requirements on the businesses .
Translation: 塑造并制约投资选择的一个重要因素是各国日益高涨的民族主义浪潮，这些国家已表明有意对企业的业务征收高额税费或提出政府监管要求。

Query_Text_en: Roger Agnelli , the CEO of Brazil 's Vale , which generated $ 26.12 billion in cash from operations in 2010 , is under pressure to step down by government officials who want the mining company to invest more heavily in Brazil .
Translation: 巴西淡水河谷公司（2010年运营所得现金达261.2亿美元）的首席执行官罗杰·阿格内利正面临辞职压力，巴西政府官员要求这家矿业公司加大对巴西本土的投资力度。

Query_Text_en: They would like to see more steel-making operations that could use iron ore and coal to make steel , rather than export those raw materials to steel plants in other parts of the world .
Translation: 他们希望看到更多利用铁矿石和煤炭生产钢铁的炼钢产能，而不是将这些原材料出口到其他国家的钢铁厂。

Query_Text_en: Rio Tinto Chief Executive Tom Albanese says that miners have cash available but that progress in developing or expanding new mines is slowed by delays in government permits , escalating costs for labor and machinery , and limited ports and railways .
Translation: 力拓集团首席执行官汤姆·阿尔巴内塞表示，矿业公司拥有充足资金，但开发或扩建新矿的进度受到政府审批延迟、劳动力和设备成本不断攀升以及港口和铁路运力不足的影响。

Query_Text_en: Companies have already developed the most accessible reserves and now have to dig deeper , which adds costs .
Translation: 企业已开发完最容易获取的资源储备，现在不得不转向开发更难获取的资源，这将推高成本。

Query_Text_en: They also have to extract more tons and refine them more because the reserves may not be as pure .
Translation: 由于矿藏纯度可能不足，他们还需开采更多矿石并加大提炼力度。

Query_Text_en: ` Even when we do find the new resources and our engineers are ready to go , we find that it 's actually taking longer than it would have 10 to 20 years ago to deliver them to the market , ' Mr. Albanese told investors in Hong Kong last week . ` Five years ago it was hard to look at a project without spending at least $ 500 million .
Translation: 阿尔巴内塞先生上周在香港向投资者表示："即便我们确实找到了新资源且工程师们已准备就绪，现在将它们推向市场所需的时间实际上比10至20年前更长。"他补充道："五年前，在不花费至少5亿美元的情况下评估一个项目几乎是不可能的。"

Query_Text_en: Today I would have to say it 's hard to look at a project without spending at least $ 2 - $ 3 billion . '
Translation: 如今要启动一个项目，若不投入至少20亿至30亿美元，恐怕难以推进。

Query_Text_en: In recent weeks , Rio Tinto , which posted a record $ 14 billion in earnings in 2010 and had $ 23.5 billion in cash from operations , boosted its 2011 capital expenditure budget to $ 13 billion from the previous $ 11 billion estimated last winter . Guy Elliott , the chief financial officer of Rio Tinto , says the miner is going to focus on small to medium-sized acquisitions up to the ` single-digit ' billion-dollar range .
Translation: 近几周，力拓集团公布了其2010年创纪录的140亿美元盈利及235亿美元运营现金流，并将2011年资本支出预算从今冬初估的110亿美元上调至130亿美元。力拓首席财务官盖伊·埃利奥特表示，这家矿业巨头未来将聚焦中小型收购项目，标的金额控制在十亿至数十亿美元范围内。

Query_Text_en: Supplies of certain minerals , copper in particular , are expected to be tight .
Translation: 预计某些矿产，尤其是铜，供应可能面临紧张。

Query_Text_en: Demand for copper , which is used in commercial construction and industrial piping , is outstripping supply by about 400,000 metric tons a year , according to analysts .
Translation: 分析人士称，用于商业建筑和工业管道的铜需求每年超过供应量约40万吨。

Query_Text_en: Demand for iron ore , used to make steel , is expected to exceed supply for at least the next five years as steel mills in China increase their own production .
Translation: 用于制造钢铁的铁矿石需求预计将在未来至少五年内超过供应量，因为中国钢铁企业正在扩大自身产能。

Query_Text_en: ` No matter how much will is out there to do these new projects , you are probably going to be in a position of under supply , with copper being the most extreme , ' says Mike Elliott , who heads Ernst & Young 's global mining and metals practice in Australia .
Translation: 安永澳大利亚全球采矿与金属业务部负责人迈克·埃利奥特表示："无论推动这些新项目的意愿多么强烈，供应不足的局面恐怕难以避免，而铜的供应短缺问题将最为突出。"

Query_Text_en: Investment and development is constrained in part by the limited ports and rails , he says .
Translation: 他表示，投资和发展在一定程度上受到港口和铁路不足的制约。

Query_Text_en: Having spent the last two years significantly reducing debt loads , miners are expected to ramp up investment and exceed 2009 's spending level of $ 113.7 billion for 1,123 deals , according to the latest report from Ernst & Young 's mining research and consulting .
Translation: 安永矿业研究与咨询部门最新报告显示，在过去两年大幅削减债务后，矿业公司预计将进一步加大投资力度，其投资规模将超过2009年1137亿美元的支出水平，涉及1123笔交易。

Query_Text_en: Rio Tinto slashed debt to $ 4.3 billion in 2010 , from $ 18.9 billion at the end of 2009 .
Translation: 力拓集团2010年债务从2009年底的189亿美元大幅削减至43亿美元。

Query_Text_en: Xstrata PLC reduced its net debt by 38 % to $ 7.64 billion from $ 12.3 billion .
Translation: 斯特拉塔公司将其净债务从123亿美元减少至76.4亿美元，降幅达38%。

Query_Text_en: BHP has about $ 16 billion of cash on hand and an undrawn $ 4 billion revolving-credit facility , according to its latest financial results .
Translation: 根据必和必拓最新财报显示，该公司目前拥有约160亿美元现金储备及40亿美元未动用循环信贷额度。

Query_Text_en: The miner says that it will spend about $ 80 billion in growth projects over the next five years to find and develop new resource projects in order to meet the world 's demand for more metals and minerals .
Translation: 这家矿业公司表示，未来五年内将投资约800亿美元，用于勘探并开发新的资源项目，以满足全球对更多金属和矿产的需求。

Query_Text_en: The U.S. stock market has powered back in the face of major global uncertainty，thanking to bond investors .
Translation: 美国股市在面临重大全球不确定性的情况下强劲反弹，得益于债券投资者。

Query_Text_en: Money managers and advisers say there has been a steady undercurrent of cash heading out of bonds and into equities .
Translation: 资金经理和顾问指出，资金正持续从债券流向股票，形成一股稳定的潜流。

Query_Text_en: While there remains unease about U.S. fiscal policy , with the Federal Reserve having pinned interest rates essentially at zero for so long , investors are capitulating and moving into stocks .
Translation: 尽管市场对美国财政政策仍存担忧，加之美联储长期将利率维持在接近零的水平，投资者已放弃抵抗并转向股票市场。

Query_Text_en: ` We 're in the early innings of a big asset allocation shift , ' says Jason DeSena Trennert , chief investment strategist at Strategas Research Partners .
Translation: “我们正处在资产配置重大调整的初期阶段。”斯特拉塔斯研究伙伴公司首席投资策略师杰森·德塞纳·特伦纳特表示。

Query_Text_en: That , some suggest , is what helped stocks rally last week despite spreading political turmoil in the Middle East , sustained higher oil prices , the ongoing nuclear crisis in Japan and looming problems for Portugal .
Translation: 一些观点认为，这正是上周股市上涨的原因，尽管中东地区持续蔓延的政治动荡、居高不下的油价、日本不断恶化的核危机以及葡萄牙日益严峻的债务问题等不利因素同时存在。

Query_Text_en: ` These kinds of events two years ago would have produced a significant de-risking ' in which investors bail out of stocks , says Erin Browne , director of macro trading at Citigroup . ` And we did n't see that . '
Translation: 花旗集团宏观交易主管Erin Browne表示，两年前类似事件本可能导致投资者大幅抛售股票，出现显著的去风险行为。但这种情况并未发生。

Query_Text_en: Analysts say investors , tired of earning nothing on their cash , are taking advantage of dips in the stock market to buy .
Translation: 分析师指出，因现金收益微薄而感到不耐烦的投资者正趁股市回调之机买入。

Query_Text_en: That sentiment has been largely missing since late 2008 amid the drubbing that was handed to many who tried to pick the bottom of that brutal bear market .
Translation: 自2008年末以来，由于许多试图在那场残酷熊市底部抄底的人遭受重创，这种情绪在很大程度上已大幅减弱。

Query_Text_en: The recent inclination to buy the dips has been particularly strong among investors who missed the market 's big rally since March 2009 because they were sitting in cash or gravitating toward bonds .
Translation: 自2009年3月以来因持有现金或转向债券投资而错过市场大幅上涨的投资者近期逢低买入的倾向尤为明显。

Query_Text_en: While the Dow Jones Industrial Average did decline in the first half of this month , losing 5 % through March 16 , it rallied back just as quickly and is now back where it started the month .
Translation: 尽管道琼斯工业平均指数在本月上半月出现下跌，截至3月16日累计下跌5%，但随后迅速反弹，目前已回升至月初水平。

Query_Text_en: Driving this trend has been increased confidence that the U.S. economy , while still weak when it comes to housing and job growth , is well on its way to a self-sustaining recovery .
Translation: 推动这一趋势的是市场对美国经济的信心增强。尽管住房与就业增长依然疲软，但美国经济正稳步走向自我持续复苏。

Query_Text_en: And with the simple passage of time from the worst of the financial crisis in 2008 , investors are less worried about protecting their money at all costs .
Translation: 随着时间从2008年金融危机最严重的时期过去，投资者不再像以往那样担忧必须不惜一切代价保护资金。

Query_Text_en: ` You had a lot of people at the beginning of the year still not believers in the economy ; I think more people are believers now , ' said Michael Strauss , chief economist and market strategist at Commonfund .
Translation: Commonfund首席经济学家兼市场策略师迈克尔·施特劳斯表示："年初时仍有相当多的人对经济缺乏信心，但现在更多人开始对经济抱有信心。"

Query_Text_en: In one shift , some investors are less enthusiastic about the outlook for corporate and high-yield bonds than in the earlier stages of the recovery .
Translation: 随着形势转变，部分投资者对企业债券和高收益债券前景的热情，较经济复苏初期阶段有所减弱。

Query_Text_en: The market value of the Barclays U.S. High Yield Index roughly doubled over the past 18 months to $ 968 billion , and few see similar gains ahead .
Translation: 过去18个月里，巴克莱美国高收益指数的市场价值大约翻了一番，达到9680亿美元，但很少有人预计未来会出现类似的涨幅。

Query_Text_en: ` The once-in-a-lifetime opportunity in credit is gone , ' said Leon Cooperman , chairmn of hedge-fund manager Omega Advisors , at a conference sponsored by Strategas last week .
Translation: 对冲基金公司欧米茄顾问公司董事长利昂·库伯曼在上周由Strategas主办的一场会议上表示："信贷领域的千载难逢机遇已然消逝。"

Query_Text_en: And Treasurys ` are screaming to be shorted , ' Mr. Cooperman added .
Translation: 库珀曼补充道：“美国国债正发出强烈的做空信号。”

Query_Text_en: That leaves stocks . ` At worst , stocks are the best house in a bad neighborhood , ' Mr. Cooperman said .
Translation: 最终归结到股市。"即便在最糟糕的环境中，股票仍是险境中的最优选择，"库伯曼先生表示。

Query_Text_en: If the U.S. can address its fiscal problems , ` they could be the best house in a good neighborhood . '
Translation: 如果美国能够解决财政问题，它就能成为好社区中最好的那栋房子。

Query_Text_en: Stocks ` are cheap relative to history , they 're cheap relative to inflation and they 're cheap relative to interest rates , ' Mr. Cooperman said .
Translation: 库珀曼先生表示：“与历史水平相比，股票价格低廉；与通胀相比，价格低廉；与利率水平相比，同样价格低廉。”

Query_Text_en: Stocks are trading at a price equivalent to 13 times earnings , compared with the average of the past 10 years of about 17 times , according to FactSet .
Translation: FactSet的数据显示，当前股市交易价格的市盈率（本益比）为13倍，而过去十年的平均水平约为17倍。

Query_Text_en: A shift into stocks and out of bonds is exactly what the Federal Reserve had been hoping for when it started its second round of quantitative easing last year .
Translation: 资金从债券转向股票正是美联储去年启动第二轮量化宽松政策时所期待的。

Query_Text_en: By pumping cash into the financial system , the Fed was aiming to force investors to move into riskier investments , such as stocks , that could eventually feed through into the broader economy .
Translation: 通过向金融体系注资，美联储旨在促使投资者转向股票等风险更高的投资，这些投资最终能够传导至整体经济。

Query_Text_en: ` By injecting funds into the financial system, the Federal Reserve (Fed) hopes to push investors into riskier investment areas, such as stocks, and it believes this may eventually have a positive impact on the overall economy.
Translation: 通过向金融体系注入资金，美联储旨在引导投资者转向风险较高的投资领域，例如股票市场，并认为此举最终可能对整体经济产生积极影响。

Query_Text_en: G. Scott Clemons, Chief Market Strategist at Brown Brothers Harriman, said that forcing funds out of short-term risk-free investment instruments and into riskier investment areas, such as stocks, is exactly the Fed's intention.
Translation: 布朗兄弟哈里曼首席市场策略师G. Scott Clemons表示，迫使资金从短期无风险投资工具转向高风险投资领域（如股票市场），正是美联储的意图所在。

Query_Text_en: Chinese-funded banks are a type of unusual financial institution.
Translation: 中资银行是一种特殊的金融机构。

Query_Text_en: For example, the Chinese government is their major shareholder; bank regulators have set a ceiling on deposit rates and a floor on lending rates respectively; and the impact of political forces on loan scale can be as great as that of financial conditions on it, among other things.
Translation: 例如，中国政府是其主要股东；银行监管部门对存款利率设定了上限、对贷款利率设定了下限；政治力量对贷款规模的影响可能与金融条件的影响相当，等等。

Query_Text_en: However, just as Western governments also interfere in the banking industry, the development model of Chinese-funded banks no longer seems so unusual as it did before.
Translation: 然而，正如西方政府也会干预银行业一样，中资银行的发展模式如今已不再像过去那般显得与众不同。

Query_Text_en: At least for now, Chinese-funded banks are bringing growth to the national economy and returns to investors.
Translation: 目前，中资银行正在推动经济增长，并为投资者带来回报。

Query_Text_en: The report shows that in 2010, the company achieved a 28% profit growth, the non-performing loan ratio dropped from 1.52% in 2009 to 1.10%, and the absolute amount of non-performing loans also decreased.
Translation: 报告显示，2010年该公司实现利润增长28%，不良贷款率从2009年的1.52%降至1.10%，不良贷款的绝对金额也同步减少。

Query_Text_en: Unlike some big international banks , the Chinese model is fairly straightforward : take in deposits and make loans .
Translation: 与一些国际大银行不同，中国的银行模式相当直接：吸收存款和发放贷款。

Query_Text_en: With the ceiling for deposit rates and the floor for lending rates set by the government , the net interest margin is currently 3.06 percentage points .
Translation: 在政府设定存款利率上限和贷款利率下限的情况下，目前净息差为3.06个百分点。

Query_Text_en: In 2011 , with policy in tightening mode , the banks will not be able to push as many loans out the door as they are used to .
Translation: 2011年，随着政策收紧，银行将无法像以往那样大量放贷。

Query_Text_en: But constraints on the availability of credit mean that banks may have more pricing power -- allowing them to charge higher rates above the floor set by regulators , while deposit rates currently remain constrained by the regulatory ceiling .
Translation: 信贷供应受限意味着银行可能拥有更强的定价能力——使其能够收取高于监管部门设定下限的利率，而存款利率目前仍受监管上限约束。

Query_Text_en: The hope is that this margin is enough to offset weaker loan growth and the possibility of rising delinquencies as the economy settles into a lower rate of growth .
Translation: 人们期望这一缓冲空间足以抵消贷款增长乏力的影响，并应对经济增速回落至较低水平时可能出现的违约风险上升。

Query_Text_en: The caveat is that a receding economic tide could expose weakness .
Translation: 需要注意的是，经济潮汐退去可能暴露潜在脆弱性。

Query_Text_en: In the last two years , the loan book for the sector as a whole has expanded by more than 50 % .
Translation: 过去两年间，该行业整体的贷款组合规模增长超过了50%。

Query_Text_en: That can not have come without compromising credit standards .
Translation: 这种情况的出现不可能没有放松信贷标准。

Query_Text_en: Exposure to real estate developers accounts for 19 % of banks ' loan book , and estimates suggest loans to local government investment entities account for another 20 % .
Translation: 银行贷款总额中，房地产开发商的风险敞口占比19%，估算显示地方政府投融资平台的贷款占比另有20%。

Query_Text_en: These are correlated risks .
Translation: 这些是相互关联的风险。

Query_Text_en: A sharp correction in the property sector would knock real estate developers and knock down the value of land which local governments rely on to repay their loans .
Translation: 房地产市场的剧烈调整将冲击房地产开发商，并导致地方政府依赖其偿还贷款的土地价值下降。

Query_Text_en: In an economy that is still expected to grow at more than 9 % this year bad loans may rise , but they are not likely to sky-rocket .
Translation: 尽管今年经济仍有望保持超过9%的增速，不良贷款可能增加，但不太可能出现急剧攀升。

Query_Text_en: The banks have made some provision in an anticipation of tougher times ahead .
Translation: 鉴于对未来更加艰难时期的预期，银行已作出部分拨备。

Query_Text_en: Another year of strong results will give them an opportunity to do more .
Translation: 又一年的优异成绩将为他们提供更多机会，开展更多工作。

Query_Text_en: After two years of frenzied lending they would do well to seize that opportunity
Translation: 在经历了两年的激进放贷之后，他们最好把握住这一机遇。

Query_Text_en: After two years of frenzied lending they would do well to seize that opportunity
Translation: 经过两年的狂热借贷，他们应把握住这一机遇。

Query_Text_en: Chinese banks ' net income surged to record highs last year , defying the slowing growth on the world 's second-largest economy .
Translation: 中国银行业去年净利润创历史新高，尽管世界经济第二大经济体增速放缓，仍实现逆势增长。

Query_Text_en: The banks have a tendency to be lagging indicators .
Translation: 银行往往具有滞后指标的特性。

Query_Text_en: Only after a certain amount of time has passed will China 's macro situation show up on the bottom line .
Translation: 只有经过一段时间后，中国的宏观经济形势才会在最终结果中显现出来。

Query_Text_en: Take , for example , bad loans .
Translation: 以不良贷款为例。

Query_Text_en: They 're finally growing , incrementally , after years of declining .
Translation: 在经历了多年的下滑后，它们终于开始逐步增长。

Query_Text_en: Industrial & Commercial Bank of China Ltd. , the nation 's largest bank by assets , saw its nonperforming loans rise by 3.82 billion yuan -LRB- about $ 606 million -RRB- in the fourth quarter ; China Construction Bank Corp. , the No. 2 bank on the mainland , reported a 6.27 billion yuan rise in such loans .
Translation: 中国工商银行（按资产规模计算的国内最大银行）第四季度不良贷款增加382亿元人民币（约合6.06亿美元）；中国大陆第二大银行中国建设银行报告称此类贷款增加627亿元人民币。
