Query_Text_en: The recent announcement of a $ 125.6 million strategic investment from Chinese Internet company Tencent Holdings Ltd. and U.S. online travel agent Expedia Inc. leaves eLong in a position to expand its customer base , thanks to its newfound access to Tencent Holdings ' 674 million active users , according to an announcement from the companies .
Translation: 据公司公告称，腾讯控股有限公司和美国在线旅游代理Expedia公司对eLong进行的1.256亿美元战略投资，使eLong能够借助腾讯控股的6.74亿活跃用户，从而扩大其客户群。

Query_Text_en: The two companies plan to set up a partnership that will distribute eLong 's supply of hotels to Tencent 's online community .
Translation: 这两家公司计划建立合作伙伴关系，将eLong的酒店资源供应分配至腾讯的在线社区。

Query_Text_en: Tencent invested $ 84.4 million in eLong for a 16 % stake , while Expedia increased its holdings of eLong from to 56 % from 48 % .
Translation: 腾讯向艺龙投资8440万美元，获得16%的股份，而Expedia将其在艺龙的持股比例从48%提升至56%。

Query_Text_en: The investment in Beijing-based eLong is n't the only sign of the coming battle for who will sell travel itineraries to China 's new middle class .
Translation: 对总部位于北京的艺龙的投资并非唯一迹象，显示出谁能向中国新兴中产阶级销售旅游行程的争夺战即将到来。

Query_Text_en: In April , Nanjing , China-based online travel group reseller Tuniu.com -LRB- Nanjing -RRB- Technology Co. raised $ 50 million in a private round of financing from venture firms DCM , Gobi Partners , Highland Capital , Sequoia Capital China , and Japanese Internet services group Rakuten Group .
Translation: 4月，中国南京在线旅游集团经销商途牛科技公司（南京）完成5000万美元私募融资，投资方包括风险投资机构DCM、戈壁投资、高瓴资本、红杉资本中国以及日本互联网服务集团乐天集团。

Query_Text_en: Yandex IPO : To Nasdaq With Love
Translation: Yandex首次公开募股：纳斯达克之爱

Query_Text_en: Yandex looks stretched .
Translation: Yandex显得力有未逮。

Query_Text_en: Shares of ` Russia 's Google ' debuted Tuesday on Nasdaq , closing up 55 % to $ 38.84 . That puts the company 's market capitalization close to $ 13.2 billion .
Translation: 俄罗斯版谷歌周二在纳斯达克交易所上市，收盘价较发行价上涨55%至38.84美元，使得该公司市值接近132亿美元。

Query_Text_en: Coming off a depressed period the prior year , first-quarter net income growth of 62 % likely wo n't be sustained .
Translation: 继去年处于低迷期之后，今年第一季度62%的净收入增长可能无法持续。

Query_Text_en: But assume 45 % growth , and the shares fetch nearly 70 times 2011 earnings .
Translation: 假设增长率达到45%，则股票市盈率将接近2011年收益的70倍。

Query_Text_en: For comparison , take ` China 's Google , ' Baidu .
Translation: 以百度为例，它被称为"中国的谷歌"。

Query_Text_en: It trades at 50 times this year 's earnings .
Translation: 该股票以今年收益的50倍进行交易。

Query_Text_en: Yet it operates in a far larger market , has no big competitors after the Chinese government forced Google to limit operations , has higher operating margins and is growing faster .
Translation: 然而，它在中国这一规模更大的市场中运营，在中方迫使谷歌限制在华业务运营后，其没有强劲的竞争对手，且运营利润率更高、增长速度更快。

Query_Text_en: Analysts expect 70 % earnings growth this year .
Translation: 分析师预计今年盈利将增长70%。

Query_Text_en: To be sure , Yandex has built an impressive operation .
Translation: 不可否认的是，Yandex已经打造了一个令人印象深刻的运营体系。

Query_Text_en: Even as Google has captured about 20 % of Russian-language Internet search traffic , Yandex has lifted its own share to 65 % .
Translation: 尽管谷歌占据了约20%的俄语网络搜索流量，但Yandex已将其自身份额提升至65%。

Query_Text_en: As Russia 's market leader , Yandex will benefit from the growth of Russian online advertising .
Translation: 作为俄罗斯市场的领军企业，Yandex将受益于俄罗斯在线广告市场的增长。

Query_Text_en: ZenithOptimedia analyst Jonathan Barnard notes that just 43 % of Russians were on the Web in 2010 .
Translation: ZenithOptimedia分析师乔纳森·巴纳德指出，2010年仅有43%的俄罗斯人使用互联网。

Query_Text_en: As that expands , along with the proportion of Russian ad budgets being spent on the Internet , Mr. Barnard says Russia 's online ad market will grow at an annual rate of 40 % through 2013 .
Translation: 伯纳德先生表示，随着这一趋势的扩展以及俄罗斯广告预算中投入互联网的比例增加，到2013年，俄罗斯在线广告市场将以每年40%的速度增长。

Query_Text_en: Investors should n't forget : This is Russia .
Translation: 投资者须谨记：这是俄罗斯。

Query_Text_en: Yandex notes in its offering document that ` the legal framework supporting a market economy remains ... in flux . '
Translation: 雅虎在其招股说明书中指出，"支撑市场经济的法律框架仍处于变动之中。"

Query_Text_en: And the economy and currency are significantly correlated to the price of oil , which can be volatile .
Translation: 经济和货币状况与油价显著相关，而油价可能波动较大。

Query_Text_en: Censored Chinese Internet companies hardly are the safest investment either .
Translation: 受严格监管的中国互联网公司也绝非最安全的投资选择。

Query_Text_en: Perhaps the best bet , at a more pedestrian 17 times 2011 earnings , is the original Google back in the U.S.
Translation: 或许，以相对保守的2011年收益17倍市盈率计算，美国市场的原始谷歌股票是最佳选择。

Query_Text_en: The topic du jour : the crunching slowdown of computer sales to consumers.We 're pulling on the skeptic hat here at Deal Journal Central .
Translation: 当前热议话题：个人电脑零售市场销售急剧下滑。在Deal Journal Central，我们保持怀疑态度。

Query_Text_en: Hewlett-Packard yesterday talked about a weak consumer market for computers , even while businesses are still snapping up new computer hardware and services .
Translation: 惠普公司昨日指出，尽管企业仍在大量采购新的计算机硬件及服务，但个人电脑消费市场需求疲软。

Query_Text_en: Desktop computer revenue slipped 4 % in the latest quarter , H-P said , and revenue from sales of laptops slid 9 % from a year ago .
Translation: 惠普表示，台式机营收在最新季度下降了4%，笔记本电脑销售额同比则下滑9%。

Query_Text_en: H-P said it expects consumer demand to continue to be weak .
Translation: 惠普表示预计消费需求将继续保持疲软。

Query_Text_en: Similarly , Dell also said sluggish consumer demand weighed on sales of low-end ` netbook ' type computers .
Translation: 同样，戴尔也表示，消费需求疲软拖累了低端上网本的销售。

Query_Text_en: Many analysts blamed the continued weak consumer PC market on the rise of tablet computers , whose sales ` increasingly cannibalize lower-end netbook and desktop sales , ' wrote Barclays Capital analyst Hale Holden .
Translation: 许多分析师将消费者个人电脑市场持续疲软归因于平板电脑的兴起，巴克莱资本分析师黑尔·霍登指出，"其销量正日益蚕食低端上网本和台式机的市场份额"。

Query_Text_en: Gartner and other respected research firms also have ratcheted down their expectations for traditional computer sales , in part because of demand for tablets .
Translation: 高德纳及其他权威研究机构也纷纷下调了对传统电脑销售的预期，部分原因是由于平板电脑需求的增加。

Query_Text_en: But today , Nielsen released new research at the PaidContent mobile conference that found fewer than 5 % of consumers surveyed own a tablet computer .
Translation: 但尼尔森今日在PaidContent移动会议上发布的一项最新研究报告显示，调查中不足5%的消费者拥有平板电脑。

Query_Text_en: If you see the glass as half empty , you could say that 's a pretty impressive number considering tablet computers did n't exist before the launch of the iPad just over a year ago .
Translation: 如果有人认为杯子是半空的，那么考虑到在一年多前iPad面世之前平板电脑还不存在，可以说这个数字已经相当可观了。

Query_Text_en: Anecdotally , it seems folks piling into Apple stores to buy an iPad are buying it as an addition to their array of tech gadgets , rather than as a replacement for our full array of home computers and laptops .
Translation: 从轶事来看，似乎涌入苹果商店购买iPad的消费者将其视为对现有科技产品阵容的补充，而非取代全套家用电脑和笔记本电脑。

Query_Text_en: Even Dell founder Michael Dell yesterday did n't scapegoat the tablet computer for weak PC sales .
Translation: 就连戴尔公司创始人迈克尔·戴尔昨日也未将个人电脑销量疲软归咎于平板电脑。

Query_Text_en: ` The tablet , in almost all the instances we 've found , is a third device , ' he said on Dell 's earnings call yesterday .
Translation: 他表示，在我们发现的几乎所有案例中，平板电脑都属于第三台设备。

Query_Text_en: It 's not hard to imagine the tablet will take a bite out of PC sales ... eventually .
Translation: 不难预见，平板电脑最终将蚕食个人电脑的销量……

Query_Text_en: Instead of buying a second laptop , you might buy opt for a tablet instead .
Translation: 与其购买第二台笔记本电脑，不如选择平板电脑。

Query_Text_en: But for now , no one yet knows if the tablet is a replacement for a TV , or for a computer , or for a smartphone .
Translation: 但目前尚无人知晓，平板电脑究竟是替代电视、电脑，还是智能手机。

Query_Text_en: Perhaps it is worth being a little skeptical about how much of these soft PC sales can be laid at the feet of Steve Jobs and his tablet computer acolytes .
Translation: 或许值得对这些疲软的PC销售在多大程度上应归咎于史蒂夫·乔布斯及其平板电脑信徒这一点持一点怀疑态度。

Query_Text_en: Federal securities regulators are taking a deeper look at the role of big banks in executing currency trades for clients .
Translation: 美国联邦证券监管机构正在深入审查大银行在为客户执行货币交易中的角色。

Query_Text_en: The Securities and Exchange Commission is examining whether two major banks made proper representations to pension-fund clients about how their currency trades would be handled and priced , according to a person familiar with the matter .
Translation: 据一位知情人士透露，美国证券交易委员会正在调查两家主要银行是否向养老基金客户做出了关于其货币交易如何处理和定价的适当说明。

Query_Text_en: The SEC probe , which is examining the currency-trading activities of Bank of New York Mellon Corp. and State Street Corp. , marks a new level of scrutiny by authorities .
Translation: 美国证券交易委员会对纽约梅隆银行和道富集团的货币交易活动展开的调查，标志着监管机构审查力度的进一步升级。

Query_Text_en: It comes on the heels of previously publicized probes by the Justice Department and three state attorneys general into whether the banks fairly charged clients for currencies .
Translation: 这紧随司法部和三个州总检察长此前已公布的调查之后，该调查旨在查明银行是否公平地向客户收取货币相关费用。

Query_Text_en: It had n't been previously known that the SEC was examining BNY Mellon 's activities .
Translation: 此前并不为人所知的是，美国证券交易委员会正在审查纽约梅隆银行的业务活动。

Query_Text_en: And the nature of the SEC investigation had n't been made public .
Translation: 而美国证券交易委员会调查的性质尚未被公开。

Query_Text_en: State Street and BNY Mellon say they have done nothing wrong and will defend themselves .
Translation: 道富集团和纽约梅隆银行表示，双方均未做错任何事，并将进行辩护。

Query_Text_en: State Street said it will ` cooperate fully ' with the SEC inquiry .
Translation: 道富集团表示将全面配合美国证券交易委员会的调查。

Query_Text_en: BNY Mellon says it made proper client representations and is cooperating with inquiries by ` certain governmental authorities . '
Translation: 纽约梅隆银行表示已采取恰当的客户代理行为，并正配合相关政府部门的调查。

Query_Text_en: An SEC spokesman declined to comment .
Translation: 美国证券交易委员会发言人拒绝置评。

Query_Text_en: Stock markets are sliding globally , and much investor attention is focused in the euro-zone debt crisis .
Translation: 全球股市普遍下跌，投资者的关注焦点集中在欧元区债务危机上。

Query_Text_en: But the sell-off may also be feeding off another part of the world , namely China .
Translation: 但此次抛售也可能受到世界其他地区，即中国的影响。

Query_Text_en: A reading above 50 indicates expansion .
Translation: 高于50的读数表明经济处于扩张状态。

Query_Text_en: Chinese stocks fell sharply after that report , with the Shanghai Composite dropping 2.9 % , its biggest loss since late January .
Translation: 受该报告影响，中国股市大幅下跌，上证综指跌幅达2.9%，为自1月底以来的最大跌幅。

Query_Text_en: Chinese stocks are now down for the year .
Translation: 中国股市年内下跌。

Query_Text_en: Commodity prices are skidding , with oil down 3.6 % at just above $ 96 a barrel , and copper off 3.8 % at just under $ 4 a pound , according to FactSet .
Translation: FactSet的数据显示，大宗商品价格急剧下跌，油价每桶略高于96美元，跌幅达3.6%，铜价每磅略低于4美元，下跌3.8%。

Query_Text_en: The decline in commodities stems , in part , from a stronger dollar , but concerns about China demand are also playing a role .
Translation: 大宗商品价格下跌部分源于美元走强，同时对中国需求的担忧也起到了推波助澜的作用。

Query_Text_en: Miners , which tend to trade as China Plays , are also down , with Rio Tinto down 2 % and BHP Billiton off nearly 3 % .
Translation: 与中国市场密切相关的矿业公司股价也出现下跌，力拓下跌2%，必和必拓下跌近3%。

Query_Text_en: So is the euro , of course .
Translation: 当然，欧元也是如此。

Query_Text_en: Our forecast is for year-over-year increases in headline CPI to slow over the next 12 months , to 2.8 % from 5.3 % in April .
Translation: 我们预测未来12个月内整体消费者价格指数（CPI）的同比增幅将放缓，从4月份的5.3%降至2.8%。

Query_Text_en: If that risk plays out , Chinese policymakers may tamp on the brakes a bit harder .
Translation: 如果这一风险显现，中国决策层可能采取更强烈的紧缩措施。

Query_Text_en: Asia 's investment-banking scene is getting increasingly crowded , as new players such as boutique firms and brokerages go up against established giants for billions of dollars in potential fees .
Translation: 随着精品投行和经纪公司等新竞争者不断涌现，亚洲投资银行业竞争日益激烈，各方正围绕数十亿美元的潜在佣金与既有巨头展开争夺。

Query_Text_en: So far they have yet to make a major splash , as the big banks still dominate deal league tables .
Translation: 迄今为止，它们尚未产生重大影响，因为大型银行仍主导着交易排行榜。

Query_Text_en: But some bankers grouse that the new players could intensify competition and put downward pressure on fees .
Translation: 但部分银行从业者抱怨，这些新进入者可能加剧市场竞争，并给费用带来下行压力。

Query_Text_en: A number of top Asian bankers have left positions at major firms to strike out on their own .
Translation: 许多顶尖的亚洲银行家已离开大型金融机构职位，自立门户。

Query_Text_en: Among them , distressed debt veterans Michel Lowy and Soo Cheon Leeleft Deutsche Bank in 2009 to set up SC Lowy , a Hong Kong-based global trading and investing firm focused on illiquid assets .
Translation: 其中，困境债务领域资深人士米歇尔·洛伊和李秀铉于2009年离开德意志银行，创立了总部位于香港的全球贸易投资公司SC Lowy，该公司专注于非流动性资产领域。

Query_Text_en: Richard Orders , the former head of global clients for Asia-Pacific at ABN Amro Bank NV , founded Hong Kong-based Asia Pacific Advisers two years ago and it was acquired in April by U.S.-based boutique Moelis & Co. .
Translation: 理查德·奥德斯此前担任荷兰安智银行亚太区全球客户主管，他于两年前在香港创立了亚太顾问公司，该公司今年四月被美国精品投行莫里斯公司收购。

Query_Text_en: They are joined by financial firms looking to branch into investment banking , from South Korea 's Samsung Securities and Japan 's Daiwa Securities to India 's Religare Capital making forays into share trading or initial public offerings .
Translation: 韩国三星证券、日本大和证券以及印度Religare资本等金融机构也纷纷加入，拓展投资银行业务，涉足股票交易或首次公开募股等领域。

Query_Text_en: Traditional banks such as Barclays PLC and Standard Chartered PLC , as well as domestic Chinese securities giants such as Citic Securities Co. , are making plays for much of the same business .
Translation: 巴克莱银行、渣打银行等传统银行以及中信证券等国内证券巨头正在争夺同一领域的业务。

Query_Text_en: Many of the new players say they have an edge : a focus on investment banking without pressure to make a market for the other services and products big banks offer , as well as a more personalized touch and greater attention from senior bankers rather than junior associates .
Translation: 许多新进入者表示他们具备竞争优势：专注于投资银行业务，无需像大型银行那样承受推广其他服务和产品的压力，同时提供更个性化服务以及高层银行家而非初级员工的更多关注。

Query_Text_en: But outside of China and Japan , where local firms predominate , big banks such as UBS AG and Goldman Sachs Group Inc. still claim the vast majority of the business .
Translation: 但在日本和中国以外的地区，由于当地企业占据主导地位，瑞银集团和高盛集团等大型银行仍占据绝大多数业务。

Query_Text_en: Standard Chartered , which began beefing up its investment-banking business after the financial crisis , is No. 14 this year , while Barclays ' Barclays Capital arm is No. 29 . Samsung Securities is at No. 81 , largely by virtue of its homegrown Korea business , while Daiwa Capital Markets is at No. 109 .
Translation: 渣打银行在金融危机后开始加强投资银行业务，今年排名第14位，而巴克莱银行的投资银行部门巴克莱资本位列第29位。三星证券凭借本土韩国业务位列第81位，大和资本市场则排在第109位。

Query_Text_en: Many of the smaller firms do n't appear on Dealogic 's league tables at all .
Translation: 许多规模较小的公司完全未被列入迪罗基的排行榜。

Query_Text_en: Smaller firms have claimed shares of a handful of bigger deals .
Translation: 中小企业已分得几笔大型交易的部分份额。

Query_Text_en: Moelis is an adviser on luggage maker Samsonite 's planned $ 1 billion listing in Hong Kong
Translation: 莫里斯公司是箱包制造商新秀丽计划在香港进行的10亿美元首次公开募股的顾问。

Query_Text_en: Lexicon Partners , a London-based firm that opened its Hong Kong office in 2007 , advised a consortium led by Asian conglomerate Jardine Matheson Holdings Ltd. on buying Hong Kong 's biggest air cargo terminal last year .
Translation: 总部位于伦敦的Lexicon Partners公司于2007年在香港开设办事处，去年曾为由亚洲企业集团怡和集团有限公司牵头的财团收购香港最大航空货运站提供咨询建议。

Query_Text_en: One of the more rarefied markets of the rich is the ` en primeur ' system , also known as the wine futures market .
Translation: 富豪阶层的一个高端市场是期酒交易体系，即葡萄酒期货市场。

Query_Text_en: Each year , French chateaux sell vintages just months after the grape harvest , with the wine still in barrels .
Translation: 每年，法国酒庄会在葡萄采收后仅数月便出售年份酒，此时酒液仍存于木桶之中。

Query_Text_en: Merchants and investors buy the futures and take delivery of the barrels years later , when the wines are more mature and closer to drinking age .
Translation: 酒商和投资者购买期货，数年后接收酒桶，那时葡萄酒已经更加成熟，接近适饮期。

Query_Text_en: The system was originally created to give chateaux money to finance their next year 's wine production .
Translation: 该体系最初设立是为了向酒庄提供资金，以支持其下一年度的葡萄酒生产。

Query_Text_en: But like many of today 's trading markets , ` en primeur ' has become financialized , prone to wild speculation , manic price swings and over-pricing .
Translation: 但与当今许多交易市场一样，"期酒"交易也已金融化，容易受到投机炒作的影响，价格剧烈波动且存在过度溢价。

Query_Text_en: As wine prices have soared in recent years , the system also cut the producers out of some of the gains , since they 're essentially pre-selling their wines .
Translation: 由于近年来葡萄酒价格大幅飙升，该体系还使生产商未能获得部分收益，因为他们基本上提前预售了葡萄酒。

Query_Text_en: Now , one of France 's more elite wine-makers is pulling out .
Translation: 如今，法国一家较为顶级的葡萄酒酿造商正退出。

Query_Text_en: It 's stated reason is that too many of the newly rich in Asia are drinking Latour wines before they 're mature .
Translation: 其给出的理由是，亚洲太多新富阶层人士在拉图酒尚未成熟时便将其饮用。

Query_Text_en: Apparently , the thought of a rich Hong Kong wine-buyer quaffing a 2009 Latour with their dumplings was simply too much to bear .
Translation: 显然，一个香港富豪酒商用2009年的拉图酒佐餐饺子的想法，实在令人难以接受。

Query_Text_en: So Latour is holding its wine until its time .
Translation: 拉图酒庄正窖藏其葡萄酒直至最佳时机。

Query_Text_en: ` From the 2012 vintage onwards , our wines will only be put on the market when they are ready to be drunk , ' Frederic Engerer told the press . ` Unfortunately , our wines are all too often drunk young .
Translation: "从2012年份开始，我们的葡萄酒只会在适宜饮用时才投放市场，"弗雷德里克·恩格瑞在记者会上表示，"遗憾的是，我们的葡萄酒却总是被过早饮用。"

Query_Text_en: They keep for a long time and there is no point opening them too soon . '
Translation: 它们具有长期有效性，过早启动并无必要。

Query_Text_en: Yet money is clearly a factor .
Translation: 然而金钱显然是一个因素。

Query_Text_en: The 1982 vintage Latour sold for about $ 400 a case en primeur .
Translation: 1982年份的拉图酒在期酒市场上以每箱约400美元的价格售出。

Query_Text_en: Now each bottle is selling for more than $ 1,000 a 30-fold gain that went largely to investors and merchants , rather than Latour .
Translation: 如今，每瓶售价超过1000美元，价格增长了30倍，而这一收益主要流向了投资者和商人，而非拉图酒庄。

Query_Text_en: With so many newly rich Asians paying so much for the blue-chip wines , it 's only a matter of time before the other top wine-makers also demand more of their cut .
Translation: 随着越来越多新富亚洲人豪掷重金购买顶级名酒，其他顶级酒商要求提高分成比例也只不过是时间问题。

Query_Text_en: The U.N. Security Council imposed sanctions on three additional North Korean companies on Wednesday in response to Pyongyang 's banned missile launch last month .
Translation: 联合国安理会于周三对三家朝鲜新增企业实施制裁，以回应该国上月进行的被禁导弹发射活动。

Query_Text_en: The state-owned firms approved by China for an asset freeze were among 40 proposed by the council , diplomats said .
Translation: 外交官表示，中国批准对其实施资产冻结的国有企业属于委员会提议的40家机构之一。

Query_Text_en: Beijing generally opposes economic sanctions and is one of North Korea 's few allies .
Translation: 中国政府一贯反对经济制裁，并且是朝鲜为数不多的盟友之一。

Query_Text_en: The Chinese did approve sanctions , including a full arms embargo against the North , in response to a missile and nuclear weapons test in 2009 .
Translation: 中国方面确实通过了制裁措施，包括针对朝鲜的全面武器禁运，作为对2009年导弹和核试验的回应。

Query_Text_en: It was that previous U.N. resolution opposing such tests that Pyongyang violated in April with its failed ballistic missile launch .
Translation: 正是此前联合国反对进行此类试验的决议，平壤于4月以失败的弹道导弹发射行动违反。

Query_Text_en: Green Pine Associated Corporation , which exports about half of all North Korean arms and materiel such as submarines and missile systems and exported torpedoes to Iran ; and the Korea Heungjin Trading Company , which has procured advanced missile technology .
Translation: 朝鲜绿松投资公司，该公司出口了朝鲜约一半的军火及物资，包括潜艇和导弹系统，并向伊朗出口鱼雷；以及朝鲜高丽亨进贸易公司，该公司采购了先进导弹技术。

Query_Text_en: Banned nuclear and missile technology items were also added to the U.N. 's banned import list in the North .
Translation: 联合国还将被禁止的核与导弹技术物品列入朝鲜的禁止进口清单。

Query_Text_en: ` Taken together , we view this as a strong and credible set of new sanctions , ' U.S. Ambassador Susan Rice told reporters .
Translation: 美国大使苏珊·赖斯对记者表示："综合来看，我们视此为一套有力且具可信度的新制裁措施。"

Query_Text_en: Baoruitong is not alone .
Translation: 宝瑞通并非孤例。

Query_Text_en: Throughout China , pawnshops have branched out a long way from their roots of swapping relatively small loans for collateral such as jewellery .
Translation: 在中国各地，当铺的业务范围已远超出其最初以珠宝等物品作为抵押换取小额贷款的传统模式。

Query_Text_en: Small businesses , which struggle to get loans anywhere in the world , are particularly disadvantaged in China , where state-owned banks shy away from private companies .
Translation: 在全球范围内难以获得贷款的中小企业，在中国面临的困境尤为突出，因为国有银行往往回避民营企业。

Query_Text_en: The transformation of pawnshops into quasi-banks offers a glimpse into the shortcomings of the Chinese financial system , but also the ways in which entrepreneurs are coming up with solutions .
Translation: 典当行向类银行机构的转型，既揭示了中国金融体系的短板，也展现了企业家探索解决之道的路径。

Query_Text_en: Banned by the Communist party until 1987 , pawnshops are now thriving .
Translation: 当铺曾被共产党禁止直至1987年，如今却蓬勃发展。

Query_Text_en: China had 4,433 pawnshops at the end of 2010 , more than double the number five years ago , according to recent official data .
Translation: 官方最新数据显示，截至2010年底，中国共有典当行4433家，数量较五年前翻了一番还多。

Query_Text_en: It seemed a bit too simple .
Translation: 这似乎有点过于简单。

Query_Text_en: You swap some money for an object , right ? But that was a traditional view .
Translation: 你用金钱换取一个物品，对吧？但那是传统的观点了。

Query_Text_en: Up to 60 per cent is backed by property and 30 per cent by cars , with almost all of the money going to the owners of small businesses .
Translation: 最高达60%以房地产抵押，30%以汽车抵押，其中几乎全部资金流向小微企业主。

Query_Text_en: Other pawnshops report similar figures .
Translation: 其他典当行也上报了类似数据。

Query_Text_en: They are answering a need .
Translation: 他们正在满足某种需求。

Query_Text_en: They prefer to lend to state-backed enterprises , fearing private companies could be allowed to fail if trouble strikes .
Translation: 他们倾向于向国有背景企业提供贷款，担心在危机来临时私营企业可能被任其破产。

Query_Text_en: China has thousands of vigorous companies which , ignored by banks , are willing to pay high rates for loans .
Translation: 中国有成千上万家充满活力的企业，这些企业虽被银行忽视，却愿意支付高利率来获取贷款。

Query_Text_en: Analysts say this informal lending could total as much as Rmb10tn , or about one-fifth of bank lending , and small businesses appear to have become even more reliant on it over the past few years .
Translation: 分析人士表示，这种民间借贷规模可能高达人民币10万亿元，相当于银行贷款规模的五分之一。近年来，小微企业似乎已变得更加依赖这种借贷方式。

Query_Text_en: Pawnshops have been some of the most aggressive lenders , bolstered by their national networks of store fronts and experience in short-term lending .
Translation: 典当行一直是活跃的放贷机构之一，依托其全国实体门店网络和短期放贷经验。

Query_Text_en: They lent Rmb180bn in 2010 , equivalent to just 2.3 per cent of lending by banks but a figure that is rising quickly .
Translation: 2010年他们发放了1800亿元人民币贷款，仅相当于银行贷款总额的2.3%，但这一数字正在迅速增长。

Query_Text_en: While bank loan growth has been about 20 per cent annually , pawnshop managers say their loan books have been doubling every year or two .
Translation: 虽然银行贷款增速约为每年20%，但典当行经理表示，他们的贷款业务规模每一年或两年便能翻一番。

Query_Text_en: The combination of rapid lending growth and relaxed credit standards inevitably raises questions about risks .
Translation: 快速增长的贷款发放与宽松的信贷标准相结合，不可避免地引发了对风险的质疑。

Query_Text_en: Regulators are not blind to this .
Translation: 监管机构对此并非视而不见。

Query_Text_en: They have pushed for greater disclosure of lending outside the formal banking system and tried to insulate banks from such activity .
Translation: 他们推动提高非正规金融体系借贷活动的信息披露透明度，并努力使银行免受此类活动影响。

Query_Text_en: But their attitude has largely been permissive and their main focus on improving monitoring .
Translation: 但他们的态度一直较为宽松，而主要着力点在于加强监管。

Query_Text_en: A pilot project launched last month to allow private lending in Wenzhou , an entrepreneurial hub in the eastern province of Zhejiang , was seen as an important step towards establishing standards for non-bank lending institutions .
Translation: 上月在浙江省东部创业中心温州启动的允许民间借贷试点项目，被视为建立非银行借贷机构标准的重要一步。

Query_Text_en: Pawnshops fall under the purview of the commerce ministry , which issues strict guidelines about interest rates .
Translation: 典当行业由商务部负责监管，该部门制定了关于利率的严格规定。

Query_Text_en: But the financing is only meant to be for a few months and businesses have lapped up the pawnshop loans .
Translation: 但该融资仅限数月，而企业已大量借入典当行贷款。

Query_Text_en: Singapore 's Temasek Holdings ' every move is being watched closely by any observer of China 's banking sector .
Translation: 新加坡淡马锡控股的一举一动都受到中国银行业的观察人士密切关注。

Query_Text_en: In its latest portfolio reshuffling , it has sold down stakes in two Chinese banks , again .
Translation: 在最近的投资组合调整中，它再次减持了两家中国银行的股份。

Query_Text_en: On Thursday , Dow Jones Newswires reports that sovereign wealth fund Temasek raised US$ 2.48 billion through share sales in two state-owned banks , Bank of China Ltd. and China Construction Bank Ltd. , via placements .
Translation: 周四，道琼斯新闻社报道，主权财富基金淡马锡通过配售中国银行股份有限公司与中国建设银行股份有限公司两家国有银行的股份，筹集了24.8亿美元。

Query_Text_en: The sales come as both CCB and Bank of China have gained 14 % so far this year in Hong Kong .
Translation: 中国建设银行和中国银行在香港的股价今年迄今均上涨14%，这一增长随之而来。

Query_Text_en: Temasek sold Bank of China 's H shares at HK$ 3.13 -LRB- US$ 0.4 -RRB- each and CCB shares at HK$ 5.99 each , both at the bottom end of their indicative price ranges .
Translation: 淡马锡以每股3.13港元（约合0.4美元）的价格出售了中国银行的H股股份，并以每股5.99港元的价格出售了中国建设银行的股份，两项交易均以各自指示性价格区间的低端价格售出。

Query_Text_en: Bank of China 's Hong Kong-listed H shares opened down 3.7 % on Thursday and CCB opened down 2.9 % .
Translation: 中国银行在香港上市的H股周四开盘下跌3.7%，建设银行开盘下跌2.9%。

Query_Text_en: Temasek has given a huge vote of confidence to Chinese lenders in the past year as it steadily builds up its holdings in the country 's biggest banks , and as Wall Street banks retreat from their investments in the sector .
Translation: 在过去一年中，淡马锡通过稳步增持国内最大型银行的股份，对中国银行业表达了强烈信心，而华尔街银行则撤出对该领域的投资。

Query_Text_en: Just last month , Goldman Sachs Group Inc. slashed its stake in Industrial & Commercial Bank of China Ltd. once again , with Temasek buying up most of the offloaded shares .
Translation: 就在上个月，高盛集团再次大幅减持了其在中国工商银行的股份，而淡马锡买入了大部分被抛售的股份。

Query_Text_en: ` The biggest shareholder in the Chinese banks , outside the Chinese government , is now Temasek and not a foreign bank , ' said Mike Werner , China bank analyst at Sanford C. Bernstein . ` Temasek is bullish on China , and investors are closely watching them . '
Translation: 桑福德·C.伯恩斯坦公司的中国银行业分析师迈克·沃纳表示："除中国政府外，中国各大银行的最大股东目前是新加坡淡马锡公司而非外资银行。淡马锡对中国经济前景持乐观态度，投资者正密切关注其动向。"

Query_Text_en: For a sovereign wealth fund , Temasek has been an uncharacteristically active portfolio manager .
Translation: 作为一家主权财富基金，淡马锡的投资组合管理表现异常活跃，堪称不寻常。

Query_Text_en: Last July , Temasek raised $ 3.62 billion in stake sales in Bank of China and CCB , which it said was part of its routine portfolio reshuffling .
Translation: 去年7月，淡马锡通过减持中国银行和中国建设银行的股份筹集了36.2亿美元，该公司表示这是其常规投资组合调整的一部分。

Query_Text_en: It sold CCB shares at HK$ 6.26 each and Bank of China shares at HK$ 3.63 each .
Translation: 它以每股6.26港元的价格出售了中国建设银行股份，以每股3.63港元的价格出售了中国银行股份。

Query_Text_en: Temasek later upped its stake again in CCB , buying shares at HK$ 4.94 in August from Bank of America Corp. , and bought shares in Bank of China again at HK$ 2.972 .
Translation: 淡马锡随后再次增持中国建设银行股份，去年8月以每股4.94港元从美国银行购入股份，并以每股2.972港元再次购入中国银行股份。

Query_Text_en: Temasek now has a roughly 7.5 % stake in CCB and 3.4 % in Bank of China .
Translation: 淡马锡目前持有中国建设银行约7.5%的股份以及中国银行3.4%的股份。

Query_Text_en: The fund has been a strategic investor in both lenders ahead of their Hong Kong initial public offerings .
Translation: 该基金在两家贷款机构的香港首次公开募股前一直是其战略投资者。

Query_Text_en: It was also a cornerstone investor in Agricultural Bank of China Ltd. 's record $ 22.1 billion IPO in 2010 .
Translation: 它也是中国农业银行股份有限公司2010年创纪录的221亿美元首次公开募股的基石投资者之一。

Query_Text_en: Western companies seeking to find their way into China 's largely state-run health-care system face heightened risks now that the Chinese government is planning to investigate drug-procurement and medical-device tendering .
Translation: 寻求进入中国以国有为主导的医疗体系的西方企业正面临更高风险，鉴于中国政府计划调查药品采购和医疗设备招标事宜。

Query_Text_en: The tendering and procurement process is opaque and fragmented , giving companies more headaches when they try to enter the market , experts said .
Translation: 专家表示，招标采购流程不透明且碎片化，导致企业在试图进入市场时面临更多困扰。

Query_Text_en: It becomes a bigger problem , given news that China 's government , according to recent reports , is going to start inspecting hospitals ' invoices in a bid to curb commercial bribery and money laundering during the procurement process .
Translation: 鉴于最近有报道称中国政府将开始检查医院的发票，以遏制采购过程中的商业贿赂和洗钱行为，这使得问题更加严重。

Query_Text_en: The problem is n't new , though .
Translation: 不过，这个问题并非新的。

Query_Text_en: In 2008 , the U.S. entered into a deferred-prosecution agreement with medical-device firm AGA Medical Corp. , fining it $ 2 million for paying bribes to doctors through its local Chinese distributor from 1997 to 2005 in exchange for their directing government-owned hospitals to purchase AGA products over those of its competitors .
Translation: 2008年，美国与医疗设备公司AGA Medical Corp.达成暂缓起诉协议，因其通过中国当地经销商在1997年至2005年间向医生行贿，以换取他们引导公立医院购买其产品而非竞争对手的产品，该公司被处以200万美元罚款。

Query_Text_en: There is a two-tiered system in the drug-procurement process that allows for ` rent-seeking behavior , ' said Lizheng Shi , a professor in Tulane University 's global health and development department .
Translation: 杜兰大学全球健康与发展系教授石立政（Lizheng Shi）指出，药品采购流程中存在一种双层体系，使得寻租行为得以发生。

Query_Text_en: The first tier , he said , is for essential medicine , mainly for primary-care facilities such as community health centers .
Translation: 他说，第一层是基本药物，主要面向基层医疗机构，例如社区卫生服务中心。

Query_Text_en: That process has been centralized .
Translation: 该流程已实现集中化处理。

Query_Text_en: But the other part , outside the essential medicine list , involves a lot of procurement done by hospitals and large health systems , Lizheng said .
Translation: 李政表示，而另一部分不在基本药物目录内，涉及大量由医院和大型医疗系统进行的采购活动。

Query_Text_en: Not all of the medicine is covered for reimbursement by the national insurance system , so some manufacturers might seek their way in through bribery , he said
Translation: 他表示，并非所有药物都能通过国家保险体系获得报销，因此一些制药企业可能会通过行贿手段寻求进入途径。

Query_Text_en: ` Outside of the essential-medicine list , procurement is very , very fragmented , ' Lizheng said .
Translation: “在基本药物目录之外，采购非常碎片化。”李政表示。

Query_Text_en: ` Even though the price setting is regulated by the government , usually there 's an allowance for markups and some profit-seeking behaviors . '
Translation: 尽管定价由政府调控，但通常会允许一定的加价空间及一些营利行为。

Query_Text_en: Last year , 3,030 people were punished for their roles in appropriation of government funds intended for drug procurement or other medical services , Xinhua reported last week .
Translation: 新华社上周报道，去年有3030人因挪用本应用于药品采购或其他医疗服务的政府资金而受到惩处。

Query_Text_en: The deals involved 32.9 million yuan -LRB- $ 5.23 million -RRB- .
Translation: 这些交易涉及人民币3290万元（约合523万美元）。

Query_Text_en: In many cases , the Xinhua report said , drug makers or sellers will bribe hospital staff into buying their products , and doctors will get kickbacks if they prescribe their drugs for patients .
Translation: 新华社报道指出，在许多情况下，制药企业或经销商会通过行贿诱使医院采购其产品，而医生若为患者开其药方也会获得回扣。

Query_Text_en: A similar problem exists in the medical-device industry , Lizheng said .
Translation: 李政表示，在医疗器械行业也存在类似的问题。

Query_Text_en: Government tendering for medical devices in China is implemented and regulated at different levels using different standards , increasing the difficulty in monitoring the tendering process , he said .
Translation: 他表示，我国政府采购医疗器械的招标工作由不同层级部门按照不同标准实施和监管，这增加了招标过程的监管难度。

Query_Text_en: With most of China 's health-care system being run by the state , everyone from hospital employees to doctors could be considered foreign officials under the U.S. Foreign Corrupt Practices Act .
Translation: 由于中国大部分医疗卫生体系由国家运营，从医院员工到医生等所有人员都可能被视为美国《反海外腐败法》认定的外国公职人员。

Query_Text_en: The law bars the use of bribes to foreign officials in order to seek or keep business , and bribery is a common occurrence in both industries .
Translation: 该法律禁止以向外国公职人员行贿的方式获取或维持商业利益，且贿赂行为在这两个行业中普遍存在。

Query_Text_en: ` It 's difficult to get these products into the hospitals if you 're not willing to give them free samples , take them out to dinner or treat them well , ' said Wendy Wysong , a partner for law firm Clifford Chance , based in Hong Kong .
Translation: “如果不愿意免费提供样品、宴请他们或给予优待，这些产品就很难进入医院，”香港Clifford Chance律师事务所的合伙人温迪·怀斯通说道。

Query_Text_en: The U.S. Justice Department has been in the middle of sweeping probes into both the pharmaceutical and medical-device industries .
Translation: 美国司法部目前正在对制药和医疗器械行业展开全面调查。

Query_Text_en: For example , in March , orthopedic manufacturer Biomet Inc. agreed to pay the U.S. $ 22 million to settle FCPA charges that the company paid more than $ 1.5 million in direct and indirect payments to employees of state-owned health-care providers in Argentina , Brazil and China to secure lucrative business with hospitals .
Translation: 例如，今年3月，骨科医疗设备制造商Biomet公司同意向美国支付2200万美元，以和解因向阿根廷、巴西和中国国有医疗机构员工支付超过150万美元直接和间接款项、从而获取医院有利可图业务而面临的《反海外腐败法》指控。

Query_Text_en: The company did n't enter a guilty plea , but accepted responsibility for the allegations laid out in court documents .
Translation: 该公司未认罪，但对法庭文件中载明的指控承担责任。

Query_Text_en: In many cases , companies use distributors to get access to Chinese hospitals .
Translation: 许多情况下，企业通过分销商进入中国医院。

Query_Text_en: The distributor working for Biomet , according to a complaint filed in the case , boasted of offering to send a Chinese doctor on a trip -- at the company 's expense -- to Switzerland to visit his daughter .
Translation: 根据该案诉讼文件显示，Biomet公司的一名分销商曾吹嘘称，将由公司承担费用，安排一名中国医生前往瑞士探望其女儿。

Query_Text_en: ` The cases become pretty easy under the FCPA ' when the conduct is that blatant , Wysong said .
Translation: 根据FCPA的规定，当行为如此明显时，这类案件的处理就相当容易了，Wysong表示。

Query_Text_en: She said companies are trying to find other ways to convince doctors that their products are the ones to use , including a study in which medical-device companies would distribute samples directly to hospitals so it could n't be seen as a bribe yet they still could get the product in the door .
Translation: 她说，企业正试图寻找其他方式来说服医生使用其产品，其中包括一项研究：医疗设备公司可直接向医院分发产品样品，既避免被视作贿赂，又能确保产品进入医院。

Query_Text_en: The idea was the topic of a 2009 Justice Department Opinion Procedure Release , which said such a program would n't bring about an enforcement action because it ` fall -LSB- s -RSB- outside the scope of the FCPA in that the donated products will be provided to the foreign government , as opposed to individual government officials . '
Translation: 该构想是美国司法部2009年一份意见程序发布中讨论的主题，该文件指出，此类项目不会引发执法行动，因为其"不属于《反海外腐败法》的适用范围，捐赠的产品是提供给外国政府的，而非向个别政府官员提供"。

Query_Text_en: When Indonesian tanker operator B.L.T. froze payments on $ 2 billion of debt earlier this year , blaming a global economic slowdown , the default hit some of the world 's biggest banks .
Translation: 今年早些时候，印尼油轮运营商B.L.T.因全球经济放缓冻结了20亿美元债务的支付，此次违约波及了全球部分最大银行。

Query_Text_en: PT Berlian Laju Tanker TBK counts among its creditors Britain 's Standard Chartered PLC , France 's BNP Paribas SA and Norway 's DnB .
Translation: PT伯利安拉祖油轮股份有限公司（PT Berlian Laju Tanker TBK）的债权人包括英国的标准渣打银行（Standard Chartered PLC）、法国的法国巴黎银行（BNP Paribas SA）和挪威的DNB银行（DnB）。

Query_Text_en: Despite relatively strong economic growth , risks for banks are growing in Asia .
Translation: 尽管经济增长相对强劲，但亚洲银行业风险正在加剧。

Query_Text_en: Among the risks are a big increase in lending in recent years , rising individual debt levels in the region , headwinds from the European debt crisis and a slowdown in China .
Translation: 风险包括近年来信贷扩张加剧、该地区个人债务水平上升、欧洲债务危机的冲击以及中国经济增速放缓。

Query_Text_en: Investors and analysts are watching the numbers closely , and while only a few see a big spike in bad debts , many are worried profits may be squeezed , particularly if there are more hiccups in the global economy .
Translation: 投资者和分析师正密切关注各项数据，虽然只有少数人认为不良债务会出现大幅激增，但许多人担心利润可能受到挤压，尤其是如果全球经济再出现更多波动的话。

Query_Text_en: Bankers across Asia agree losses will rise but only modestly .
Translation: 亚洲银行界普遍认为，未来损失将小幅上升。

Query_Text_en: ` There will be a slight increase in defaults and bad debts within the region because of the cycle change , ' said Australia and New Zealand Banking Co. Ltd. . Chief Executive Mike Smith .
Translation: “由于周期变化，该地区内的违约和坏账将略有增加，”澳大利亚和新西兰银行有限公司首席执行官迈克·史密斯表示。

Query_Text_en: Credit-rating agency Standard & Poor 's says the turning point in the credit cycle will come this year after two to three years of steady loan growth .
Translation: 标准普尔信用评级机构表示，在连续两到三年的贷款增长后，信贷周期的转折点将于今年出现。

Query_Text_en: ` In Asia the high growth of the economies has masked problems , ' said Naoko Nemoto , a credit analyst at S&P .
Translation: “在亚洲，经济的高速增长掩盖了问题，”标普信用分析师内本尚子表示。

Query_Text_en: Ms. Nemoto met with Singaporean , Chinese and Japanese banks recently that told her they expect nonperforming loans to tick higher this year .
Translation: 近日，根元女士与新加坡、中国和日本的银行会面，这些银行告诉她，他们预计今年不良贷款将有所增加。

Query_Text_en: ` Typically when loans are issued in a rapid manner , corners get cut , ' said Mike Werner , a senior analyst at Bernstein Research who expects to see a significant jump in bad loans across the region in late 2012 and early 2013 .
Translation: 伯恩斯坦研究公司高级分析师迈克·沃纳表示："通常在快速发放贷款时，就会出现疏漏。他预计该地区2012年底至2013年初不良贷款将显著增加。"

Query_Text_en: Distress is already showing -- from India 's cash-strapped Kingfisher Airlines Ltd. , to Chinese property developer Hangzhou Glory Real Estate Co. , which is in bankruptcy protection , to chipmaker Elpida Memory Inc. , Japan 's largest corporate failure among the nation 's manufacturers since the end of World War II .
Translation: 困境已现——从印度资金紧张的金奈航空有限公司，到获得破产保护的中国房地产开发商杭州辉耀地产有限公司，再到日本尔必达内存公司——这是二战以来日本制造业最大的企业破产案。

Query_Text_en: B.L.T. has estimated that US$ 418 million of payments were due this year on its bonds , loans and finance leases .
Translation: B.L.T.估计其债券、贷款及融资租赁今年应偿付的金额为4.18亿美元。

Query_Text_en: It is working on a debt restructuring with banks .
Translation: 其正与银行方面推进债务重组事宜。

Query_Text_en: Standard Chartered participated in a $ 685 million loan taken out by B.L.T. in 2011 .
Translation: 2011年，B.L.T.获得的一笔6.85亿美元贷款中，标准银行参与了该笔贷款。

Query_Text_en: One person familiar with the matter said it committed about $ 115 million and that lenders generally have been unable to sell the loan .
Translation: 一位知情人士表示，其已投入约1.15亿美元，而贷款方通常未能成功处置该笔贷款。

Query_Text_en: Some loan bankers say that they are becoming pickier , screening out prospective borrowers in sectors where they think growth is slowing .
Translation: 一些贷款银行家表示，他们正变得更加挑剔，开始筛选并排除那些他们认为所在行业增长放缓的潜在借款人。

Query_Text_en: Stiffer competition for the higher-quality borrowers could also start to squeeze margins , analysts say .
Translation: 分析人士指出，优质借款人领域的竞争加剧也可能开始挤压利润空间。

Query_Text_en: To be sure , Asian banks are adequately capitalized , economic growth remains faster than in the U.S. and Europe , and nonperforming loans are rising from very low levels .
Translation: 诚然，亚洲银行业资本充足，经济增长仍快于美国和欧洲，不良贷款虽有所上升但仍处于较低水平。

Query_Text_en: Nonperforming loan ratios are 73 % below their long-term average in Asia , with some countries at 1 % or lower , according to brokerage CLSA Asia Pacific Markets .
Translation: 根据CLSA亚洲太平洋市场经纪公司的数据，亚洲地区的不良贷款率比长期平均水平低73%，其中部分国家的比率在1%或以下。

Query_Text_en: CLSA has said it expects nonperforming loans to turn sharply higher this year .
Translation: CLSA表示，预计今年不良贷款将显著增加。

Query_Text_en: At the same time , warning signs are showing up for some global banks that are big lenders in Asia , such as Standard Chartered , HSBC Holdings PLC and Citigroup Inc. .
Translation: 与此同时，渣打银行、汇丰控股和花旗集团等在亚洲地区大量放贷的全球性银行开始出现警示信号。

Query_Text_en: Standard Chartered saw an uptick in early warnings that loans might go bad across the Asia-Pacific region in 2011 from a year earlier .
Translation: 2011年较上年同期，渣打银行注意到亚太地区贷款可能出现违约的早期预警信号有所增加。

Query_Text_en: In commentary on Wednesday on the first few months of this year , it noted loan impairments , the amount of the loan the lender may not recoup from the borrower , were above the level seen a year earlier as a result of a bigger loan book and a change in product mix .
Translation: 该机构在周三对今年头几个月的评论中指出，由于贷款规模扩大和产品结构变化，贷款减值金额高于去年同期水平。

Query_Text_en: It did n't provide numbers .
Translation: 该报告未提供具体数据。

Query_Text_en: Responding to an analyst 's question on whether there had been deterioration in asset quality , Standard Chartered Group Finance Director Richard Meddings said , ` Overall the credit portfolio is behaving very well . '
Translation: 在回应分析师关于资产质量是否恶化的提问时，标准渣打集团财务总监理查德·梅德蒙斯表示："整体信贷资产组合表现良好。"

Query_Text_en: Bernstein analysts say Standard Chartered 's rapid loan growth has masked the growth of possible problem loans .
Translation: 伯恩斯坦分析师指出，渣打银行贷款的快速增长掩盖了潜在不良贷款的增长。

Query_Text_en: As loan growth slows , it expects impairments to double to around 0.70 percentage point this year from a year earlier , contributing to a fall in earnings per share of 25 % to 30 % year-on-year .
Translation: 随着贷款增速放缓，预计今年减值损失将较上年同期翻倍至约0.70个百分点，导致每股收益同比将下降25%至30%。

Query_Text_en: Analysts see Standard Chartered as more vulnerable to market reaction than HSBC , which scaled back lending last year and whose shares trade at 1.1 times book value versus 1.4 times for Standard Chartered
Translation: 分析师认为，与汇丰银行相比，渣打银行更容易受到市场反应的影响。汇丰银行去年缩减了贷款业务，其股价目前为账面价值的1.1倍，而渣打银行的股价则为1.4倍。

Query_Text_en: But even at HSBC , there were some warning signs .
Translation: 但即便在汇丰银行，也出现了一些预警信号。

Query_Text_en: HSBC has reported that the amount set aside for loan losses fell $ 1.9 billion in 2011 to $ 12.1 billion from a year earlier as the group restructured .
Translation: 汇丰银行报告称，随着该集团进行重组，2011年贷款损失拨备金额较上年减少19亿美元，降至121亿美元。

Query_Text_en: But it rose 36 % year-on-year in Hong Kong to US$ 156 million .
Translation: 但香港同比增长36%，达到1.56亿美元。

Query_Text_en: HSBC said in its annual report that in the rest of Asia outside Hong Kong : ` We remain cautious on the outlook for credit quality . '
Translation: 汇丰在其年度报告中表示，在亚洲其他地区（不包括香港）：「我们对信贷质量前景继续保持谨慎。」

Query_Text_en: Analysts will be looking closely when HSBC reports first-quarter results next week .
Translation: 当汇丰银行下周公布第一季度业绩时，分析师们将密切关注。

Query_Text_en: After a multiyear downward trend in the volume of nonperforming loans on its books at Citicorp , which comprises the company 's operating divisions , possible signs of stress emerged in Citi 's first-quarter results for Asia .
Translation: 在花旗集团（由其运营部门组成）的账面上，不良贷款量经历了多年的下降趋势后，其亚洲业务第一季度财报中出现了可能出现的运营压力迹象。

Query_Text_en: The New York company 's loans in the region have swollen by a third over the year to institutions .
Translation: 这家纽约公司在该地区向机构发放的贷款在过去一年中增长了三分之一。

Query_Text_en: But Citi 's loans to companies placed on watch by credit risk officers rose 49 % to $ 499 million in the first quarter from the fourth quarter and loans to consumers on watch were up 5 % to $ 474 million over the same period .
Translation: 但花旗银行向信贷风险管理人员列为观察对象的企业提供的贷款在第一季度环比增长49%，达到4.99亿美元，同期向被列为观察对象的消费者提供的贷款也增长5%，增至4.74亿美元。

Query_Text_en: TFacebook Inc. pulled back the curtain on how much it thinks it 's worth , targeting a valuation as rich as $ 96 billion in what would be a record technology debut .
Translation: Facebook公司披露了其自我估值预期，目标估值高达960亿美元，此次可能创下纪录的科技公司首次公开募股。

Query_Text_en: Eight-year-old Facebook would become the most valuable U.S. technology company at the time of an IPO , exceeding Google Inc. 's $ 23 billion valuation in 2004 .
Translation: 在首次公开募股时，成立八年的Facebook将成为当时美国最有价值的科技公司，其估值超过谷歌公司2004年的230亿美元。

Query_Text_en: At nearly $ 100 billion , it would also rival the current market values of more established companies including Amazon.com Inc. and McDonald 's Corp. , and longtime tech giants like Hewlett-Packard Co. , despite having a fraction of the revenue -- or profit .
Translation: 接近1000亿美元的市值也将与亚马逊公司、麦当劳公司等规模更大的企业以及惠普公司等老牌科技巨头当前的市值相抗衡，尽管其收入或利润仅为这些公司的零头。

Query_Text_en: Facebook 's IPO will be a watershed moment for Silicon Valey , spawning a new generation of millionaires , and a handful of billionaires , including founder and Chief Executive Mark Zuckerberg , whose stake is worth as much as $ 18.7 billion .
Translation: Facebook的首次公开募股将成为硅谷的一个分水岭时刻，催生新一代百万富翁以及数位亿万富翁，其中包括创始人兼首席执行官马克·扎克伯格，其持有的股份价值高达187亿美元。

Query_Text_en: It will also stand out even among the wave of high-profile Internet IPOs in the past year from companies such as LinkedIn Corp. and Zynga Inc. .
Translation: 即使是在过去一年中领英公司（LinkedIn Corp.）和Zynga公司（Zynga Inc.）等企业掀起的备受关注的互联网公司IPO浪潮中，它也将脱颖而出。

Query_Text_en: But while the social network is growing rapidly -- more than 900 million people now use the site -- there are questions whether its trajectory is slowing .
Translation: 虽然该社交媒体平台用户数已突破9亿，但对其增长轨迹是否正在放缓存在质疑。

Query_Text_en: Its revenue in the latest quarter rose 45 % from a year ago , but fell 6 % from the previous three months .
Translation: 其最新季度营收较上年同期增长45%，但较上一季度下降6%。

Query_Text_en: Among Facebook 's challenges will be convincing skeptical marketers that ads on its site lead to people buying products .
Translation: Facebook面临的挑战之一将是说服持怀疑态度的营销人员相信其网站上的广告能促使人们购买产品。

Query_Text_en: In addition , Facebook lags in the fast-growing mobile market , where Google has gained significant influence with its Android software .
Translation: 此外，Facebook在快速增长的移动市场中处于落后地位，而谷歌凭借其安卓系统在此领域获得了显著影响力。

Query_Text_en: And Facebook has little presence in China , home to the world 's largest population of Internet users .
Translation: 而Facebook在中国——这个拥有全球最大互联网用户群体的国家——的存在感微弱。

Query_Text_en: A lot is also riding on investors who bought into Facebook at outsized valuations , believing the company would continue its rapid growth .
Translation: 许多因素也取决于那些以过高估值投资Facebook的投资者，他们相信公司会继续实现快速增长。

Query_Text_en: Facebook said Thursday it is targeting an initial stock price of $ 28 to $ 35 .
Translation: Facebook于周四表示，计划将首次公开募股定价区间定为每股28至35美元。

Query_Text_en: Some investors had expected an even higher value and had earlier this year bid up Facebook 's stock on private-company stock exchanges like SharesPost , where the social network 's shares last cleared at more than $ 44 .
Translation: 一些投资者原本预期估值会更高，并在今年早些时候在SharesPost等私人公司股票交易所抬高了Facebook的股价，而该社交网络的股份最后一次成交价超过44美元。

Query_Text_en: If Facebook ends up going public at the lower end of its price range -- suggesting a valuation of $ 77 billion -- that would mean an immediate loss for investors like Kevin Landis of San Jose , Calif. , tech investment fund Firsthand Capital .
Translation: 若Facebook最终以定价区间的低端上市——意味着估值约为770亿美元——这将导致加州圣何塞科技投资基金Firsthand Capital的凯文·兰迪斯等投资者立即面临亏损。

Query_Text_en: Mr. Landis bought shares of Facebook on the secondary market for $ 31 to $ 32 a share over the last year and agreed not to sell the shares for six months after the IPO .
Translation: 兰迪斯先生在过去一年中以每股31至32美元的价格在二级市场购入了Facebook股票，并承诺在IPO后六个月内不抛售这些股份。

Query_Text_en: ` I 've been surprised before , but I 'll be surprised again if it ends up pricing at that low end of that range , ' said Mr. Landis .
Translation: “我之前已经多次感到意外，但如果最终定价落在该区间的低端，我还会再次感到意外，”兰迪斯先生表示。

Query_Text_en: He adds he is n't worried yet , partly because the low range may be a tactic to build excitement for the IPO .
Translation: 他表示目前并不担心，部分原因在于较低的定价区间可能是为了营造首次公开募股的市场热度而采取的策略。

Query_Text_en: Facebook will narrow down a specific price before its first day of trading on May 18 , by which time investor interest could cause bankers to raise the price even higher .
Translation: Facebook将在5月18日上市交易首日前确定具体发行价，届时投资者兴趣高涨可能促使承销商进一步上调价格。

Query_Text_en: With the pricing , Facebook is anticipated to raise as much as $ 13.6 billion , above earlier expectations of $ 10 billion .
Translation: 随着此次定价，Facebook预计筹集高达136亿美元，超过了此前预计的100亿美元。

Query_Text_en: In a regulatory filing , Facebook said the company would seek to sell 337.4 million shares , with about half of those being sold by founders , employees and investors .
Translation: Facebook在一份监管文件中表示，该公司计划出售3.374亿股股票，其中约有一半将由公司创始人、员工及投资者出售。

Query_Text_en: The only U.S. issuers that have raised more money in an IPO were Visa Inc. at $ 19.7 billion in 2008 and General Motors Co. at $ 18.1 billion in 2010 .
Translation: 在首次公开募股（IPO）中融资金额超过其他美国发行方的仅有两家公司，分别是2008年的Visa公司（197亿美元）和2010年的通用汽车公司（181亿美元）。

Query_Text_en: Mr. Zuckerberg , who founded Facebook in his Harvard University dorm room in 2004 , is selling 30.2 million shares in the offering that could pocket him over $ 1 billion .
Translation: 扎克伯格于2004年在哈佛大学宿舍创立了Facebook，此次出售将使他通过抛售3020万股股份获得超过10亿美元收益。

Query_Text_en: Facebook says he is selling to pay taxes on his stake in the company .
Translation: Facebook表示，他正在出售股份以缴纳相关税款。

Query_Text_en: He would be left with as much as $ 17.6 billion worth of shares .
Translation: 他将持有价值高达176亿美元的股份。

Query_Text_en: Mr. Zuckerberg will also control approximately 57.3 % of the voting power of Facebook 's outstanding stock following the offering .
Translation: 此次发行后，扎克伯格先生还将控制Facebook大约57.3%的已发行股票投票权。

Query_Text_en: Chris Baggini , a fund manager for the Berwyn , Penn.-based Turner Investment Partners , said he plans to buy stock in the Facebook IPO and thinks even if the company prices on the high end of its range , it would be a discount .
Translation: 宾夕法尼亚州伯温市特纳投资合伙人公司的基金经理克里斯·巴吉尼表示，他计划购买Facebook首次公开募股的股票，并认为即使该公司以价格区间的高端定价，仍属折价。

Query_Text_en: He anticipates Facebook will be worth $ 200 billion within four years .
Translation: 他预计Facebook的市值将在四年内达到2000亿美元。

Query_Text_en: ` We already have a business model out there that 's similar to what their business model is going to look like and that 's Google , ' said Mr. Baggini , who calls Facebook 's business ` incredible . '
Translation: Baggini先生表示："我们已经存在一种与脸书未来将采取的商业模式类似的模式，即谷歌。"他称脸书的商业模式"令人惊叹"。

Query_Text_en: Others were more cautious .
Translation: 另一些则更加谨慎。

Query_Text_en: To sustain Facebook 's valuation , Jed Williams , an analyst with BIA Kelsey , said the company would need to grow revenue at 41 % each year in the next five years .
Translation: 为了维持Facebook的估值，BIA Kelsey分析师杰德·威廉姆斯表示，该公司未来五年每年的收入增长率需达到41%。

Query_Text_en: Morningstar 's Mr. Summer said the only way to justify even the low end of Facebook 's valuation would require the company to make $ 40 billion in revenue within the next six to seven years , while maintaining the same profit margins .
Translation: 晨星公司的Summer先生表示，即使要证明Facebook较低端估值的合理性，也需要该公司在未来六到七年之内实现400亿美元的营收，同时保持相同的利润率。

Query_Text_en: Facebook 's revenue in 2011 was $ 3.7 billion and profit margin was 27 % .
Translation: 2011年，Facebook的收入为37亿美元，利润率为27%。

Query_Text_en: The company will also need to expand into other areas like e-commerce or payments in order to support its valuation , analysts said .
Translation: 分析师表示，该公司还需拓展电子商务或支付等其他领域以支撑其估值。

Query_Text_en: Right now , Facebook 's payments business is limited to social game companies , with Zynga Inc. making the bulk of those payments .
Translation: 目前，Facebook的支付业务仅面向社交游戏公司，其中Zynga公司贡献了绝大部分收入。

Query_Text_en: Facebook 's ad business , which accounted for 85 % of the company 's total revenue last year , has been tricky as the social network has struggled to balance the needs of advertisers , who want more room for display ads on the site , while trying to maintain the quality of the experience for users , who dislike ads .
Translation: Facebook的广告业务去年占公司总收入的85%，但在平衡广告主需求与用户体验质量方面面临挑战。广告主希望网站能提供更多展示广告空间，而用户对广告普遍存在抵触情绪，影响了使用体验的质量。

Query_Text_en: Facebook is also trying to find new ways for advertisers to cough up big bucks , since much of the advertising on the site can be done for free through brand pages that accumulate fans .
Translation: 由于该网站上的许多广告可以通过品牌主页积累粉丝的方式免费进行，Facebook正试图寻找让广告商投入更多资金的新途径。

Query_Text_en: In March , Facebook made its biggest push to get advertisers to pay through a product called ` Reach Generator , ' which helps advertisers reach 75 % of its fans on the site .
Translation: 三月份，Facebook推出名为《触达生成器》的产品，最大力度吸引广告商付费，该产品可帮助广告商触达其平台上75%的粉丝群体。

Query_Text_en: Facebook also has limited ways to make money off its mobile app , despite nearly half of its 900 million users accessing the site through the app .
Translation: 尽管Facebook近9亿用户中约半数通过移动应用访问该网站，但其在移动应用上的盈利方式仍较为有限。

Query_Text_en: Facebook also has limited mobile advertising .
Translation: Facebook在移动端广告方面也存在限制。

Query_Text_en: Last month , however , the social network agreed to pay $ 1 billion to acquire mobile photo-sharing app Instagram .
Translation: 然而，这家社交媒体公司上月同意支付10亿美元收购移动照片分享应用Instagram。

Query_Text_en: Hussein Fazal , CEO of Facebook ad company Adparlor Inc. , said the amount advertisers pay for every 1,000 people who view an ad is relatively low on Facebook , at 25 cents to 30 cents .
Translation: Facebook广告公司Adparlor Inc.首席执行官侯赛因·法祖尔表示，在Facebook平台上，广告商为每千名观看广告的用户支付的费用相对较低，具体为25美分至30美分。

Query_Text_en: Mr. Fazal said it will be a challenge for Facebook to increase those rates , but they could increase the volume of ads if the company expands its ads into areas like mobile , he said .
Translation: 法扎尔表示，提高广告费率对Facebook而言将是一个挑战，不过他指出，如果该公司将广告业务拓展至移动端等领域，可以增加广告投放量。

Query_Text_en: Meanwhile , Facebook has said international markets are essential sources for significant growth .
Translation: 与此同时，Facebook表示，国际市场是其实现显著增长的重要来源。

Query_Text_en: But the social network is mostly blocked in China , leaving hundreds of millions of Internet users out of reach .
Translation: 但由于该社交网络在中国主要被封锁，导致数亿互联网用户无法访问。

Query_Text_en: Facebook is likely about two weeks away from a final pricing and the first trading of its shares on the Nasdaq Stock Market , under the symbol FB .
Translation: Facebook距离最终确定股票定价及在纳斯达克证券市场首次公开交易大约还有两周时间，股票代码为FB。

Query_Text_en: The ` roadshow , ' where the company pitches its shares to investors , is expected to begin Monday with group lunch meetings for investors planned in New York , Boston and Palo Alto , Calif. , hotels .
Translation: 该公司推介股份的路演活动预计将于周一启动，投资者团体午餐会计划在纽约、波士顿以及加利福尼亚州帕洛阿尔托的酒店举行。

Query_Text_en: Facebook Chief Operating Officer Sheryl Sandberg and Chief Financial Officer David Ebersman will handle most of the investor meetings on the roadshow , said people familiar with the matter .
Translation: 据知情人士透露，Facebook首席运营官雪莉·桑德伯格和首席财务官大卫·埃伯斯曼将负责此次路演期间的大部分投资者会议。

Query_Text_en: Mr. Zuckerberg will make just a few appearances , they said .
Translation: 他们表示，扎克伯格先生将仅公开露面几次。

Query_Text_en: On Thursday , however , Mr. Zuckerberg appeared in an video for investors .
Translation: 然而，周四，扎克伯格现身于一段面向投资者的视频中。

Query_Text_en: Wearing jeans and a t-shirt , the 27-year-old discussed why he decided to start the social network .
Translation: 穿着牛仔裤和T恤，这位27岁的人解释了自己为何决定创建社交网络。

Query_Text_en: ' I grew up with the Internet , when I was in middle school I was using search engines like Google and Yahoo , ' he said . ' I thought it was the most amazing thing . Now you have access to all this information . The thing that was missing was just people . '
Translation: 我是和互联网一起成长的，"他说，"中学时我就在使用谷歌和雅虎这样的搜索引擎。我觉得那是最棒的事情。现在你可以接触到海量信息，但缺失的恰恰是人与人之间的互动。

Query_Text_en: Morgan Stanley , J.P. Morgan Chase & Co. and Goldman Sachs Group Inc. are the lead underwriters .
Translation: 摩根士丹利、摩根大通和高盛集团是主承销商。

Query_Text_en: Bank of America Merrill Lynch , Barclays PLC , Allen & Co. , Citigroup Inc. , Credit Suisse Group AG and Deutsche Bank Securities are the other bookrunners on the IPO , in addition to which 24 firms are co-managers .
Translation: 美银美林、巴克莱银行、艾伦公司、花旗集团、瑞士信贷集团及德意志银行证券为此次IPO的其他主承销商，此外还有24家机构担任联合经理。

Query_Text_en: The hazards of sight-seeing in China are no secret : epic crowds , megaphone-toting guides and aggressive touts .
Translation: 在中国旅游的隐患众所周知：人潮汹涌、手持扩音器的导游以及咄咄逼人的小贩。

Query_Text_en: Now , a series of reports in state media are lambasting another unwelcome surprise that often awaits visitors -- the meteoric rise in admission prices .
Translation: 目前，一系列媒体报道正在抨击游客常会遇到的另一个不速之客——门票价格的急剧攀升。

Query_Text_en: These days , a ticket to enter many Chinese tourist locations -- even more humdrum sights in second-tier cities -- can cost you more than a trip to the Louvre or , say , Mt. Fiji .
Translation: 如今，进入许多中国旅游景点——甚至二线城市的一些寻常景点——的门票费用，可能比参观卢浮宫或富士山的行程费用还要高。

Query_Text_en: That 's because local governments lean heavily on such public sight-seeing spots to fill their coffers , say industry experts .
Translation: 行业专家指出，地方政府之所以这样做，是因为他们严重依赖这些公共景点来充实财政收入。

Query_Text_en: To take one example , the price of one ticket to see the pretty village of Taierzhuang , between Beijing and Shanghai , has more than tripled in just two years .
Translation: 以台儿庄为例，这座位于北京和上海之间的美丽村庄，其参观门票价格在过去两年间已上涨了三倍多。

Query_Text_en: As China 's tourism industry booms , other price hikes are likely to follow : the Global Times , a tabloid run by the Communist Party-backed People 's Daily , reports that price increases this year could range from 20 % to a hefty 100 % .
Translation: 随着中国旅游业的蓬勃发展，其他领域的价格上涨可能随之而来：由中国共产党支持的《人民日报》旗下《环球时报》报道指出，今年的价格涨幅可能介于20%到高达100%之间。

Query_Text_en: ` In theory , scenic areas are public property , but this is a naive viewpoint , ' Zhang Lingyun , vice-dean of the tourism institute of Beijing Union University , tells People 's Daily . ` In reality , the local government usually treats these natural resources as cash cows to revitalize the local economy . '
Translation: 北京联合大学旅游学院副院长张玲云在接受《人民日报》采访时指出："理论上景区属于公共财产，但这是一种天真的观点。实际上，地方政府通常将这些自然资源视为摇钱树来振兴当地经济。"

Query_Text_en: Or take another high-priced destination : a visit to the Jiuzhaigou park in Western China , whose aqua and rainbow-hued waters have attracted growing hordes of visitors in recent years . An entry ticket during prime season will set you back 220 yuan , while a bus to get around the park will cost you another 90 yuan .
Translation: 另一个高消费旅游目的地是中国西部的九寨沟景区，其碧蓝与彩虹色的水域近年来吸引了越来越多的游客。旺季期间，景区门票需花费220元，而用于在公园内游览的巴士还需另付90元。

Query_Text_en: That 's a total cost of nearly $ 50 .
Translation: 总成本近50美元。

Query_Text_en: During this past Labor Day holiday in China this week , many Chinese tourists took to the Internet to voice their disgust over ever-rising ticket prices . ` Traveling is just too painful .
Translation: 在刚刚过去的五一假期期间，许多中国游客纷纷通过网络表达对门票价格不断上涨的不满，"旅游实在太痛苦了。"

Query_Text_en: Ticket prices , travel fees , the cost of oil ... Better to stay at home and buy stuff online or watch movies in comfort , ' wrote one user .
Translation: 票价、旅行费用、油价……不如待在家里网购或舒适观影。一名用户写道。

Query_Text_en: ` Ai , going to Putuoshan -LSB- a Buddhist island southeast of Shanghai described in tourist promotions as ` magic , holy and mysterious ' -RSB- , I resent the government for being just too wicked . These ticket prices are so deathly expensive , ' sighed another .
Translation: 去普陀山——这座位于上海东南方向的佛教圣地，旅游宣传中被描述为“神奇、神圣、神秘”——时，我怨恨政府太过分了。“这些门票价格高得离谱，”另一人叹息道。

Query_Text_en: Nearly half of tourist destinations had ticket prices in excess of 100 yuan -LRB- $ 15.90 -RRB- .
Translation: 近半数旅游景点的门票价格超过100元（约合15.90美元）。

Query_Text_en: Meanwhile this past week , visitors battled another inclement force in Chinese tourism : unforgivingly massive crowds .
Translation: 与此同时，过去一周，游客们又遭遇了中国旅游业的另一大挑战——汹涌的人潮。

Query_Text_en: The number of visitors trooping through Beijing 's Forbidden City this past Sunday rose by 26 % compared to the year prior .
Translation: 与去年同期相比，上周日参观北京故宫的游客数量增长了26%。

Query_Text_en: In fact , the crowds have become so overwhelming that China 's government has even launched a meter to give tourists an online index of the number of visitors at major tourist sites -- updated hourly -- for would-be tourists to consult before heading out to brave the masses .
Translation: 事实上，游客数量已变得如此庞大，中国政府甚至推出了游客流量监测系统，在线实时发布主要旅游景点的游客数量指数（每小时更新），供计划出行的游客在游览前参考，以避开高峰人群。

Query_Text_en: Chinese officials in high-level talks with U.S. counterparts agreed to negotiate limits of export funding for state-owned firms and increase the equity stake foreign firms can take in the securities trading ventures , said a senior administration official .
Translation: 一位高级政府官员表示，中方官员在与美方对应官员的高层会谈中达成一致，将就国有企业出口资金的限制进行磋商，并提高外资在证券业务相关合资企业中可持有的股权比例。

Query_Text_en: The willingness to make substantial economic changes suggests officials recognize what economists both inside and outside the country say is China 's need for an ` economic rebalancing ' so that it bases strategies for future growth more around consumer spending rather than exports and state investment .
Translation: 官员表现出推进重大经济改革的意愿，表明他们认识到国内外经济学家指出的中国需要实现"经济再平衡"，即未来增长策略应更多围绕消费而非出口和政府投资。

Query_Text_en: Chinese officials also are moving to put some limits on the operations of state-owned firms , which have been criticized abroad for unfair competition and at home for monopoly practices .
Translation: 中国官方正着手对国有企业经营活动进行一定限制，这些企业此前因在国外从事不公平竞争及在国内存在垄断行为遭到国内外批评。

Query_Text_en: For instance , the administration official said , China would commit to raising the dividends paid by Chinese state-owned firms so they are comparable to the dividends paid by private firms .
Translation: 例如，这位政府官员表示，中国政府承诺提高国有企业支付的红利，使其与民营企业相当。

Query_Text_en: The additional payouts would go to the Chinese national budget where the funds could be used to finance social spending .
Translation: 追加支付款项将进入中国国家预算，其中资金可用于支持社会支出。

Query_Text_en: The hope , often expressed by Chinese economists , is that having a firmer social safety net would encourage Chinese consumers to spend more .
Translation: 中国经济学家普遍认为，建立更完善的社会保障网将促进中国消费者增加支出。

Query_Text_en: During the two-day meeting of the Strategic and Economic Dialogue on Thursday -- annual talks between Chinese and U.S. economic and security officials -- China signaled more willingness to discuss far-reaching economic reforms than it had been in some time , the official said .
Translation: 一位官员表示，在周四举行的为期两天的战略与经济对话会议上——这是中美两国经济和安全官员的年度会谈——中国比以往一段时间以来表现出了更大意愿，愿意讨论范围广泛的经济改革。

Query_Text_en: The Obama administration has worried that the once-a-decade leadership change in China that begins later this year -- compounded by the upheaval caused by the ouster of senior Chinese official Bo Xilai -- might prompt the Chinese to pull back .

For China , shifting its economic strategy so it relied more on domestic consumption could help provide a firmer foundation for growth over the coming years . For the U.S. , the change could boost U.S. exports to China and ease Chinese competition .
Translation: 对于中国而言，调整经济战略，更多依靠国内消费，可能为未来数年的经济增长奠定更坚实的基础。对于美国而言，这一调整可能促进美国对华出口，并缓解来自中国的竞争压力。

Query_Text_en: ` China must rely more on domestic consumption rather than exports , and more on innovation by private companies rather than capacity expansion by state owned enterprises , ' U.S. Treasury Secretary Timothy Geithner said at the start of the discussion .
Translation: 美国财政部长蒂莫西·盖特纳在讨论开始时说：“中国必须更多地依靠国内消费而非出口，更多地依靠私营企业的创新而非国有企业的产能扩张。”

Query_Text_en: Chinese Vice Premier Wang Qishan made clear the priority China attaches to the talks .
Translation: 王岐山副总理阐明了中方对会谈的高度重视。

Query_Text_en: ` Our countries should make the most of the platform provided by the dialogue to make the most of cooperation in trade , investment , finance , infrastructure , science and technology , ' he said .
Translation: 我们应该充分利用对话机制提供的平台，深化在贸易、投资、金融、基础设施及科技等领域的合作。

Query_Text_en: The Obama administration has been focusing on competition posed by Chinese state-owned firms .
Translation: 奥巴马政府一直关注中国国有企业带来的竞争挑战。

Query_Text_en: U.S. and European companies complain that such competitors get subsidies and low-cost financing that are n't available to private firms .
Translation: 美国和欧洲企业抱怨称，这些竞争对手获得了私营企业无法获取的补贴和低成本融资。

Query_Text_en: The senior official said that Chinese economic officials have agreed to negotiate new international convention with a number of countries regarding export financing .
Translation: 这位高级官员表示，中国经贸官员已同意与多国就出口融资问题磋商新的国际协议。

Query_Text_en: The official said that China was n't willing to join an Organization of Economic Cooperation and Development accord on the subject because it is n't a member of the OECD .
Translation: 该官员表示，中国不愿加入经济合作与发展组织（OECD）就此达成的相关协议，由于中国并非该组织成员国。

Query_Text_en: But a new deal is likely to have similar provisions .
Translation: 但新的协议可能会包含类似条款。

Query_Text_en: Having state-owned firms pay out more of their earnings as dividends , that too would reduce advantages they have compared with their private-sector competitors , the official said .
Translation: 一位官员表示，要求国有企业将更多利润以红利形式上缴，也能减少其相对于私营企业竞争对手的优势。

Query_Text_en: On the financial sector front , the U.S. official said the Chinese have agreed to let foreign firms own as much as 49 % of joint ventures involved in brokerage services and securities trading -- and to speed up approvals .
Translation: 在金融领域方面，美国官员表示，中方已同意允许外资企业在涉及经纪服务和证券交易的合资企业中最高持股比例达到49%，并加快相关审批流程。

Query_Text_en: Currently , foreign firms are limited to a 33 % stake .
Translation: 目前，外资企业持股不得超过33%。

Query_Text_en: Similarly firms engaged in trading commodities and financial futures would be able to take a 49 % stake in joint ventures .
Translation: 同样地，从事大宗商品和金融期货交易的企业将能够持有合资企业49%的股份。

Query_Text_en: The current rules concerning such stakes are ambiguous , the official said .
Translation: 该官员表示，目前关于此类股份的规定存在模糊之处。

Query_Text_en: Auto companies would also have greater ability to provide auto financing , the official said .
Translation: 该官员表示，汽车公司将具备更强的汽车金融服务能力。

Query_Text_en: As in most U.S.-China economic meetings in the past few years , the value of the yuan was raised by the U.S. , which pressed China to let the currency rise further .
Translation: 正如过去几年大多数中美经济会议那样，人民币汇率问题由美方提出，并敦促中国允许人民币进一步升值。

Query_Text_en: China as usual said it was moving in that direction .
Translation: 中国一如既往地表示正在朝这一方向推进。

Query_Text_en: As in the past before an international economic meeting , the Chinese central bank pushed the value of the yuan higher starting a few days ahead of the talks , and the U.S. said that greater appreciation was in the interests of China as a way of boosting consumer purchasing power .
Translation: 与往次国际经济会议前的做法一致，中国央行在会谈前几天就开始推动人民币升值，美国方面则表示，人民币进一步升值符合中国的利益，有助于提升消费者购买力。

Query_Text_en: But the discussions had more of a pro forma quality than in the past because the basis for the U.S. complaints -- an immense Chinese trade surplus -- is fading .
Translation: 但由于美国提出批评的基础——中国巨额贸易顺差——正在逐渐消失，如今的讨论更多流于形式，不像以往那样深入。

Query_Text_en: The International Monetary Fund estimates that China 's current-account surplus , the broadest measure of trade , would slip to 2.3 % of GDP this year , well below 4 % of GDP , a level that Mr. Geithner suggested in 2010 indicated an undervalued currency .
Translation: 国际货币基金组织预计，中国今年的经常账户顺差（作为贸易收支的最广泛衡量指标）将降至国内生产总值（GDP）的2.3%，远低于GDP的4%这一水平；而盖特纳曾在2010年指出，该水平表明人民币被低估。

Query_Text_en: As a city that gets the vast majority of its food and water from mainland China , Hong Kong is no stranger to food-safety fears .
Translation: 作为绝大多数食品和水源都依赖中国大陆供应的城市，香港对食品安全问题并不陌生。

Query_Text_en: Smithfield Inc. worked together with Million -LRB- Far East -RRB- Ltd in 2009 to create the product specifically for the Hong Kong market , he said .
Translation: 他表示，2009年，史密斯菲尔德公司与百万（远东）有限公司合作，专门针对香港市场开发了该产品。

Query_Text_en: While the former British colony returned to Chinese rule in 1997 , it has remained largely self-governing and continues to operate with its own independent political and economic system .
According to company statements , Shuanghui slaughters some 15 million pigs a year .
Translation: 根据公司资料显示，双汇每年屠宰约1500万头猪。

Query_Text_en: A look at past Chinese purchases suggests that the answer is likely , ` Yes . '
Translation: 从中国过去的采购情况来看，答案很可能是"是的"。

Query_Text_en: Chinese companies have stumbled in efforts to build homegrown brands in areas ranging from autos to tennis shoes .
Translation: 中国公司在从汽车到运动鞋等多个领域打造自主品牌的过程中步履维艰。

Query_Text_en: But with a few hitches -- notably Volvo 's in the sputtering European car market -- the companies have managed to keep existing global brands healthy by investing and persuading senior managers to stay on board .
Translation: 但尽管存在一些波折——尤其是沃尔沃在萎靡的欧洲汽车市场中的表现——这些企业仍通过持续投资和说服高管团队留任，成功维持了现有全球品牌的健康发展。

Query_Text_en: ` There has been initial concern about quality when foreign companies have been acquired by companies in developing markets , but the concerns fade over time , ' said Jon Parker , a mergers-and-acquisitions partner at KPMG China .
Translation: 毕马威中国并购业务合伙人Jon Parker表示："当外国企业被发展中国家的企业收购时，最初曾引发对质量的担忧，但这些担忧会随着时间推移逐渐消退。"

Query_Text_en: Many Chinese companies are able to expand foreign brands while leveraging their own manufacturing strengths , streamlining costs and production , he said .
Translation: 他表示，许多中国企业在拓展国外品牌的同时，能够发挥自身制造优势，优化成本与生产流程。

Query_Text_en: That track record offers a positive sign for Shuanghui International Holdings Ltd. . On Wednesday it unveiled a $ 4.7 billion deal to acquire Smithfield Foods Inc. , which supplies U.S. supermarkets with Smithfield Ham , Eckrich sausages , Armour meatballs and Farmland bacon .
Translation: 这一业绩记录为双汇国际控股有限公司提供了积极信号。周三，该公司宣布将以47亿美元收购史密斯菲尔德食品公司，后者向美国超市供应史密斯菲尔德火腿、埃克里奇香肠、阿麦鲁肉丸和农场牌熏肉等产品。

Query_Text_en: Shuanghui has stressed that it will keep senior management in place .
Translation: 双汇表示将保留现有高级管理层。

Query_Text_en: If completed , the deal would be the largest Chinese purchase of a U.S. company .
Translation: 如果完成，该交易将成为中国企业在美最大规模的收购。

Query_Text_en: More deals from China are expected in the second half , with the U.S. , Canada , Australia and the European Union as targets , according to KPMG .
Translation: 据毕马威报告，下半年预计将有更多来自中国的交易，目标市场包括美国、加拿大、澳大利亚和欧盟。

Query_Text_en: There were an estimated 40 deals completed last year between Chinese companies and the U.S. , valued at $ 11.1 billion , the firm said .
Translation: 某公司表示，去年中美两国企业之间完成了约40笔交易，总价值达111亿美元。

Query_Text_en: Chinese companies have also purchased Ferretti Italian luxury yachts ; Weetabix cereal , a staple of British breakfast tables ; and the U.K. company that makes London 's famous black cabs .
Translation: 中国公司还收购了意大利法拉帝豪华游艇、英国家庭早餐桌上常见的维他麦麦片品牌，以及英国伦敦标志性的黑色出租车制造商。

Query_Text_en: The deals have been motivated in part by Beijing 's desire for its companies to gain global footprints and to nurture China 's consumer class .
Translation: 这些交易部分源于北京方面希望中国企业拓展全球布局并培育中国的消费阶层。

Query_Text_en: The strategy for many Chinese companies looking to create global reputations has been to buy strong , sizable brands that already have power , rather than attempt to build Chinese brands and businesses , said Doreen Wang , head of client solutions at brand-research company Millward Brown in Beijing .
Translation: 北京品牌研究公司Millward Brown的客户解决方案主管王杜若恩表示，许多希望建立全球声誉的中国公司采取的策略是收购已有强大影响力的知名品牌，而非尝试打造中国品牌和业务。

Query_Text_en: ` Acquiring or creating joint ventures leverages both Chinese and foreign companies , ' she said , allowing the opportunity for ` building the brand in a more systematic way than starting from ground zero . '
Translation: 通过收购或创建合资企业，中外资企业得以发挥各自优势，她表示，这为品牌建设提供了比从零开始更为系统化的机会。

Query_Text_en: Indigenous Chinese brands have struggled .
Translation: 中国本土品牌面临挑战。

Query_Text_en: Companies such as Li Ning Co. , which once aspired to be a major global sports-apparel brand , have n't been able to compete successfully with international rivals .
Translation: 曾试图成为全球知名运动服饰品牌的企业如李宁公司，至今未能成功与国际竞争对手抗衡。

Query_Text_en: Among the world 's top 10 most valuable brands as measured by Millward Brown , only one is Chinese . And that company , state-controlled telecommunications operator China Mobile Ltd. , is firmly China-focused .
Translation: 在Millward Brown评估的全球十大最有价值品牌中，只有一个是我国的品牌。这家企业即国家控股的中国移动有限公司，业务牢牢扎根于中国市场。

Query_Text_en: Perhaps China 's biggest foreign-brand success story is Lenovo Group Ltd. , which in 2005 bought the personal-computer business of International Business Machines Corp. and with it , ThinkPad laptops .
Translation: 或许，中国最成功的外资品牌故事非联想集团有限公司莫属。该公司于2005年成功收购了国际商业机器公司（IBM）的个人电脑业务及其ThinkPad笔记本电脑业务。

Query_Text_en: At first the business posted losses and struggled with integration , fulfilling the expectations of analysts who had questioned whether a Chinese company would damage a brand that IBM had built by selling to corporate clients .
Translation: 起初该业务出现亏损并在整合方面遇到困难，这符合那些曾质疑中国公司是否会因向企业客户销售而损害IBM打造的品牌的分析师的预期。

Query_Text_en: But Lenovo kept several key managers , including Arimasa Naitoh , the engineer who designed the ThinkPad , inspired by a Japanese lunchbox .
Translation: 但联想保留了包括ThinkPad设计师内藤明佐（其设计灵感源自日式便当盒）在内的数位关键管理人员。

Query_Text_en: Lenovo also split its headquarters between Beijing and Morrisville , N.C. , where the IBM unit had been based , and made English the company 's official language .
Translation: 联想还将总部分设于北京和北卡罗来纳州莫里斯维尔（原IBM部门所在地），并将英语定为公司官方语言。

Query_Text_en: Lenovo Chief Executive Yang Yuanqing also expanded in developing markets , particularly China , where PC demand continued to boom .
Translation: 联想首席执行官杨元庆还进一步拓展了新兴市场，尤其是中国市场，而这里的个人电脑需求持续增长。

Query_Text_en: Since Lenovo took over , ThinkPad sales have doubled , while profit margins have remained above 5 % .
Translation: 自联想收购以来，ThinkPad销量翻番，而利润率一直保持在5%以上。

Query_Text_en: The company also is gaining market share as rivals such as Hewlett-Packard Co. and Dell Inc. take hits from the rise of tablet computers like Apple Inc. 's iPad .
Translation: 随着惠普公司、戴尔公司等竞争对手因苹果公司iPad等平板电脑的兴起而遭受冲击，该公司也正在抢占市场份额。

Query_Text_en: ` To have higher market share , you need to have a brand , ' Mr. Yang said last year .
Translation: 杨先生去年表示："想要获得更高的市场份额，就必须打造品牌。"

Query_Text_en: Since Chinese car maker Zhejiang Geely Holding Group Co. bought Volvo cars in 2010 , the line has taken a hit because of industrywide and economic woes in Europe , its key market .
Translation: 自2010年浙江吉利控股集团有限公司收购沃尔沃汽车以来，该品牌因欧洲市场（其主要市场）的行业性及经济困境而受到冲击。

Query_Text_en: Volvo 's global sales fell 6.1 % last year , and the Swedish car maker barely eked out an operating profit .
Translation: 沃尔沃去年全球销量下滑6.1%，这家瑞典汽车制造商仅勉强实现运营利润。

Query_Text_en: Volvo is hoping an $ 11 billion product redesign and its China business will ensure success .
Translation: 沃尔沃希望斥资110亿美元的产品线重塑及其中国业务将确保其成功。

Query_Text_en: Geely has been careful to stress Volvo 's independence .
Translation: 吉利一直谨慎强调沃尔沃的独立性。

Query_Text_en: At the same time , the Chinese parent has helped expedite approval for Volvo 's soon-to-open plant in the southwestern Chinese city of Chengdu and is looking to tap Geely 's local expertise and supplier connections .
Translation: 与此同时，中国母公司帮助加快了沃尔沃在成都这一中国西南城市即将投产的新工厂审批流程，并计划借助吉利的本地经验和供应商网络。

Query_Text_en: Results in China have been disappointing .
Translation: 中国的相关成果不尽如人意。

Query_Text_en: Sales declined to 41,989 cars last year from 47,140 a year earlier -- way behind rivals such as Audi and BMW .
Translation: 去年销量从去年的47,140辆下滑至41,989辆，远远落后于奥迪和宝马等竞争对手。

Query_Text_en: But in the first four months of this year , Volvo sold 18,490 cars in China , up 28 % from a year earlier .
Translation: 今年前四个月，沃尔沃在中国销售汽车18,490辆，同比增长28%。

Query_Text_en: In April , China became Volvo 's largest single market .
Translation: 4月，中国成为沃尔沃最大的单一市场。

Query_Text_en: Other deals have had more success .
Translation: 其他交易进展更为顺利。

Query_Text_en: Since last May , just after Chinese property conglomerate Dalian Wanda Group Corp. announced its $ 2.6 billion purchase of U.S. movie chain AMC Entertainment Holdings Inc. , the theater chain AMC 's stock has jumped 71 % to $ 66.81 .
Translation: 自去年5月大连万达集团刚宣布以26亿美元收购美国影院连锁公司AMC娱乐控股公司后不久，AMC股价便飙升71%至66.81美元。

Query_Text_en: AMC last year posted a profit of $ 58 million on revenue that increased 11 % to $ 2.65 billion .
Translation: 去年，AMC营收增长11%至26.5亿美元，实现净利润5800万美元。

Query_Text_en: The chain posted a loss of $ 242.4 million in 2011 .
Translation: 该连锁企业2011年亏损2.424亿美元。

Query_Text_en: A spokesman said the Chinese company has moved a financial team to the U.S. but lets U.S. management decide how to use its strategic budget . ` The method has been to let those people most familiar with the market run the company , ' he said , adding that AMC 's management was a reason Wanda was attracted to the business .
Translation: 一位发言人表示，这家中国公司已将一个财务团队派驻美国，但允许美方管理层自行决定如何使用战略预算。"我们的做法是让最熟悉市场的人来运营公司，"他补充称，AMC的管理层正是吸引万达投资的重要原因。

Query_Text_en: The Chinese company has said it would invest $ 500 million in AMC capital improvements , such as theater remodeling , in three to five years .
Translation: 中国公司表示，未来三到五年内将投资5亿美元用于AMC的资本性改善项目，包括影院翻新等。

Query_Text_en: Since China 's state-owned Bright Food Group Co. last May announced plans to buy a 60 % stake in Weetabix Food Co. , the cereal has retained its 15 % market share in the U.K. , a Bright Food spokesman said .
Translation: 光明食品集团发言人表示，自去年5月该中国国有企业宣布计划收购维他麦食品公司60%的股份以来，其在英国的市场份额仍保持15%。

Query_Text_en: Bright and Weetabix 's British team have meanwhile turned their focus to building demand in China .
Translation: 与此同时，Bright公司和维他麦的英国团队已将工作重点转向开拓中国市场。

Query_Text_en: The Chinese company kept Weetabix 's entire management team and has been flying it to China for consumer research , the spokesman said .
Translation: 发言人表示，这家中国企业保留了维他麦的整个管理团队，并持续安排其前往中国进行消费者调研。

Query_Text_en: as the shifting dietary profile of the world 's most populous nation increasingly puts meat , dairy and processed-food producers into play .
Translation: 随着世界人口最多的国家饮食结构的变化，肉类、乳制品和加工食品生产商正面临日益重要的影响。

Query_Text_en: Underscoring the trend , China 's Shuanghui International Holdings Ltd. on Wednesday said it agred to acquire Smithfield Foods Inc. . SFD -1.83 % of the U.S. for $ 4.7 billion , aiming to secure more pork for Chinese markets .
Translation: 凸显这一趋势，中国双汇国际控股有限公司周三宣布已达成协议，将以47亿美元收购美国史密斯菲尔德食品公司（SFD，股价下跌1.83%），旨在为中国市场获取更多猪肉供应。

Query_Text_en: The proposal is the largest in more than a decade of Chinese ventures to snap up food companies abroad .
Translation: 该计划是中国过去十多年海外收购食品企业行动中规模最大的一次。

Query_Text_en: Other purchases have included state-owned Cofco Corp. 's buying Australian sugar producer Tully Sugar Ltd. last year for about $ 140 million and Shanghai-based Bright Food -LRB- Group -RRB- Co. 's 2011 purchase of Manassen Foods Australia Pty. Ltd. for an estimated $ 522 million including debt .
Translation: 其他收购案例包括去年中粮集团以约1.4亿美元收购澳大利亚图利糖业有限公司，以及上海光明食品（集团）有限公司于2011年以约5.22亿美元（含债务）收购曼森澳大利亚食品有限公司。

Query_Text_en: Bright Food said last year it would acquire control of U.K. cereal maker Weetabix Food Co. .
Translation: 去年，Bright Food集团表示将收购英国麦片制造商维他麦食品公司的控制权。

Query_Text_en: The purchases are part of a broader effort by Beijing to secure the raw materials needed to feed its fast-growing economy .
Translation: 这些采购是中国为确保满足其快速增长经济所需原材料所做更大努力的一部分。

Query_Text_en: Chinese state-controlled companies in recent years have struck big energy and mining deals . But many of the country 's food investments have had lower profiles .
Translation: 近年来，中国国有控股企业达成了多项重大能源和矿业领域交易，但该国在食品领域的投资则较为低调。

Query_Text_en: Shuanghui 's bid for Smithfield , the world 's largest hog farmer and pork processor , signals that not just any dish will do .
Translation: 双汇对全球最大的养猪及猪肉加工企业史密斯菲尔德发起收购要约，表明其并非满足于一般标准。

Query_Text_en: As China becomes richer , relatively expensive protein is becoming a bigger portion of the domestic diet .
Translation: 随着中国富裕程度的提高，优质蛋白在国内饮食结构中的占比越来越大。

Query_Text_en: China 's meat consumption would still need to rise about 8 % from last year 's level just to catch up to South Korea 's , according to the United Nations ' Food and Agriculture Organization .
Translation: 根据联合国粮农组织的数据，中国肉类消费量仍需较去年水平增长约8%，才能达到韩国的水平。

Query_Text_en: ` It is part of the broad Chinese strategy to invest the country 's current-account surplus into strategically important commodities . And going forward , more transnational acquisitions are possible in meat and dairy , ' said Paul Deane , the senior agricultural economist at Australia & New Zealand Banking Group Ltd. .
Translation: 这是中国全面战略的一部分，即利用国家经常账户盈余投资于战略重要商品。澳大利亚和新西兰银行集团有限公司高级农业经济学家保罗·迪恩表示："未来在肉类和乳制品领域，可能将出现更多跨国收购案例。"

Query_Text_en: Cofco Chairman Ning Gaoning told reporters in March that his company is seeking acquisitions and investment opportunities in more consumer brands in the U.S. , Australia and Brazil , suggesting that as Chinese palates get more adventurous , the door will open for imports of more premium foods .
Translation: 中粮集团董事长宁高宁在三月份对记者表示，该公司正积极寻求在美国、澳大利亚及巴西等市场拓展更多消费品牌收购与投资机会，这表明随着中国消费者口味日趋多元化，进口高端食品将迎来更大市场空间。

Query_Text_en: Australia may be a favored destination given the nation 's resources , Mr. Deane said .
Translation: 迪恩先生表示，鉴于该国丰富的资源，澳大利亚可能成为备受青睐的目的地。

Query_Text_en: Chinese investment in Australia and New Zealand food and agribusiness targets has totaled $ 1.1 billion since 1995 , according to research firm Dealogic .
Translation: 自1995年以来，中国对澳大利亚和新西兰食品及农商业领域的投资总额已达11亿美元，研究公司Dealogic的数据显示。
